programme.title: Party of Five
programme.desc: After being rescued from the shelter, Lexi, London and Reggie prove to be welcome additions for three different families of four.

programme.title: Rufus
programme.desc: A 1-year-old poodle mix could be the perfect playmate for a young couples current dog.

programme.title: Sandy
programme.desc: A golden retriever answers the call of duty for a wounded warrior whos in need. But to earn his service dog badge, Sandy must successfully complete Brandons boot camp.

programme.title: Kona
programme.desc: Two former high school sweethearts reunite after college and decide to kick off their new life by adopting a shelter dog. But before one-and-a-half-year-old Kona can fit into their beach-centric lifestyle, she'll need to conquer her own fear of new environments.

programme.title: Scotty
programme.desc: A young miniature pinscher mix must learn to harness his energy before he can be placed with a fashion photographer who wants a dog that can join him in public.

programme.title: Rhea
programme.desc: Brandon rescues a German shepherd that could be the perfect companion for a woman who works in a senior living community. But before the match can be confirmed, Rhea must prove that she has impulse control and mastery of the heel command.

programme.title: Aussie
programme.desc: Before he can find a new home for a Golden Retriever-Collie mix that was surrendered by his previous family, Brandon must help the dog overcome separation anxiety.

programme.title: Sammy
programme.desc: After rescuing a senior dog that was abandoned by his previous family, Brandon introduces the troubled terrier to a new recreational activity that could keep the dog healthy, while helping him bond with two young victims of bullying.

programme.title: Rosa & Charley
programme.desc: Brandon rescues a bonded Husky and Chihuahua pair that risk being permanently separated at the shelter. But despite the close connection that Charley and Rosa share, their size difference and contrasting work habits force Brandon to train them separately.

programme.title: Rosie
programme.desc: Brandon helps turn a ten-month-old poodle mix into a therapy dog for a cancer survivor whos hoping to pay it forward. But, can managing one of lifes most difficult challenges prepare Lori for the job of handling Rosie?

programme.title: Maddie
programme.desc: Brandon rescues a malnourished Poodle mix, suffering from an upper respiratory infection, in hopes that she might be the perfect companion for a woman coming to grips with her own failing eyesight.

programme.title: Estella
programme.desc: Brandon trains 5-year-old mystery mutt Estella to join a family with two 7-year-old boys, Max and Finn, and one dog, Pluto (see episode 2.5), a Tibetan terrier.

programme.title: Tank!
programme.desc: Brandon trains a Tank, a black Lab, to alert a diabetic Navy vet when his blood sugar levels are low.

programme.title: Right Fit
programme.desc: Three different shelter dogs are fitted with special outfits that could help them fit in better with their new adopters.

programme.title: Sonny
programme.desc: Eric and Rashi take on the difficult task of finding a new home for an active Siberian husky.

programme.title: Sinbad
programme.desc: A medically retired Army sergeant who suffers from PTSD seeks Brandons help finding a dog that can provide her with emotional support. But before Sinbad can be trained for his new role, Brandon must earn the trust of this timid terrier.

programme.title: Marley
programme.desc: A crafty couple thinks a six-month-old beagle-terrier mix could lift their spirits following a year thats been marred by tragedy. But their hobbies could potentially stand in the way of the safe placement of an energetic young puppy.

programme.title: Arts & Crafts
programme.desc: Eric and Rashi place three different shelter dogs into the homes of adopters whose lives revolve around music, photography and an assortment of arts and crafts

programme.title: June
programme.desc: Before being placed with an active and social couple, a rescued poodle mix must demonstrate an interest in the great outdoors and a knack for party etiquette.

programme.title: Benny
programme.desc: A shy terrier mix could be the perfect match for a family with a passion for music. But, before Bennys adoption is confirmed, he'll need to get in-tune with his potential adopters.

programme.title: Belle
programme.desc: After a series of tragic losses, a grieving couple hopes that a Silver Lab can heal their broken hearts. But before Belle can join this beach-loving family, Brandon will need to prepare the dog for a life on the sand and the sea.

programme.title: Lincoln
programme.desc: If Brandon can teach a friendly black lab to rein in his strength, he could become the perfect companion-and a physical assist dog-for a soon-to-be graduate student with muscular dystrophy.

programme.title: Sadie
programme.desc: Brandon faces one of his biggest challenges yet. He must find the perfect shelter dog to assist a woman with very special needs. And he'll have to devise a new form of training in order to make the match successful.

programme.title: Akira
programme.desc: A timid shelter dog could be the right fit for an active couple with kids. But, before Akira can join her new family, she must leap through her training and learn to trust humans.

programme.title: Champ
programme.desc: Brandon rescues a young Labrador that could be the perfect companion for a teenage boy. But before the energetic dog is ready to join his new family, he'll need obedience training and lessons in control.

programme.title: Cheese
programme.desc: A cute Corgi mix hopes to trade in his space at the shelter for a bungalow near the beach with an active, cycling couple. But to make this transition a success, Cheese must be willing to sit back and go along for the ride.

programme.title: Post Pandemic Parings
programme.desc: Eric checks in with past adopters whose isolation during the initial COVID-19 lockdown inspired the decision to welcome a new furry friend into their lives.

programme.title: Kiddo
programme.desc: A two-year-old chihuahua-mix could serve as the perfect social bridge for a young, newlywed couple that has Aspergers Syndrome. But Kiddo will need to make it through basic training before he'll be ready to join his new adopters.

programme.title: Jax
programme.desc: Brandon rescues Jax, a two-year old black shepherd-collie mix with hip dysplasia. After surgery to correct the condition, Brandon rehabilitates Jax so he can join the rescued animals at a farm owned by Brandons friend.

programme.title: Simba
programme.desc: Before a young, energetic Golden Retriever can be a companion for a family, Brandon will have to teach him control and how to safely navigate around wheelchairs.

programme.title: Evie
programme.desc: Brandon teaches balance and water safety to Evie, a Chihuahua mix, so she can fit right in with a water-loving family.

programme.title: Ginger
programme.desc: A young Terrier mix might be the best friend a nine-year-old boy has been hoping for. But Brandon is in for a lot of work if hes going to transform this untrained dog into a well-mannered family member thats good with power tools, hover-boards, and cats.

programme.title: A Family Affair!
programme.desc: Brandon revisits some of his best family-inspired training moments.

programme.title: Welcome Interruptions
programme.desc: An unexpected communication from an animal shelter results in the rescue of four dogs.

programme.title: Sapphire
programme.desc: Brandon takes on the unique challenge of training a deaf and blind puppy. If successful, this Australian Shepherd mix could become a therapy dog.

programme.title: Jingles
programme.desc: A pointer mix suffering from a bad case of kennel stress learns to shed anxiety and become an off-leash pet for an outdoor-loving family. Meanwhile, the familys daughter tries to overcome her personal fear of dogs.

programme.title: Special Services
programme.desc: Five rescued shelter dogs learn skills that will make a huge difference in their potential adopters' lives.

programme.title: Scout
programme.desc: Brandon rescues a ten-week-old puppy whose close bond with another ranch resident could be the key to successful training. If all goes well, Scout could be the perfect match for a cancer survivor searching for her next canine

programme.title: Reggie
programme.desc: A large German Shepherd mix could offer companionship to a military family thats still mourning the loss of their previous dog. But Reggie will need to prove that he can be a gentle playmate for the familys two energetic young boys.

programme.title: Progress Reports
programme.desc: Eric and Rashi receive positive progress reports from the adopters of former ranch residents, Leo and Reggie.

programme.title: Safe and Sound
programme.desc: Eric makes safety a priority while preparing four different shelter dogs for their new forever families.

programme.title: Morty
programme.desc: A pair of fishing enthusiasts hope to adopt a senior Airedale Terrier. But before Eric and Rashi can reel in this adoption, they'll need to acclimate Morty to an outdoor lifestyle.

programme.title: Oliver
programme.desc: A homeless, severely underweight terrier mix is given a home with a Los Angeles family.

programme.title: Cooper
programme.desc: Brandon rescues a terrier mix that might be the perfect companion for a retired woman and her handicapped daughter. But transforming this untrained street dog into a well-mannered family member will require a lot of work.

programme.title: Cookie
programme.desc: A female terrier mix is trained to provide comfort for a woman who suffers from anxiety and panic attacks.

programme.title: Healthcare Heroes
programme.desc: Eric and Rashi place shelter dogs with three different adopters who have dedicated their lives to caring for others.

programme.title: Gryffin

programme.desc: Three final bakers must create a beautiful edible holiday ornament display in the pre-heat; for the final main heat, the bakers must create a cake that is decorated like a gift on the outside and reveals a surprise inside when sliced.

programme.title: Sweet Revenge

programme.title: Holiday Survival Guide

programme.desc: After a woman is murdered in her apartment, Danny and Baez turn to her daughter for help, but instead she complicates the investigation; someone from Jamie and Eddie's past launches a smear campaign against them.

programme.title: Two-Faced
programme.desc: Frank's longtime friend Lenny reveals that an upcoming exposé will air some of the NYPD's dirty laundry; Erin must decide how to charge a doctor whose experimental treatments led to the death of his terminally ill daughter.

programme.title: Rectify
programme.desc: Frank must decide about implementing a more rigorous fitness test after an officer has trouble keeping up with his partner; Danny is hesitant to pursue a cold case after learning who the original detective was; Anthony begs Erin to stall a trial.

programme.title: Common Enemies
programme.desc: After someone breaks into Luis Delgado's home and kills his wife, Luis and Danny team up to take down the vicious murderer who may also be responsible for Linda's death; Frank finally meets Eddie's mother; Jamie and Erin are at odds.

programme.title: Strange Bedfellows
programme.desc: Erin must convince Frank to back a new state police bill as part of a bargain she made with Gov. Mendez; Danny and Baez pursue the same perp twice after the DA's office is unconvinced by their initial lineup; a cop killer comes up for parole.

programme.title: Identity
programme.desc: DNA evidence in a murder case leads Danny and Baez to identical twins with identical alibis; Frank learns Nicky is interviewing for a job at the Justice Coalition, which he rarely sees eye-to-eye with; Jamie visits Eddie's father in prison.

programme.title: Something Blue
programme.desc: As Jamie and Eddie's wedding day approaches, Erin interviews a witness whose story leads her to doubt Eddie's honesty; Danny and Baez unravel the complicated love life of a young man who was murdered; Frank squabbles with the top brass.

programme.title: The Real Deal
programme.desc: Danny and Baez grapple with a homicide investigation brought to their attention by Maggie, the medium who previously helped them solve a case; Frank looks for a way to help his ex-partner Lenny Ross when Lenny's daughter gets arrested.

programme.title: Naughty or Nice
programme.desc: Frank and Erin are at odds when Frank learns the district attorney's office keeps a list of officers they consider unreliable; Danny and Baez recruit a retired mobster to assist in an investigation; a predator poses as a ride-share driver.

programme.title: Behind the Smile
programme.desc: Frank's esteem for an old friend proves to be a mistake; Jamie asks Erin for help apprehending a perp who shot at him after learning she chose not to send him to prison six months ago; Eddie clashes with her new boss.

programme.title: Foggy Notion
programme.desc: Toby tries to help the sister of a shooting victim find out who killed her brother.

programme.title: Iris
programme.desc: When Toby sees a woman revive a badly injured baby, he becomes curious about her gift.

programme.title: One Way or Another
programme.desc: Toby uses his gift to help Detective Marks gather intelligence from the traumatized victim of a serial rapist.

programme.title: Falsetto
programme.desc: Maggie partners with Eva to hunt a killer after a shocking daytime stabbing in an NYC park.

programme.title: Parental
programme.desc: When a robbery at a community clinic turns deadly, the team investigates a drug trafficking crew and soon uncovers that the clinic's doctor may be more involved than they initially thought; Isobel and her stepdaughter are at odds over a family issue.

programme.title: Fadeaway
programme.desc: When a large-scale explosion rocks a Brooklyn apartment complex, the team quickly locates the perpetrator and discovers he's acting on the orders of a convicted felon currently serving time; Isobel must name her successor.

programme.title: Ratlined
programme.desc: When a journalist is shot while interviewing a prime minister, all fingers point to an assassination attempt; OA struggles to let Gemma in on the dangers of his job.

programme.title: Wolf Pack
programme.desc: Chaos erupts in the city when an attack disrupts cell, internet and emergency services; as the team races to uncover the culprits, they learn the group responsible is a radical accelerationist movement fixated on resetting society.

programme.title: Daybreak
programme.desc: When a federal whistleblower is murdered while in FBI custody along with two agents, the team is stunned to find a familiar perpetrator has resurfaced; OA wrestles with telling the team what is happening in his personal life.

programme.title: Confetti
programme.desc: When an undercover operation being led by Special Agent Nina Chase goes sideways, the team works together to flip their only witness to help them hunt down a rip crew at a cartel wedding; Nina and Scola realize they are ready to tie the knot.

programme.title: Fanatics
programme.desc: After the son of a professional basketball team owner is taken for ransom, Jubal and the team race to catch the kidnappers; they soon discover the perpetrators have been planning a larger revenge plot that they must act quickly to stop.

programme.title: Forgiven
programme.desc: After Maggie's sister, Erin, goes missing, the team begins an all-out search to recover her; when Maggie discovers Erin was kidnapped by a sinister figure from her past, she must race to save her before it's too late.

programme.title: Crusader
programme.desc: A dangerous drug kingpin from Eva's past resurfaces when two children and a daycare worker are killed due to an accidental drug exposure; Eva wavers between her mission as an agent and her personal vendetta.

programme.title: 3 Up, 3 Down
programme.desc: A double homicide in Brooklyn sets the team after a corrupt longshoreman, but they soon discover something sinister has been smuggled into New York; Isobel enlists the help of CIA's Deputy Chief of Station Nikki Reynard.

programme.title: Shahadah
programme.desc: When the body of a VA psychiatrist is found tortured and deceased under a nearby overpass, the team is led to a suspicious religious leader with a substantial online presence.

programme.title: Behavior
programme.desc: When a single mother and her son are abducted while visiting a state park, Maggie brings in Peter Olsen to help profile their suspect; as the team works, they make a harrowing discovery about an old case.

programme.title: Alien Contacts
programme.desc: Joan of Arc's defeat of the English Army; a young boy from India learns advanced mathematical formulas; an American serviceman receives a message while touching an alien aircraft; the ancient astronaut theory.

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Lavish Indulgences
programme.desc: Jacques celebrates birthdays, anniversaries and holidays with special meals. It's when he splurges on caviar, oysters, even truffles-the ultimate extravagance. These occasions are a time to gather together around the table with family and friends and indulge in our favorite foods and wines.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Extreme Smoke
programme.desc: In this "surf and turf" show, a marine biologist brings ocean-fresh sea urchins for Steven to grill. Local spiny lobster is split and roasted in the shell directly on the embers. Meanwhile, Alaskan king crab gets grilled and served with garlicky absinthe butter. Representing turf are bone-in veal chops blasted with rosemary smoke and beef plate ribs, spit-roasted on a wood-burning rotisserie.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Fire Birds
programme.desc: Poultry is one of the most versatile meats to cook over fire. From the Republic of Georgia comes tabaka, citrusy butterflied chickens grilled under a press with piquant Rhubarb Tkemali sauce. From Fez, grilled chicken and onion kebabs marinated in Charmoula. Pound cake gets the grill treatment with fresh berry "salsa" and whipped cream. Finally, a smoke-roasted turkey with butter and truffles.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Fire Meets Water
programme.desc: Fresh local fish hits the grill in this show, which is devoted to the art of grilling seafood. Local Channel Island rockfish roasts on a Himalayan salt slab, served with Melon Mint Relish. Tuna steaks come spice-rubbed and grill-blackened, sauced with Cajun Remoulade. Next, fire-roasted shrimp with Deconstructed Pesto. And for smoked fish lovers, Alaskan king salmon smoked over maple wood.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Hot Stuff
programme.desc: A show to stoke our insatiable appetite for fiery foods, starting with smoky Nashville Hot Wings. From rural Kentucky come smoky grilled pork shoulder steaks to dunk in incendiary vinegar cayenne pepper sauce. For more pain, we present Piri Piri Prawns grilled in the shell with a distinctive hot sauce, followed by Indian Tandoori Lamb served with Hell's Fury Hot Sauce and cucumber yogurt raita.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Much at Steak
programme.desc: A show devoted to the most awesome cut of meat to grill: steak. Up first, a magisterial Wood-Grilled Beef Tomahawk Steak topped with Pt. Reyes Blue Cheese Butter. Followed by a four-finger thick Cherry-Smoked New York Strip Steak. Then a plancha-seared "steak" from the sea: Bacon-Wrapped Albacore Tuna "Filet Mignons" sauced with Peppercorn Cream Sauce.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - ABC's of Smoke
programme.desc: Rotisserie-smoked chicken with root vegetables; bourbon brown sugar pork loin; brisket; smoke-roasted pears.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Bird Meets Smoke
programme.desc: Some of the world's greatest poultry dishes owe their soulful character to wood smoke. Find out how to master the fundamentals of smoking poultry-from curing and brining to smoking in charcoal smokers and pellet grills. Plus, discover how to electrify barbecue sauce with chipotle (smoked jalapeño) chilies.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Asian Smoke
programme.desc: This show explores a region you don't normally associate with smoking: Asia. From Chinese char siu pork to smoky tangerine flan, learn to create a unique fusion of Asian barbecue and American wood smoke.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Raichlen on Ribs
programme.desc: Ribs epitomize barbecue, combining well-marbled, rich-tasting meat with the primal pleasure of eating with your bare hands. Embark on a rib world tour from St. Louis to Chinatown. Plus, learn how to build an onion bomb that explodes with flavor.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Maryland Crab Feast
programme.desc: Maryland Crab Feast: This show focuses on my favorite food growing up: callinectes sapidus, better known as the Maryland blue crab. Maryland seafood markets and restaurants come alive with soft shell crabs, eaten shell and all, traditionally deep-fried, here seared over live fire. Which brings us to the summum of the Maryland crab experience: a crab feast known as Maryland steamed crabs.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Surviving Thanksgiving
programme.desc: We get it. Thanksgiving is the biggest, most intimidating meal of the year for most cooks. You won't have to worry about that because Sara Moulton has you covered! She'll show you how to cook the turkey so it's never dry, how to prep gravy and mashed potatoes ahead so you don't have to do everything at the last minute, plus recipes for three easy and delicious side dishes.

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Some Classics
programme.desc: Jacques enjoyed many new food trends. But on a cold damp night, he still craves classic dishes like onion soup or for a family dinner or an elegant meal, a roast chicken. For him, these dishes will never go out of fashion, just like the apple galette he's been making for decades.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Rice & Resilience | Charleston, South Carolina
programme.desc: Unveil Charleston's soul as we explore the layers of its history at the International African American Museum and a Lowcountry rice farm. Learn crabbing secrets from a local pro, then cook with a passionate chef, celebrating Southern staples of the local cuisine.

programme.title: A Taste of History - History, Horses, & Hospitality | Nashville, Tennessee
programme.desc: Saddle up for Southern charm as Chef Walter Staib rides through Nashville's history at Belle Meade Mansion. Explore the melodic roots of Country Music, visit iconic landmarks, and whip up delicious Southern eats like Country ham, fruitcake, and syllabub. Experience Nashville's rich cultural heritage and culinary delights in this captivating journey.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Coastal Texas Treasure | Port Aransas, Texas
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib dives into the coastal bounty of Port Aransas, Texas! Discover legendary fishing tales, explore the vibrant local culture, and savor unique seafood creations with Chef Pete Mims. Experience how Texas spices meet Gulf Coast flavors in a culinary adventure that blends tradition and innovation. Join us for an unforgettable journey through the rich, diverse tastes of coastal Texas.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Dushi Delights & Beachside Bites | Curacao, Caribbean
programme.desc: Chef Walter Staib visits Curacao to unravel the delicious stories behind this vibrant Caribbean island. We'll meet local chefs who share their culinary passion through mouthwatering dishes like stewed papaya, okra soup, and stuffed Dutch cheese. Unforgettable flavors and island adventures await as we explore Curacao's heritage and unique cuisine, making this an episode you won't want to miss!

programme.title: A Taste of History - Danube River Adventure | Part 1
programme.desc: Set sail with Chef Walter Staib on a two-part adventure down the majestic Danube River! Part 1 charts a course through Germany and Austria, exploring stunning valleys amidst Europe's heart. Discover historic sites, artistic treasures, and culinary delights at every stop along this unforgettable journey.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Danube River Adventure | Part 2
programme.desc: Our journey continues through Austria, Slovakia, and ending in the Hungarian city of Budapest. We'll marvel at architectural wonders and savor the flavors of the region with Chef Walter Staib as he prepares traditional meals aboard a luxurious cruise ship. Don't miss this unforgettable finale on the mighty Danube!

programme.title: A Taste of History - A Pioneer Palate | Colorado Springs
programme.desc: Join Chef Walter Staib on a journey to Colorado Springs, where we'll explore the history of this scenic landscape, from the indigenous Ute people through the era of homesteaders. At the Historic Rock Ledge Ranch, savor delicious recipes that have withstood the test of time. Don't miss out on this opportunity to experience the flavors and heritage of Colorado Springs!

programme.title: A Taste of History - Nourished by Nature | St. John's, Newfoundland
programme.desc: Journey to St. John's, Newfoundland, to discover the deep connection locals have with nature's bounty, and meet inspiring individuals who fish, farm, and cook with generations of tradition. Savor unique recipes prepared over crackling fire-pits, including the king of St. John's cuisine: cod.

programme.title: Great Chefs of America - Chefs: Wayne Nish, Michael Taus, and Scott Boswell
programme.desc: Recipes included with this episode: Sashimi with Olive Oil and Soy Sauce, Grilled Venison with Figstuffed Carrot Pierogis, and Bananas Foster French Toast with Crisp Plantains. Restaurants include: March in New York, Zealous in Chicago, and Stella! in New Orleans.

programme.title: Great Chefs of America - Chefs: Sandro Gamba, Antoine Bouterin, and Jean-Luc Albin
programme.desc: Recipes included with this episode: Frog Leg Risotto, Provençal Poached Cod and Vegetables, and Strawberry-Grand Marnier Tiramisú. Restaurants include: NOMI in Chicago, Bouterin in New York, and Maurice French Pastry in Metairie.

programme.title: Great Chefs of America - Chefs: Monique Barbeau, Richard Starr, and Michael Lomonaco
programme.desc: Recipes included with this episode: Saffron Fish Soup, Sugarcane-smoked Duck Breast, and Apple-Cranberry Tart. Restaurants include: Fullers in Seattle and Cuvée in New Orleans.

programme.title: Great Chefs of America - Chefs: Richard Starr, Thomas Ferlesch, and Brian Schoenbeck
programme.desc: Recipes: Crispy Mirliton and Spicy Shrimp Napoleon, Bourride with Aioli, and Lemon-Goat Cheese Cheesecake.

programme.title: Great Chefs of America - Chefs: Bill Telepan, Joachim Splichal, and Michael Taus
programme.desc: Recipes included with this episode: Crab Cocktail, Potato Chip Sandwich with Scallops, Caviar, and Bass Tartare, and Oven-roasted Kobocha Squash Masala Dosa. Restaurants include: Judson Grill in New York, Patina in Los Angeles, and Zealous in Chicago.

programme.title: Great Chefs of America - Chefs: Richard Starr, Odessa Piper, and Deborah Snyder
programme.desc: Recipes included with this episode: Foie Gras, Apple, and Goat Cheese Creme Brulee, Chicken Breast with Fennel, Peaches, and Roses, and Pear Tart Tatin with MapleWalnut and Sour Cherry Compote. Restaurants include: Cuvée in New Orleans, L'Etoile in Madison, and Judson Grill in New York.

programme.title: Great Chefs of America - Chefs: Wayne Nish, John Coletta, and Jean-Luc Albin
programme.desc: Recipes: Shirred Eggs with White Truffles, Oven-roasted Chicken with Soft Mascarpone Polenta, & more.

programme.title: Great Chefs of America - Chefs: Kim Canteenwalla, Suzana Davila, and Claudia Fleming
programme.desc: Recipes included with this episode: Caramelized Sea Scallops, Chicken in Mole Verde, and Triple Cream Tarte. Restaurants include: Beau Rivage in Biloxi, Cafe Poca Cosa in Tucson, and Gramercy Tavern in New York.

programme.title: Great Chefs of America - Chefs: Michael Lomonaco, Tim Cardillo, and Joachim Splichal
programme.desc: Recipes included with this episode: Seared Scallops and Herb Salad, Loin of Venison, and Chocolate Croissant Pudding. Restaurants include: Cranwell in Lenox and Patina in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Great Chefs of America - Chefs: Sandro Gamba, Shelley Lance, and François Payard
programme.desc: Recipes included with this episode: Crabmeat Napoleon, Potato Gnocchi with Chanterelle-Basil, and Lemon Tart.

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - To Spoon or not to Spoon
programme.desc: Dishes include: Tortellini ala Panna, Pasta Alle Vongole All'Esenziale, Chicken Scallopini / Apple Tart.

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - Being Italian
programme.desc: Chef Stellino explains the difference between Italians from Italy and Italian Americans. Dishes include: Salsiccie al Sugo (sausages braised in tomato sauce ) / Pasta alla Nanci (with Ricotta cheese) / Pasta with Shrimp (Linguine and Shrimp in white wine) / Sicilian Fish Soup / Pannacotta (chocolate pudding with berries and mint).

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - The Gardner
programme.desc: Chef Stellino paints the picture of a life expressing himself through his plating. Dishes include: Red Wine Sauce / Scalloped Potatoes (with Swiss and Parmesan cheese) / Steak au Poivre with Garlic Arugula / Salmon with Brussel Sprouts and Red Wine Sauce.

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - Vincenzo
programme.desc: Dishes include: Mussels with Garlic and Ginger / Swordfish with Peas and Tomato Sauce / Gelo Di Melone

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - The Steakhouse
programme.desc: Chef Stellino tells us about the time his parents visited him in America and he brought them to a Steak House with a surprising menu choice from his late father. Dishes include: Reverse Sear Steak with Port Wine Sauce and Pan Fried Mushroom and Arugula / Wedge Salad.

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - The Vegetarian
programme.desc: Nick ponders on the question of whether or not he could ever be a vegetarian. The answer is a solid "no." However, he has fun trying and in the process discovers some fabulous new dishes which are not exactly vegetarian, but nonetheless are loaded with spectacular flavors. Dishes include: Chilled Cantaloupe Soup / Salmon with Spinach and Pancetta Cream Sauce / Biancomangiare (Sicilian Almond Pudding).

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - The Inventor
programme.desc: Nick describes about what it takes to be in touch with yourself as a chef and what lessons to look at to further culinary passion. Dishes Include: Salad Lyonnaise with Poached Egg / Pork Schnitzel with Jaeger Sauce / Strawberry Pudding.

programme.title: Nick Stellino: Storyteller in the Kitchen - The Great Outdoorsman
programme.desc: Chef Stellino recalls the joys of camping, or lack therof. Dishes include: Pollo Alla Cacciatore (Chicken Cacciatore) / Pork Chop Alla Milanese / Macedonia Di Frutta (Marinated fruit salad in liquor and sugar).

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm - Maine Maple Sunday
programme.desc: Lisa visits a local sugar shack to learn how maple syrup is made during the early spring maple syrup season in Maine. Back at home, she bakes a maple walnut cake, then treats her chickens to some winter treats and shares an easy DIY project for the chicken coop.

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm - The Chicks are Coming!
programme.desc: It's spring in Maine, so Lisa is planting seeds and getting ready for baby chicks. After making a fun DIY project for her chickens who lay eggs, she shares her best tips and attempts to get one of her hens to raise some baby chicks, then shares a recipe for Scotch Eggs.

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm - Apple of my Eye
programme.desc: Lisa makes a small basket using wood scraps and wire. Then she takes a trip to a local orchard and bakes an apple pie with some of the apples she's picked. She demonstrates how to make homemade apple cider vinegar, introduces several of her chickens, then makes them some apple treats.

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm - The Great Pumpkin
programme.desc: It's fall in Maine, so Lisa shares a few tips for planting garlic, then heads to a local family-owned farm to find the perfect pumpkin for her fall decor. After learning some pumpkin growing tips, she chooses a few pumpkins and bakes one of her favorite fall desserts - pumpkin swirl cheesecake - and of course shares some of the pumpkin with her flock.

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm - Moo Vous Plait
programme.desc: Lisa visits a local cow farm in search of fresh milk to make homemade ice cream, only to find out that the Scottish Highlands at the farm aren't dairy cows. But the second farm she visits does raise dairy cows, so Lisa tries her hand at milking, then shares bowls of homemade blackberry basil ice cream for a few friends to enjoy after a day on the lake.

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm - An Old-Fashioned New England Thanksgiving
programme.desc: Lisa prepares a holiday meal for friends, but instead of turkey, she decides to highlight some traditional New England Thanksgiving recipes including spiced cranberry sauce, popovers, seafood chowder, and a sweet Indian pudding. And of course she shares some of the scraps and leftovers with her chickens so they can enjoy their own holiday feast.

programme.title: Welcome to My Farm - Let There be Light
programme.desc: Before Lisa heads south to visit the annual holiday light display at the Coastal Maine Botanical Gardens, she shares a favorite childhood sweet treat. Then after enjoying the festivities, she ends the evening with a traditional creme brulee made with her fresh eggs. She also explains why light is so important in a chicken coop and how to handle the lack of light during the long Maine winters.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Surviving Thanksgiving
programme.desc: We get it. Thanksgiving is the biggest, most intimidating meal of the year for most cooks. You won't have to worry about that because Sara Moulton has you covered! She'll show you how to cook the turkey so it's never dry, how to prep gravy and mashed potatoes ahead so you don't have to do everything at the last minute, plus recipes for three easy and delicious side dishes.

programme.title: Pati's Mexican Table - Turkey Day
programme.desc: Pati is preparing an epic Thanksgiving meal like no other because this one has a Yucatecan twist. Trade in your turkey for a citrus brined bird and boxed stuffing for one with chorizo, apple and cornbread. Brussels sprouts get spiced up with habaneros and pork belly. With Pati's family and closest friends around the table, don't expect there to be any leftovers.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking At Home - Turkey - Not-quite-traditional Roast Turkey Dinner
programme.desc: This meal is the holiday favorite that is so good, Julia & Jacques recommend it for any day of the year. Roast Turkey with sausage and cornbread stuffing, gravy made the old-fashioned way, accompanied by creamed onions and a zesty Cranberry-Apple Chutney. The "not-quite" which has to be seen, is the inventive way the turkey is cut-up before cooking, roasted and re-assembled for serving.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Apples
programme.desc: In the orchards of upstate New York, Georgia Pellegrini explores the idea of "uncultivation"--a way of working with nature rather than controlling it. From regenerative apple growing to slow-crafted cider and brandy, she meets makers who transform fruit into something lasting, revealing how time, patience and imperfection shape both flavor and meaning.

programme.title: Modern Pioneering with Georgia Pellegrini - Maine
programme.desc: In Maine, Georgia Pellegrini explores the delicate balance between wild ecosystems and the people who steward them. From ancient wild blueberry barrens to regenerative oyster farms and cutting-edge marine research, she follows a network of growers, fishers and scientists working in sync with nature -- revealing how diversity, care and innovation can sustain both food systems and the future.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Surviving Thanksgiving

She'll show you how to cook the turkey so it's never dry, how to prep gravy and mashed potatoes ahead so you don't have to do everything at the last minute, plus recipes for three easy and delicious side dishes.

With Pati's family and closest friends around the table, don't expect there to be any leftovers.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Roasting and Baking
programme.desc: The oven is on in Lidia's kitchen, and she is using it for sweet and savory dishes. To start, she makes a springtime crunchy, cheese roasted asparagus dish. Next is a family favorite, baked eggplant with tomatoes, created with cheese and herbs, topped with a baked egg. Then it's time for sweets as she prepares an almond torte with chocolate chips served with a mound of whipped cream.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Fall's Flavorful Favorites
programme.desc: Lidia creates a seasonal meal that says 'Family Time'. Pork and grapes are a natural combination, and in today's menu she prepares Pork Medallions with Grapes; Baked Fennel with Sage and for dessert, a colorful and perfect cold weather Orange in Marsala for dessert.

programme.title: Sara's Weeknight Meals - Surviving Thanksgiving
programme.desc: We get it. Thanksgiving is the biggest, most intimidating meal of the year for most cooks. You won't have to worry about that because Sara Moulton has you covered! She'll show you how to cook the turkey so it's never dry, how to prep gravy and mashed potatoes ahead so you don't have to do everything at the last minute, plus recipes for three easy and delicious side dishes.

Trade in your turkey for a citrus brined bird and boxed stuffing for one with chorizo, apple and cornbread. Brussels sprouts get spiced up with habaneros and pork belly. With Pati's family and closest friends around the table, don't expect there to be any leftovers.

programme.title: MIX Cocktail Hour - A Bourbon Thanksgiving
programme.desc: It's a very special MIX Cocktail Hour Thanksgiving Special with host Tamee Harrison, MIX head barman Scott Cushman, and the spirit of holiday cocktail gifting.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Martha Washington Won the War
programme.desc: We all know Martha Washington from her portraits as a dowdy grandmother, but did you know that there is new evidence she was a beautiful and passionate wife befitting her handsome George? And that Martha was the secret weapon that kept troop morale high during the hard winter encampment at Valley Forge? We prepare Martha's authentic Turkey Stew with Oysters and speak with expert Patricia Brady.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Jefferson's Monticello - Part 1
programme.desc: We start a special four-part series cooking in Thomas Jefferson's actual kitchen at Monticello, his Virginia home. Chef Staib prepares Jefferson's favorite exotic dish, Stuffed Cabbage with Fried Asparagus. We also tour Jefferson's gardens, where we learn how important discovering and growing foods was to our third President.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Jefferson's Monticello - Part 2
programme.desc: In this next episode at Monticello, we learn how Thomas Jefferson "liberated" grains of European rice to grow here in America, and tour his legendary Monticello estate, including the Dependencies that housed the beer and wine cellars, and the ice house. Chef Staib also borrows Jefferson' kitchen to prepare Bouilli, a favorite boiled beef dish of Jefferson's, along with Bouillon Potatoes.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Jefferson's Monticello - Part 3
programme.desc: During his years abroad as Minister to France, Jefferson's culinary tastes became refined. In this episode, we get to know James Hemmings, Jefferson's slave cook who accompanied Jefferson to learn the ways of French cuisine. We also meet Jefferson's long-time Monticello cooks, Edith Hern Fossett and Fanny Hern. Chef Staib prepares White Bean and Bacon Soup, Chicken Fricassee, and Herbed Barley.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Jefferson's Monticello - Part 4
programme.desc: We end our tour of Jefferson's Gardens at Monticello as we learn how the President carefully cultivated over 330 vegetable varieties, along with a host of fruits. Chef Staib prepares a tour-de-force final meal in Jefferson's kitchen. Curried Lamb and with Rice Pilaf and Stewed Mushrooms, along with Leni Sorensen, Monticello's expert on the slave cooks who worked there.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Ben Franklin's Genius
programme.desc: From discovering how to harness electricity to inventing reading glasses and publishing the first daily newspaper in America, Ben Franklin's genius was a spark that helped to launch a country. We visit the American Philosophical Society, which he founded, to learn more about this most amazing man. Chef Staib prepares Braised Oxtail, and he toasts Franklin with his authentic Spruce Beer.

programme.title: A Taste of History - Washington's Crossing Pepperpot Soup
programme.desc: Before the Christmas night in 1776 when Washington led his troops to a surprise attack on the British at Trenton, he ordered one of their favorite meals to be ready upon their return, Pepperpot Soup with Cornbread. Chef Staib makes this West-Indies influenced dish again, right at that same spot along the Delaware, with revolutionary troops at his side to celebrate that all important victory.

programme.title: A Taste of History - The Washingtons at Mount Vernon - Part 1
programme.desc: When George Washington wasn't busy governing a fledgling nation, he enjoyed spending time at his family plantation, Mount Vernon. Tour the "Jewel of the Potomac" and join Chef Walter Staib in Washington's very own kitchen as he prepares some of the first President's favorite dishes such as Roasted Beef Marrow, Baked Stuffed Sturgeon, Roasted Root Vegetables and Citrus Vinaigrette.

programme.title: A Taste of History - The Washingtons at Mount Vernon - Part 2
programme.desc: Meet "Martha Washington" as she brings her years with George to life. Always a gracious hostess, "Martha" invites Chef Walter to tea. We also see the Washingtons' personal china and silverware from Mount Vernon. In the kitchen, Chef Walter's menu includes Pickled Herring Bonne Femme, Roasted Stuffed Grouse, Braised Sunchokes and Sweet Potato Biscuits.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Barbecue Takes Flight
programme.desc: Barbecue Takes Flight: What's America's most popular meat? It's Poultry. Americans consume more than 112 pounds per person each year. Today Steven prepares an astonishing array of grilled poultry from brandy brined rotisserie chicken to duck legs flame roasted Peking-style. And with a special guest a Project Fire first: turkey "ribs"-found in St. Louis, and virtually nowhere else.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Bird Meets Smoke
programme.desc: Some of the world's greatest poultry dishes owe their soulful character to wood smoke. Find out how to master the fundamentals of smoking poultry-from curing and brining to smoking in charcoal smokers and pellet grills. Plus, discover how to electrify barbecue sauce with chipotle (smoked jalapeño) chilies.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Fire Birds
programme.desc: Poultry is one of the most versatile meats to cook over fire. From the Republic of Georgia comes tabaka, citrusy butterflied chickens grilled under a press with piquant Rhubarb Tkemali sauce. From Fez, grilled chicken and onion kebabs marinated in Charmoula. Pound cake gets the grill treatment with fresh berry "salsa" and whipped cream. Finally, a smoke-roasted turkey with butter and truffles.

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Smoke - Thanksgiving Comes Early
programme.desc: Don't wait until Thanksgiving to try these new twists on holiday favorites: whiskey-brined turkey smoked over maple wood; bacon-stuffed barbecued onions; smoky creamed corn; fiery jalapeno cranberry salsa; and a smoky bacon-apple crisp for dessert. No oven required! These recipes call for a ceramic smoker, upright barrel smoker, electric smoker, and stovetop smoker.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Turkey
programme.desc: This meal is the holiday favorite that is so good, Julia & Jacques recommend it for any day of the year. Roast Turkey with sausage and cornbread stuffing, gravy made the old-fashioned way, accompanied by creamed onions and a zesty Cranberry-Apple Chutney. The "not-quite" which has to be seen, is the inventive way the turkey is cut-up before cooking, roasted and re-assembled for serving.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Desserts
programme.desc: Jacques and Julia create some very special desserts in this colorful episode. Poires Belle Helene - poached pear perched atop pound cake drizzled with chocolate sauce; sweet creamy rich and delicious Strawberries Sabayon; and Crepes Suzette, classically flambéed and served with orange butter and powdered sugar, as well as a Hungarian inspired torta of layered crepes baked with raspberry jam.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Salads
programme.desc: Jacques dressed in a toga? For the Julia's Caesar Salad, of course! This show has a salad for everyone, from a simple mixed green salad with a garlic vinaigrette, to classic Caesar and Nicoise (with fresh seared tuna) Salads. How about some Potato Salad? Well, Julia and Jacques prepare two: an American style potato salad with home made mayonnaise, and its tart French cousin.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Vegetables
programme.desc: Julia and Jacques prepare artichokes-several ways-including artichoke hearts stuffed with spinach and mushroom Duxelle. Julia demonstrates her secret to ever-green cooked string beans and butter bruised peas. Jacques counters with his aromatic Tomato Provencal.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Beef Stew
programme.desc: Sounds rather ordinary for this celebrated duet...but here, Jacques and Julia demonstrate why Beef Burgundy and Pot Roast have beens favorite "classic" recipes (here and in France) for what seems like "forever," and they put their own signature on it "Swiss cheese mashed potatoes" (for the Beef Burgundy), and "soft ribbon noodles" (fort the Pot Roast).

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Roast Chicken
programme.desc: Perfectly roasted chicken says Julia, is a telltale of a really good cook. Here are three ways to perfectly roasted chicken. Whether whole rack-roasted or trussed and stuffed under the skin with a savory and shallot sauté, or butterflied and roasted with a delicate spice rub, each has a crispy golden brown skin and juicy meat that say "Hmmmm! Great chicken!"

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Soufflés
programme.desc: Julia and Jacques demonstrate the art, and the adventure, of the Soufflé. Julia extends the classic cheese soufflé to super-height...and Jacques creates a light, fluffy, flavorful scallop and cheese soufflé in a large casserole. For dessert, a chocolate soufflé and cream roulade. Twinkies were never this good!

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Charcuterie
programme.desc: Julia and Jacques demonstrate recipes for sausage and paté that are right out of the French countryside. Made from scratch sausage and lentil salad, country paté (2 ways), and, for a finale, a grand truffle infused sausage wrapped in fresh baked brioche (recipe also demonstrated).

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Comfort Food
programme.desc: Poached chicken, chicken pot pie and rustic apple tart dessert. Julia and Jacques show how simple it is to poach a chicken with vegetables, mushrooms and a little white wine, and then take that poaching liquid and use it with the leftover poached chicken for a flaky crusted chicken pot pie. The same simple pastry Julia makes for the pot pie is perfect base for a rustic apple and dried fruit tart.

programme.title: Julia & Jacques Cooking at Home - Potatoes
programme.desc: One Potato, two potato, oh, so many potatoes. Julia and Jacques share their tricks, "trucs" and techniques for perfect baked potatoes, airy mashed potatoes, creamy potato casserole, and delightful lighter-than-air crispy-fried pommes soufflés.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Antipasti
programme.desc: Lidia shares several dishes that will work for any party, including a selection of cheese, cured meat, and Giardiniera-style vegetables; an easy and quick sweet & sour zucchini dish and lastly stuffed mushrooms made with a delicious mixture of scallions, red peppers, and fresh parsley. Lastly, there is still time for a delicious salad of poached seafood featuring shrimp, mussels, and calamari.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Braising
programme.desc: Lidia serves up a crispy golden Italian style quiche followed by a fork tender beef braised in Barolo. Her side dish is a braised broccoli rabe with garlic and extra virgin olive oil.

programme.title: Lidia's Kitchen - Grandma's Favorites
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia honors the Grandmothers of the family. She starts with a delicious and quick Skillet Gratin of Mushrooms and Chicken, one of her mother's favorites. As the chicken is cooking, she heads to the side dish, Celery Potatoes and Tomatoes. Joining her at the end of the show is Lidia's granddaughter, Julia to taste Grandma Rosa's Apple Cake.

programme.title: Jacques Pépin Cooking at Home - Warming Fall Flavors
programme.desc: As fall approaches, the weather chills and summer vegetables lose their vibrancy. Jacques uses the final days of tomatoes and eggplant to make his ratatouille cooked with a pork roast. He follows with comforting dishes with Brussels sprouts, lamb shoulder chops and his wife's Arroz con Pollo. And, because apples are at their peak, he makes Apple Compote.

programme.title: Legacy
