programme.desc: A trail bum rides into North Fork during one of the worst droughts in years. He claims that he can bring rain to their town. Many believe that he's a water witcher, but a railroad boss resents his intrusion and wants him gone.

programme.title: The Rifleman - Blood Brothers
programme.desc: Lucas finds a wounded man, takes him to the North Fork doctor, and gives blood to help save the stranger's life. Marshal Torrance won't help as he says he knows the man and wants him dead. Things become more complicated when vigilantes ride to town.

programme.title: Maverick - The Judas Mask
programme.desc: A Norwegian showgirl named Karen lures Bart Maverick into partnering on a hotel casino business proposition. However, after she steals $20,000 and flees to Mexico, Bart gives chase, set on retrieving his cash from the woman before she disappears.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - Burton Mossman Crosses the Line
programme.desc: After failing to capture the ruthless murderer Augustine Chacon on U.S. soil, Arizona Ranger Burton Mossman relinquishes his badge to cross the border. In Mexico, he goes undercover as a horse thief to join Chacon's gang and spring his trap.

programme.title: Wild West Chronicles - Sister Blandina and the Killer
programme.desc: When a bloodthirsty mob storms a jailhouse holding a man accused of attempted murder, they are confronted by a 22-year-old missionary from the Sisters of Charity. Only Sister Blandina can stop the vigilantes from taking the law into their own hands.

programme.title: Into The Wild Frontier - Jim Beckwourth: War Chief of the Crow
programme.desc: When former slave Jim Beckwourth heads west to seek work as a trapper, he begins what will become one of the most eventful, heroic lives of all the mountain men. As a joke, one of Beckwourth's fellow trappers tells a group of Crow warriors that Beckwourth is a long-lost member of their tribe, and the adventure begins. Adopted by the Crow, Beckwourth joins them in a series of ferocious battles with other tribes, becomes a war chief, and falls in love with a fierce female warrior named Pine Leaf.

programme.title: The Fabulous Baker Boy
programme.desc: When Will agrees to fire Karen's pastry chef, he becomes involved in a love triangle that the baker created.

programme.title: Sour Balls
programme.desc: When Jack convinces Will that they need a change of scenery, they buy an apartment in an up-and-coming gay community.

programme.title: The Blonde Leading the Blind
programme.desc: Will is jealous when his no-nonsense therapist (guest star Sharon Stone) becomes fast friends with Grace.

programme.title: It's a Dad, Dad, Dad, Dad World
programme.desc: Grace convinces Karen to attend her father's (Alan Arkin) birthday party; Karen entertains herself by spending time with Martin's friend Burt (Lee Majors).

programme.title: From Queer to Eternity
programme.desc: Grace's near-death experience prompts her to write her will and jolts Will into making a life-altering career choice.

programme.title: Friends With Benefits
programme.desc: When Will's writing career fizzles, Malcolm (Alec Baldwin) makes him another job offer; Grace's old college flame (Eric Stoltz) gives her a job decorating his new hotel.

programme.title: Kiss and Tell
programme.desc: Will becomes suspicious of his new job when he finds himself in an empty office with a German shepherd and a Russian-speaking thug.

programme.desc: Grace contemplates an affair with a married man (Eric Stoltz); Jack begins his new career as a talk-show host; Will continues to hide from Karen the fact that Stan is alive.

programme.desc: When Will suspects that Karen is more upset about Stan being alive than she is letting on, he makes it his mission to help her heal emotionally.

programme.title: The Old Man and the Sea
programme.desc: Jack learns that Will has never learned how to swim, so he makes it his mission to teach him.

programme.title: Steams Like Old Times
programme.desc: Jack tells Karen he believes she belongs with Stan, not Malcolm (Alec Baldwin).

programme.title: Love Is in the Airplane

programme.title: Swish Out of Water
programme.desc: When Grace finds it impossible to please her mother, Jack offers to help, believing no one knows how to be a good daughter like a gay son.

programme.title: A Little Christmas Queer
programme.desc: When the gang spends Christmas at the home of Will's mother, Marilyn Truman (Blythe Danner), Grace gets romantic with Will's brother.

programme.title: Von Trapped
programme.desc: "The Sound of Music Sing-Along" has come to town and no one is more excited than Grace; she plans for her and Will to attend the musical in character-like style by dressing up in costumes.

programme.title: Bathroom Humor
programme.desc: All of New York society attend Karen's birthday party, but Will, Grace and Jack embarrass themselves and get stuck in the bathroom with the birthday girl.

programme.title: Forbidden Fruit
programme.desc: Will insists that Grace turn down a job offer from his former boss, Margot, who has asked Grace to redecorate the law firm.

programme.title: Cop to It
programme.desc: Will and Grace dread a dinner date with Rob and Ellen, but the identity of their waiter (Bobby Cannavale) eclipses their friends' big news.

programme.title: I Love L. Gay
programme.desc: Will, Karen and Grace travel to Los Angeles to support Jack as he accepts an award for Best Local Cable Guy Talk Show Host.

programme.title: The Definition of Marriage
programme.desc: Karen ignores Grace's plea for a low-key wedding and plans a huge affair, hiring Hall & Oates to perform "Maneater" at the ceremony.

programme.title: Grace Expectations
programme.desc: Nervous but optimistic Grace decides it is time to tell Leo (Harry Connick Jr.) she is pregnant with his child.

programme.title: Cowboys and Iranians
programme.desc: Ecstatic, Jack coerces Will into coming out with him to a cowboy bar to meet his new boyfriend, Travis.

programme.title: Buy Buy Baby
programme.desc: A large corporation takes over OutTV, completely revamping Jack's talk show and giving him a conservative co-host, Britney Spears.

programme.title: Blanket Apology
programme.desc: Jack loses his hosting job and vows never to return to acting; Will has a showdown with his father.

programme.title: The Mourning Son
programme.desc: At his father's funeral, Will grapples with their last encounter; Grace begins to doubt her potential to be a good mother.

programme.title: Partners 'N Crime
programme.desc: Will and Grace attend childbirth classes; Karen seeks comfort from very busy Jack.

programme.title: Whatever Happened to Baby Gin?
programme.desc: Will and Grace settle into the idea of raising the baby together; Vince's plans to move into a brownstone with Will do not include Grace; Jack's show premieres; Will must choose between his commitment to Grace and his relationship with Vince.

programme.title: The Finale
programme.desc: Will and Grace make a decision about their future together; Jack continues his never-ending search for love; Karen tries to find happiness in Stan's absence.

programme.title: The Finale
programme.desc: Will and Grace make a decision about their future together; Jack continues his never-ending search for love; Karen tries to find happiness in Stan's absence.

programme.title: 11 Years Later
programme.desc: Will and Grace both falter when their political beliefs are put to the test; Jack and Karen help Will and Grace hide their secret shame from each other, but the truth finally comes out.

programme.title: Who's Your Daddy
programme.desc: Will and Jack try to date younger guys but find it challenging; Grace and Karen experience a crisis that reveals Grace's true feelings about Karen.

programme.title: Emergency Contact
programme.desc: Grace finds that the emergency contact called by her doctor's office is ex-husband Leo, not Will; Jack takes on a new job; Karen befriends a 12-year-old girl in the Bronx.

programme.title: Grandpa Jack
programme.desc: Jack is stunned to learn that his estranged son has a son of his own; Grace and Karen behave badly with the hot new guy at work.

programme.title: How to Succeed in Business Without Really Crying
programme.desc: Grace gets a job decorating a string of boutique hotels for an obnoxious hotel mogul; Will is surprised at his reaction to becoming senior partner; Jack owns half of a winning lottery ticket.

programme.title: Rosario's Quinceanera
programme.desc: Karen has trouble dealing with a personal tragedy; Will, Grace, and Jack try to intervene; Will and Grace's new business relationship begins to show signs of stress.

programme.title: A Gay Olde Christmas
programme.desc: Will, Grace, Karen and Jack wish they could have experienced Christmas in old New York, but realize the past was not quite as romantic or open to diversity as they pictured it.

programme.title: Friends and Lover
programme.desc: Will and Grace try to convince themselves they are okay with dating the same man; Jack and Karen get an annoying commercial jingle stuck in their heads and must seek medical attention.

programme.title: There's Something About Larry
programme.desc: Will and Grace's old friend Larry decides he's in love with Will; Jack's first day as a Lyft driver doesn't go as planned; Karen tries to help Jack but ends up needing help rather than giving it.

programme.title: The Wedding
programme.desc: Grace tries to prevent Will from making a scene at his ex-boyfriend's wedding; Jack's wedding hook-up comes with strings attached.

programme.title: Staten Island Fairy
programme.desc: Jack's intimacy issues are challenged by a closeted boyfriend; Will and Grace sell their new line of bedding on live television.

programme.title: Three Wise Men
programme.desc: Grace is horrified to realize that she's dated three men from the same family; Will and Karen get on each other's nerves at the office until they bond over watching -- and producing -- their own little telenovela.

programme.title: Sweatshop Annie & the Annoying Baby Shower
programme.desc: A baby shower makes Grace and Will question their life choices; Karen and Jack find a way to combine child labor with musical theater.

programme.title: The Beefcake & the Cake Beef
programme.desc: Against Jack's advice, Will rekindles a relationship with his first love; Grace reluctantly fights for Karen's civil rights when a bakery refuses to make a cake she wants.

programme.title: One Job
programme.desc: Grace brings Will for support when she goes home to celebrate her deceased mother's birthday; Jack's faith in love is crushed after a breakup; a secret in Karen's marriage is uncovered.

programme.title: It's a Family Affair
programme.desc: Grace's father and Will's mother end up making a surprising and upsetting connection; Jack rebounds from his breakup with a new love; Karen must decide between her husband and her lover.

programme.title: The West Side Curmudgeon
programme.desc: Grace's accidental run-in with a curmudgeon she follows on Twitter smacks of romance; Jack makes a terrible impression on Estefan's family after a numbing cream incident; Will helps Karen protect her most prized possession.

programme.title: Where in the World Is Karen Walker?
programme.desc: After Will and Grace's parents get married, big changes are afoot for the gang: Will gets a teaching job and a beard, Grace decides to run for office, Jack prepares to settle down with Estefan and Karen goes missing.

programme.title: Tex and the City
programme.desc: When Jack learns what song his grandson Skip intends to perform at his church talent show, he fears for his safety; Karen faces off with Beverley Leslie over her piece of border wall; Grace and Noah try to have sex; Will unleashes his inner Queen.

programme.title: Who's Sorry Now?
programme.desc: Now a certified psychic, Jack channels Rosario to help Karen open her heart to love again; Grace learns love means having to say she's sorry.

programme.title: Grace's Secret
programme.desc: While on a road trip with her father, Grace reveals a past secret, changing their relationship forever; legendary drag queen Miss Coco Peru emcees a lip sync monologue throw down to determine who will be Jack's best man, Will or Karen.

programme.title: Kid 'n Play
programme.desc: When Will discovers Noah has a child, he promises to keep the secret from Grace; Karen and Jack's relationship is tested when she fires him from the play she's producing and replaces him with Jon Cryer.

programme.title: So Long, Division
programme.desc: Grace unintentionally meets Noah's daughter Katie; Will's mom Marilyn visits after the death of her beloved dog, but doesn't get the emotional support she expects; Jack argues with his rec center boss, Theo.

programme.title: Anchor Away
programme.desc: In order to land a handsome TV news anchor with a penchant for dim, silly men, Will seeks advice from Jack on how not to be himself; Karen enlists Grace to help get photos of her ex Stan's affair with Lorraine Finster.

programme.title: Family, Trip
programme.desc: Will, Karen and Jack unknowingly take hallucinogens, which cause Will and Jack to wonder whether they're soul mates and have Karen giving her final performance as Mrs. Stanley Walker; a high-powered client takes up with Grace's sister Janet.

programme.title: Dead Man Texting
programme.desc: Will and Grace's plan to win over Will's new boss goes awry when he drops dead in their apartment; Estefan and Karen's mutual dislike puts Jack in full damage control mode at his birthday dinner.

programme.title: The Scales of Justice
programme.desc: Will uses a mock trial in an attempt to repair the rift between Karen and her stepdaughter; Grace and Jack decide to go on a diet together but changing their eating habits proves harder than they thought.

programme.title: The Pursuit of Happiness
programme.desc: Malcolm enlists Grace to help him win back Karen's affections; Will's flirtation at work lands him in an ethical dilemma; Jack's passion for performing is reignited by a chance encounter with Susanna, the sister of his former acting teacher.

programme.title: The Real McCoy
programme.desc: Will gives local newscaster McCoy Whitman a second chance -- with Jack's help; Grace's campaign hits a snag when the deciding vote belongs to her nemesis Val; campaign manager Karen attempts to secure the winning vote by any means necessary.

programme.title: Supreme Courtship
programme.desc: Jack's insistence that Will be nicer to Estefan backfires; Grace unknowingly knocks over a prominent figure; when Karen discovers Noah plans to kill off the main character of her favorite romance novel, she forces him to rewrite the story.

programme.title: Bad Blood
programme.desc: After her dad, Martin, is rushed to the hospital, Grace is shocked when he refuses a transfusion of Will's blood; Will's mom, Marilyn, uncharacteristically takes Martin to task; Karen's demands cause Jack to uninvite her to his wedding.

programme.title: Conscious Coupling
programme.desc: When both of their boyfriends ask to move in, Will and Grace use each other as an excuse to get out of it; a snowstorm traps Karen at the office and Jack in an elevator, where he reunites with old flame Drew and tests his commitment to monogamy.

programme.title: The Things We Do for Love
programme.desc: Jack realizes he lost 13 gold coins he's supposed to give Estefan at their wedding to avoid a curse; Will is concerned that Grace is the only one compromising in her relationship with Noah; Karen shows up at a dinner party with her new date, Nikki.

programme.title: Jack's Big Gay Wedding
programme.desc: Jack and Estefan's wedding takes a detour when they're forced to get married at the airport by their friend Miss Coco; Will's worried his relationship may turn long-distance; Grace meets a charming guy; Karen reconsiders her commitment to Nikki.

programme.title: Eat, Pray, Love, Phone, Sex
programme.desc: Grace returns from her European travels a new woman, but her elation is short-lived when she receives life-changing news; Karen teaches Will how to be better at phone sex; Jack has a yard sale to discreetly get rid of Estefan's annoying cuckoo clock.

programme.title: Pappa Mia
programme.desc: When Grace admits she's not sure who's the father of her baby, Karen orchestrates a "Mamma Mia" situation with the potential baby daddies; Will worries what will happen if he has a straight son and enlists Jack to help him prepare.

programme.title: With Enemies Like These
programme.desc: Will discovers a way to finally get back at Jack for years of mocking his hairline; Grace is determined to prove to Mrs. Timmer she's strong enough to handle being a single mother; Karen squares off against Stan's brother in a poker game.

programme.title: The Chick or the Egg Donor
programme.desc: Will and Grace get competitive over whose process of having a baby is more difficult; Jack helps Karen prove that she'll be a competent owner of her new baseball team, but Karen realizes that an old acquaintance may be the help she really needs.

programme.title: The Grief Panda
programme.desc: In the aftermath of Will and McCoy breaking up, Grace and Jack hire the Grief Panda to help Will process his pain; with Karen completely occupied with her new baseball team, Grace believes that she has to fire Karen to set her free.

programme.title: Performance Anxiety
programme.desc: Committed to becoming a father on his own, Will meets a potential surrogate who has stellar reviews, but her lifestyle choices give him doubts; Grace pretends to be a former famous Annie to gain entrance into AnnieCon.

programme.title: What a Dump
programme.desc: Grace and her neighbor give their romance another shot; however, an embarrassing incident puts Grace's relationship, and her dignity, in jeopardy; Will decides it's time for Jack to grow up and cuts him off financially.

programme.title: Lies & Whispers
programme.desc: When Larry warns Will and Grace about the difficult entry process into the elite school they want their kids to go to, they set out to prove that their child would be the better candidate; Jack creates problems between Karen and her booty buddy.

programme.title: Bi-Plane
programme.desc: Will and Grace decide to intervene when they discover Grace's niece is dating a bisexual man; Jack gets permission from his husband to sleep with his celebrity hall pass; Karen struggles to adapt when her assistant books them on an economy flight.

programme.title: Of Mouse and Men
programme.desc: Marilyn goes behind Grace's back to fix her up with a beagle-breeding couple interested in adopting Grace's baby; Will helps Karen deal with a PR nightmare; Jack and Estefan go to extreme lengths to get rid of a mouse.

programme.title: Accidentally on Porpoise
programme.desc: Grace and her neighbor, James, give their relationship one more shot, but when James invites Grace to his job at the aquarium, she endangers his job and a species; Jack takes Will to an unexpected place to blow off steam -- church.

programme.title: Filthy Phil, Part I
programme.desc: Karen introduces Will and Grace to the new love of her life, Phil, but Will and Grace become suspicious that he has sinister intentions; when Miss Coco Peru tells Jack that he's closing down his bar, Estefan encourages Jack to become its new owner.

programme.title: Filthy Phil, Part II
programme.desc: Will and Grace race to save Karen when they think she is in danger after her new boyfriend takes her to a cabin in the woods; Jack makes up a story to a snobby reporter to keep his new bar relevant after its previous owner steps down.

programme.title: The Favourite
programme.desc: Jack helps Karen sneak into the manse to retrieve her ring, but they're shocked to find it on the hand of Stan's new girlfriend; while hosting Will's surrogate for the weekend, Will and Grace become the old folks they swore they'd never become.

programme.title: Broadway Boundaries
programme.desc: Will ropes Dr. DiLorenzo into going on a fake date so he can spy on his surrogate; Grace struggles with popping her gender reveal balloon; Karen is torn between celebrating her team's championship and helping Jack with his Broadway audition.

programme.title: We Love Lucy
programme.desc: Will claims living with Grace is like Ricky living with Lucy; when Karen and Jack hear this, they each claim that they are the Lucy of the group; Grace, Karen and Jack each imagine themselves as Lucy, with Will as the Ricky to all of them.

programme.title: New Crib
programme.desc: Karen celebrates her baseball team's championship; Will and Grace go to an open house, which leads to a conversation about their future living arrangement; Jack has to decide if he wants to stay in the city to pursue his dreams.

programme.title: It's Time
programme.desc: Will is determined to not reminisce about his life in the city or his ex; Grace has false alarms of going into labor; Karen attempts to get closure with her ex-husband; Jack's dream of taking a bow on a Broadway stage becomes a very real possibility.

programme.title: Pilot
programme.desc: When Grace (Debra Messing) gets a marriage proposal, Will (Eric McCormack) risks their friendship by telling her what he thinks.

programme.title: A New Lease on Life
programme.desc: Will mulls asking Grace to share his place when she considers renting across town.

programme.title: Head Case
programme.desc: Will (Eric McCormack) faces the big issues when Grace (Debra Messing) moves in and wants to knock down the bathroom walls.

programme.title: Between a Rock and Harlin's Place
programme.desc: Grace's (Debra Messing) decorating job on Harlin's (Gary Grubbs) place embarrasses Will (Eric McCormack), who then makes an even bigger mess.

programme.title: Boo! Humbug
programme.desc: Jack and Karen (Sean Hayes, Megan Mullally) head out to party, while Will and Grace (Eric McCormack, Debra Messing) go trick-or-treating with Harlan's (Gary Grubbs) kids.

programme.title: William, Tell
programme.desc: Grace worries that Will is keeping secrets from her after Jack discloses Will's past affair with a client.

programme.title: Where There's a Will, There's No Way
programme.desc: Grace (Debra Messing) blames Will (Eric McCormack) for her lack of a social life and decides that they can no longer have fun.

programme.title: The Buying Game
programme.desc: Grace (Debra Messing) seeks Will's (Eric McCormack) advice on buying a studio, then sets out to prove she can make the deal.

programme.title: The Truth About Will and Dogs
programme.desc: Will (Eric McCormack) develops a dog obsession after Grace (Debra Messing) brings home a puppy, forcing her to take action.

programme.title: The Big Vent
programme.desc: Will and Grace (Eric McCormack, Debra Messing) eavesdrop on the couple downstairs (guest stars Tom Sullivan, Corinne Bohrer), who are involved in a marital conflict.

programme.title: Will on Ice
programme.desc: Jack and Grace (Sean Hayes, Debra Messing) surprise Will (Eric McCormack) on his birthday with tickets to an ice-skating show with Rudy Galindo (as himself). With Megan Mullally.

programme.title: My Fair Maid-y
programme.desc: Will hires a cleaning lady to help Grace with her preparations for an upcoming decorators' contest; Jack dates a guy he meets at the bookstore.

programme.title: The Unsinkable Mommy Adler
programme.desc: Grace (Debra Messing) gets a visit from her mother (guest star Debbie Reynolds), who wreaks havoc by suggesting that she marry Will (Eric McCormack).

programme.title: Big Brother Is Coming
programme.desc: Will's estranged, older brother turns up at Jack's birthday party; Karen flashes her platinum card for Jack.

programme.title: Big Brother Is Coming
programme.desc: Grace (Debra Messing) tells Will (Eric McCormack) about her romance with his brother (guest star John Slattery); Karen (Megan Mullally) helps Jack (Sean Hayes) deal with turning 30.

programme.title: Yours, Mine or Ours
programme.desc: Will and Grace (Eric McCormack, Debra Messing) compete for the affections of their new neighbor (guest star David Newsom). With Megan Mullally.

programme.title: Secrets & Lays
programme.desc: Grace (Debra Messing) romances an old flame (guest star David Sutcliffe) while in Vermont and tries to hide the fling from Will (Eric McCormack). Tom Bosley also guest stars.

programme.title: Grace, Replaced
programme.desc: Will uses his new neighbor, Val, for his plans while Grace works; Jack is sentenced to pick up trash.

programme.title: Will Works Out
programme.desc: Will learns a lesson about prejudice from Jack; Karen tells Grace about her rocky marriage.

programme.title: Saving Grace
programme.desc: A successful publicist hires Grace to decorate his office with the condition that Will dates him.

programme.title: Alley Cats
programme.desc: Grace tones down her competitiveness during game playing, while Will's focus changes to winning; Karen saves a workman.

programme.title: Object of My Rejection
programme.desc: Grace and Will (Debra Messing, Eric McCormack) rethink their living arrangement; Jack (Sean Hayes) agrees to marry Karen's (Megan Mullally) maid (guest star Shelley Morrison).

programme.title: Guess Who's Not Coming to Dinner
programme.desc: To assert her independence, Grace moves to the apartment across the hall and throws a dinner party without Will's help.

programme.title: Election
programme.desc: A jealous Grace runs against Will for president of the board of tenants when she finds out about the position's perks.

programme.title: Das Boob
programme.desc: Grace tries to live up to her new "dimensions" when a deceiving, but flattering, picture of her appears in a newspaper.

programme.title: Whose Mom Is It Anyway?
programme.desc: Grace's mom (guest star Debbie Reynolds) shows Will (Eric McCormack) a little too much attention for her jealous daughter's taste. With Debra Messing.

programme.title: Polk Defeats Truman
programme.desc: Will lets his ego get the better of him when he dismisses the clients who believed in him before he became a success.

programme.title: To Serve and Disinfect
programme.desc: Jack (Sean Hayes) challenges Will (Eric McCormack) to become a waiter on his staff; Grace (Debra Messing) finds out a dirty secret about Karen (Megan Mullally).

programme.title: Homo for the Holidays
programme.desc: Jack's (Sean Hayes) mother (guest star Veronica Cartwright) doesn't know he is gay and thinks he once had a romantic relationship with Grace (Debra Messing).

programme.title: Terms of Employment
programme.desc: Grace (Debra Messing) looks to Will (Eric McCormack) for representation when a lawyer (guest star Gregory Hines) doesn't pay her for a consulting assignment.

programme.title: I Never Promised You an Olive Garden
programme.desc: Rob and Ellen become jealous when Will and Grace begin to pal around with a photographer and an art gallery manager.

programme.title: Tea and a Total Lack of Sympathy
programme.desc: Will has until Friday to find a new client or lose his job; Jack and Grace try to get on their favorite TV show.

programme.title: Seeds of Discontent
programme.desc: Grace (Debra Messing) is upset when Will's (Eric McCormack) best friend (guest star Megyn Price) from high school wants him to be the father of her baby.

programme.title: He's Come Undone
programme.desc: Will suffers from strange dreams when he learns that Grace is dating his therapist; Jack and Karen argue about the treatment of Rosario.

programme.title: Oh Dad, Poor Dad, He's Kept Me in the Closet and I'm Feeling So Sad
programme.desc: Will's father (Sydney Pollack) dissuades him from attending a company banquet because he has told people that Will is married to Grace.

programme.title: Acting Out
programme.desc: When a kiss between two gay men scheduled to air on TV doesn't happen, Will and Jack go to the network to complain and have an unexpected meeting with the "Today" show's Al Roker.

programme.title: Advise and Resent
programme.desc: Will (Eric McCormack) gets advice from Jack (Sean Hayes) on how to handle a blind date arranged by his boss (guest star Gregory Hines).

programme.title: Hey La, Hey La, My Ex-Boyfriend's Back
programme.desc: Will's (Eric McCormack) former boyfriend (guest star Chris Potter) is back in town and may want to rekindle their relationship. With Debra Messing.

programme.title: The Hospital Show
programme.desc: After Karen's husband suffers a heart attack, there is speculation on whom she will turn to for support.

programme.title: Sweet and Sour Charity
programme.desc: Grace (Debra Messing) backs out of a charity commitment after she has already convinced Will (Eric McCormack) to participate.

programme.title: JDM Toyota Chaser Goes From Big-Body Drifter to Quarter-Mile Dragger
programme.desc: The boys score a Japanese-spec, right-hand-drive 1997 Toyota Chaser; it's the perfect recipe for a sideways, big-body drift car, but Nads and Amir want to go in a different direction: straight down the drag strip.

programme.title: Classing Things Up With a Japanese-Inspired 2005 Lexus LS 430 VIP
programme.desc: VIP cars include rare body kits, oversized wheels and slammed ride heights; the boys try to build something that's true to the roots of the space and make it to an exclusive VIP party reveal.

programme.title: Giving Our JDM Toyota Chaser a Big Turbo in Pursuit of Big Time Slips
programme.desc: Our quest to transform a drift car into an all-out drag car continues.

programme.title: Amir's Lotus Elise Is Also Our First EURO Complete With a JDM Twist
programme.desc: Amir's Elise has been a long-standing dream, but now that he has it, the boys can't leave well enough alone; Honda's Civic Type R engine makes for a perfect swap.

programme.title: The Blue Ridge Buckin' Bronco
programme.desc: Tommy Pike and his crew are no strangers to working on off-road vehicles, so when a client drops off a '74 Bronco, it's game on; they transform this Bronco by dropping a giant engine into a new body, with fresh paint and a fully re-designed interior.

programme.title: The Monster Carlo
programme.desc: Tommy and his best friend take a ride back to the '80s; the shop crew transforms a bone-stock 1986 Monte Carlo SS into a LT4 "Monster Carlo" mega machine.

programme.title: Top Secret Impala
programme.desc: Tommy's dear friend and father figure Kenny sold his 1960 Chevy Impala when he started a family, and has wanted it back ever since; Tommy finds one and plans to restore it, but keeping the secret is more of a challenge than the team ever imagined.

programme.title: I Love It
programme.desc: Tommy and his team continue the secret '60 Chevy Impala restoration; they revitalize the machine with a new suspension, rebuilt engine and a stunning interior, before reuniting Tommy's father figure with the car of his dreams.

programme.title: Corn-fed '55 Chevy
programme.desc: Tommy Pike and his team restore and modernize a 1955 heirloom Chevy truck.

programme.title: Lambo Livin'
programme.desc: Tommy and his team up the ante by working on a cutting-edge Lamborghini Huracán; the crew feels excited about their supercar project, before realizing what a tricky project they've taken on.

programme.title: Mr. B's Controversial Corvette
programme.desc: One of the shop's best customers has a big request; now Tommy and the crew need to finish up a one-of-a-kind '54 Chevy Corvette build before a big local car show.

programme.title: Beast of the Southeast
programme.desc: A client brings Tommy his '73 Chevy Vega for a nostalgic restoration; the team has to roll up their sleeves and uncover all the issues on this half-baked restomod.

programme.title: Safari Style
programme.desc: Tommy and the crew pay homage to the '71 East African Safari Rally winner by transforming a brand-new Nissan Z into an era-specific ride that needs to be ready for a SEMA debut.

programme.title: Abandoned Chevy C10
programme.desc: Tommy and the crew find a partially restored '60 Chevy C10 pick up that's been abandoned at the end of the build process and decide to bring it back to life.

programme.title: '67 'Vette Retro Racer
programme.desc: A Corvette aficionado trusts Tommy to put his spin on a classic '67 Chevy Corvette and go full-tilt bozo on the machine; the crew must pull out all the stops to reimagine the car from the ground up.

programme.title: '67 Vette Hits the Track
programme.desc: While the team continues putting their own spin on a classic '67 resto-modded Chevy Corvette, Tommy recruits his buddy Dewayne to get the interior in tip-top shape.

programme.desc: Something lurking in a 1952 Pontiac threatens the entire build.

programme.title: Poor

programme.title: Birth

programme.title: The Black Wolf
programme.desc: Xena comes to the aid of imprisoned freedom fighters who refuse to reveal the identity of their mysterious leader.

programme.title: Beware Greeks Bearing Gifts
programme.desc: Xena joins the climactic battle between the warring Greeks and Trojans that is precipitated by the false peace offering of the Trojan horse.

programme.title: Athens City Academy of the Performing Bards
programme.desc: Gabrielle cons her way into a prestigious storytelling competition and ends up helping a fellow bard who is under pressure from his father to win.

programme.title: A Fistful of Dinars
programme.desc: A hidden key to a chamber containing Ambrosia, which turns mortals into gods, will fall into the wrong hands if Xena does not find it first.

programme.title: Warrior...princess
programme.desc: Xena trades identities with a look-alike princess in order to defeat the young woman's would-be assassins. Features Lucy Lawless in a dual role.

programme.title: Mortal Beloved
programme.desc: Xena crosses the river Styx to the Underworld to help her deceased lover stop a madman from destroying the heavenly Elysian Fields.

programme.title: The Royal Couple of Thieves
programme.desc: Xena forces a renowned thief to assist her in an elaborate scheme to recover a powerful weapon from a warlord.

programme.title: The Prodigal
programme.desc: Gabrielle takes on the role of leader when she returns home and finds her village ill-prepared to defend itself from a band of marauders.

programme.title: Altared States
programme.desc: A boy will die in a sacrificial killing unless Xena can stop his jealous older brother.

programme.title: Ties That Bind
programme.desc: As the god Ares schemes to make Xena lead his army, the warrior princess meets a man claiming to be her long-lost father.

programme.title: The Greater Good
programme.desc: Gabrielle assumes Xena's identity after the warrior princess is injured during a skirmish with a warlord bent on destroying Salmoneus.

programme.title: Callisto
programme.desc: The female warrior Callisto tries to turn the world against Xena by committing acts of terrorism in her name.

programme.title: Death Mask
programme.desc: After learning a raiding party's leader was responsible for the destruction in their village, Xena and her brother set out to destroy him.

programme.title: Is There A Doctor in the House?
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle run a makeshift hospital for war casualties and attempt to convince a general that the bloody conflict should end.

programme.title: Orphan of War
programme.desc: Xena's deepest secret is revealed when she and Gabrielle join forces with the Centaurs to battle the evil warlord, Dagnine (Mark Ferguson).

programme.title: Remember Nothing
programme.desc: The three Fates give Xena the chance to recreate her life when she agrees to give up her warrior ways.

programme.title: The Giant Killer
programme.desc: Xena must face her old friend Goliath (Todd Rippon) in battle when the giant refuses to turn his back on the ruthless Philistines.

programme.title: Girls Just Wanna Have Fun
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle join forces with Joxer (Ted Raimi) and Orpheus (Matthew Chamberlain) to defeat the evil god Bacchus (Anthony Ray Parker), who is transforming innocent girls into deadly monsters.

programme.title: The Return of Callisto
programme.desc: When the fierce woman warrior Callisto (Hudson Leick) escapes from prison, Xena must face her in battle once again.

programme.title: Warrior..Princess..Tramp
programme.desc: Xena must foil an attempt to dethrone her friend and look-alike, Princess Diana, by the unscrupulous Meg, who bears a startling resemblance to both.

programme.title: Intimate Stranger
programme.desc: With the help of Ares (Kevin Smith) in the Underworld, Callisto (Hudson Leick) switches bodies with Xena and returns to the land of the living where the two women warriors battle once more, this time disguised as each other.

programme.title: Ten Little Warlords
programme.desc: While still trapped in the body of her enemy, Callisto, Xena is forced to enter a competition where warlords vie to become the new god of war.

programme.title: A Solstice Carol
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle try to bring the warmth of the holiday season to a cold-hearted king (Peter Vere Jones) who has outlawed the Winter Solstice celebration.

programme.title: The Xena Scrolls
programme.desc: In 1940, two archaeologists look for the legendary scrolls that Gabrielle wrote about her adventures with Xena.

programme.title: Here She Comes...Miss Amphipolis
programme.desc: Xena masquerades as a beauty pageant contestant to stop a saboteur, who is bent on destroying a peace treaty between three warlords.

programme.title: Destiny
programme.desc: After being critically injured in a fight, Xena lets her mind flash back to the time that Julius Caesar (Karl Urban) taught her a valuable lesson about destiny.

programme.title: The Quest
programme.desc: Gabrielle's attempt to take Xena's body to be buried with her brother are complicated by would-be thieves, Amazon dynasty squabbles, and Xena attempts to communicate through Autolycus.

programme.title: A Necessary Evil
programme.desc: In order to stop the evil Velasca (Melinda Clarke) from hunting down Gabrielle, Xena must unleash an even more depraved immortal to vanquish her---Callisto (Hudson Leick).

programme.title: A Day In The Life
programme.desc: Xena (Lucy Lawless) has 24 hours to prevent a warlord from plundering one village, and the world's biggest giant from destroying another.

programme.title: For Him The Bell Tolls
programme.desc: While engaged in a battle of wills with her son, Cupid, Aphrodite (Alexandra Tydings) turns Joxer into a dashing hero tasked with stealing a princess's heart away from her betrothed.

programme.title: The Execution
programme.desc: When Meleager, the hero who once saved Gabrielle's village, is condemned for murder, Gabrielle and Xena have only one turn of the sand dial to produce evidence that he is innocent.

programme.title: Blind Faith
programme.desc: A warrior (Jeremy Callaghan) wants to make his name by killing Xena. He fails, but he succeeds in putting the warrior princess in a blind rage when he kidnaps Gabrielle and sells her to agents of a king.

programme.title: Ulysses
programme.desc: Xena and Gabrielle chance upon King Ulysses on his way home to Ithaca from Troy, and when they see that Poseidon doesn't want him to get there, they do everything they can to make sure that he does.

programme.title: The Price
programme.desc: Xena reverts to her old ways to whip a dispirited Athenian army into shape to take on a foe known as the Horde.

programme.title: Lost Mariner
programme.desc: After a shipwreck, Gabrielle is rescued by the cursed ship of Cecrops, where she will have to stay until she dies -- unless Xena can break the curse.

programme.title: A Comedy of Eros
programme.desc: The baby of Cupid & Psyche, on the loose with Daddy's love-causing bow, complicates Xena's attempt to stop Draco from attacking a temple of Hestian virgins.

programme.title: The Furies
programme.desc: When the Furies find out that Xena never avenged the death of her father, they curse her with persecution and madness until she completes her task.

programme.title: Been There, Done That
programme.desc: The exact same day continues to start over and over again and only Xena can unravel the mystery.

programme.title: The Dirty Half Dozen
programme.desc: Xena enlists the help of four notorious criminals to steal back the secret to an impenetrable metal that Ares is using to win wars.

programme.title: The Deliverer
programme.desc: When Xena goes to help an old foe in a battle against Caesar, she ends up rescuing Gabrielle from the evil talons of Dahak, the 'One God.'

programme.title: Gabrielle's Hope
programme.desc: When Gabrielle is mysteriously impregnated, Xena must fight in a battle between the warriors and the Banshees to determine if the child is evil or good.

programme.title: The Debt
programme.desc: When Xena is given a cryptic message about a Green Dragon, she heads to the Kingdom of Chin to kill him.

programme.title: The Debt II
programme.desc: While awaiting execution for attempting to kill the Ming ruler, Xena finally repays the debt she owes her spiritual mentor, Lao Ma.

programme.title: The King of Assassins

programme.title: Seven Twenty Three
programme.desc: As Don secures an account with Conrad Hilton, Sterling and Cooper try to strong-arm Don into signing a contract; Betty meets with her acquaintance from the governor's office.

programme.title: Souvenir
programme.desc: Don and Betty renew their love affair while on a business trip to Rome; Peter has a bout of infidelity with an au pair in his building while his wife is away.

programme.title: Wee Small Hours
programme.desc: Betty tries to meet with Henry Francis again; Don steps up his pursuit of his daughter's former teacher. Don disappoints Conrad Hilton and is forced by a client to fire Salvatore over an unwelcome advance.

programme.title: The Color Blue
programme.desc: As Sterling Cooper prepares for its 40th anniversary party, the bosses in London drop a bombshell to Lane; Miss Farrell's troubled brother pays a visit to her and Don; Betty stumbles onto her husband's secrets.

programme.title: The Gypsy and the Hobo
programme.desc: An old flame and potential client re-enters Roger Sterling's life; Joan's husband searches for a new job; and Don finally comes clean to Betty about his true identity.

programme.title: The Grown-Ups
programme.desc: Pete finds out that he lost the promotion to Cosgrove; Roger Sterling's daughter's wedding goes off as planned; Betty musters up the courage to respond to Don's confessions.

programme.title: Shut the Door. Have a Seat
programme.desc: With another sale on the horizon, Sterling, Cooper, and Draper convince Lane Pryce to fire them and then join them as they start up a new advertising firm; at home, Betty follows through with her plans to divorce Don.

programme.title: Public Relations
programme.desc: Roger attempts to find a girlfriend for Don; Don's secretive demeanor results in an unfavorable interview by a reporter.

programme.title: Christmas Comes but Once a Year
programme.desc: The firm reluctantly throws a Christmas party for its most important client; Don prepares for his first Christmas away from his children and makes an indiscretion.

programme.title: The Good News
programme.desc: Joan is trying to start a family with Greg, but her work schedule and his impending army commitments make things difficult; Don takes a trip to California to see Anna and meets her niece, who delivers some unsettling news.

programme.title: The Rejected
programme.desc: Pete gets some bad news and then some good news, which affects Peggy more than she can say; Allison can't keep her feelings under wraps.

programme.title: The Chrysanthemum and the Sword
programme.desc: Don and Pete try to land a new Japanese client, but Roger's racist attitude may hand the lucrative account to a rival; Don has to read deeply and think quickly to salvage things.

programme.title: Waldorf Stories
programme.desc: Don and the agency are up for an award for their Glo Coat ad; Roger reflects on how he first met Don.

programme.title: The Suitcase
programme.desc: An impending deadline leaves the firm in disarray; Don makes Peggy stay late to work on a Samsonite ad, missing a birthday dinner with her boyfriend, Mark.

programme.title: The Summer Man
programme.desc: Don attempts to regain control over his life through physical changes and journal writing; Don's persistence with Faye results in an impromptu dinner date.

programme.title: The Beautiful Girls
programme.desc: Peggy is forced to face some unpleasant facts about a client's discriminatory business practices; Don and Faye's burgeoning relationship is tested when Sally runs away from home and turns up at the office.

programme.title: Hands and Knees
programme.desc: Joan finds out she's pregnant with Roger's child and goes to have an abortion; Lane's father is displeased when Lane expresses his feelings for an African-American waitress at the local Playboy Club.

programme.title: Chinese Wall
programme.desc: When word leaks of Lucky Strike's defection to BBDO, the employees of SCDP scramble to hold onto the rest of their accounts.

programme.title: Blowing Smoke
programme.desc: Don incenses the other partners when he runs a full-page ad declaring that his firm will no longer represent tobacco companies.

programme.title: Tomorrowland
programme.desc: Surprising opportunity arises for both Don and Peggy, leaving them with some pretty big decisions to make.

programme.title: For Those Who Think Young
programme.desc: Sterling Cooper advertising agency receives some new office equipment; Don and Duck are at odds over an account; Betty reconnects with an old friend.

programme.title: Flight 1
programme.desc: Paul has a party at his apartment; Peggy visits her family; the agency pursues an account despite a conflict in interest; Duck uses an unorthodox approach with a client.

programme.title: The Benefactor
programme.desc: Trouble arises on the set of a commercial; Harry tries to gather support for a controversial sponsorship; Betty and Don try to appease a client with a friendly dinner.

programme.desc: Don has to deal with issues between a TV comedian and his wife; Joan finds Don the perfect secretary.

programme.desc: Don buys a new car; Pete, Harry and Ken strategize to attract new business; Don's secretary makes a grave error; Cooper has a new piece of art in his office.

programme.desc: Peggy contributes on a church project; Duck and Don try to create market appeal for a foreign beer brand; Harry recruits assistance to help with the workload in his department.

programme.title: Six Month Leave
programme.desc: Fred Rumsen gives a disappointing pitch; Pete exploits an opportunity; Don proves his loyalty; Betty finds a welcome distraction.

Each team's goal is to guess the results of audience survey questions. A player from each team initially faces off, answering the question to earn the chance to either pass or play. The winning family gets a chance to earn extra cash in a bonus round.

programme.title: Lost in Spain: Part 2
programme.desc: Bill, Cissy and Mr. French continue to search for Buffy and Jody in Spain. Meanwhile, the twins are being cared for at a school house run by nuns.

programme.title: Lost in Spain: Part 3
programme.desc: The twins are finally found and reunited with their family.

programme.desc: Jody has been exchanging letters with a pen-pal from Bolivia. Finally, the boy gets a chance to visit Jody in New York. When he arrives, everyone is more interested in him than Jody.

programme.title: The Flip Side
programme.desc: Cissy falls for a popular musician who writes songs about her. Love-struck Cissy decides to surprise him by going to the concert. She is the one surprised when he starts singing to another woman.

programme.desc: Mr. French is accused of sending questionable letters to a young woman. He and Bill take a stint as a detective to find the source.

programme.title: Freddie
programme.desc: Bill wants to take Freddie out to dinner, but also has to go to the twins open house at school. Bill takes Freddie to the school, and she just loves it. She starts to think she wants to have kids.

programme.title: Our Friend Stanley
programme.desc: A new family moves into the apartment building where the Davis' live. Stanley is a child with a physical disability that hinders his walking. Buffy and Jody try to be friends with him at school.

programme.title: I'd Tell You I Love You but We're Not Speaking
programme.desc: When all channels of communication break down between the Hubbards and Buells, a family-style group therapy session is conducted by Jerry's psychology professor.

programme.title: Herb's Little Helpers
programme.desc: Eve and Kaye turn Herb's office into a model of inefficiency when they take over for his sick secretary.

programme.title: Bye, Bye, Blackmailer
programme.desc: Eve and Kaye try diplomacy and artful deception to prevent a blow-up over Herb's $100 loan to Roger, which is due and which Roger can't repay.

programme.title: The Wig Story
programme.desc: Kaye borrows a blonde wig from Eve, and Roger's romantic reaction succeeds only in depressing Kaye, who's convinced that he now prefers blondes.

programme.title: It's Only Money
programme.desc: Tired of Roger's skinflint ways, Herb plots to play golf and gin rummy for money, but Herb finds himself in the financial hole when Roger's luck turns for the better.

programme.title: I Haven't Got a Secret
programme.desc: Kaye gets a game of charades under way to let everyone in on a secret that she isn't allowed to divulge: Roger's scripts are being considered for a TV series.

programme.title: Jerry's Night out with the Boys
programme.desc: The men side with Jerry's decision to play poker with the guys, so the women plan an all-girl night out for Suzie.

programme.title: The Long, Long Weekend
programme.desc: The Hubbards, Buells, and newlyweds each have secret plans for a weekend away from each other. But it backfires: They all head for the same mountain cabin, where snowstorm traps them together.

programme.title: Jealousy Makes the Heart Grow Fonder
programme.desc: Thanks to Kaye's overactive imagination, Eve suspects a rekindled romance between Herb and his old flame, who has come to visit.

programme.title: How Not to Manage a Rock Group
programme.desc: Jerry convinces his folks to put up $500 for a hippie rock group to make a demo recording. They scare off the band with talk of crew cuts, tuxedos, and old songs.

programme.title: Flower Power
programme.desc: Cissy meets some flower children in the park and wants to be one of them. Uncle Bill is none too pleased.

programme.title: My Man, the Star

programme.title: No Uncle Is an Island
programme.desc: Mr. French, Cissy, Buffy and Jody decide to give Bill some time alone for the weekend. Unfortunately, while they are away, a barrage of neighbors stop by, disrupting Bill's relaxation, peace and quiet.

programme.title: The Wings of an Angel

programme.title: Uncle Prince Charming
programme.desc: One of Cissy's friends has a crush on Uncle Bill, and he cannot shake her from this feeling.

programme.title: Cissy's Apartment
programme.desc: Cissy decides it is time to move out on her own, so she moves into an apartment with a friend. It seems like she hasn't left home when when her family constantly visits her.

programme.title: The Jody Affair
programme.desc: When playing at school, a ball thrown breaks a window and Jody is blamed. Jody denies doing it.

programme.title: With This Ring
programme.desc: Since most of Cissy's friends are getting engaged and married, Cissy decides it it is time for her and Gregg to be engaged, even if Gregg does not want it.

programme.title: What's Funny about a Broken Leg?
programme.desc: Buffy breaks her leg while playing with friends. When Uncle Bill tells her she will not be able to go to the circus, she is sad. Uncle Bill saves the day by bringing the circus act to the building.

programme.title: The Birthday Boy
programme.desc: When the twins find out that Mr French's birthday is approaching, they ask Cissy to help them set up a birthday party for Mr French.

programme.title: The Stowaway
programme.desc: The twins make friends with a boy who does not have any parents and has run away from an orphanage. They hid him in the apartment, moving him from room to room, so the others do not find him.

programme.title: Number One Boy
programme.desc: When Bill is in Hong Kong for business, he works with Ng Ho. Bill invites him to visit. When Ng Ho stays with the Davis' he starts to help around the apartment, too efficiently, and upsets Mr French.

programme.title: A Tale of Two Travels
programme.desc: Uncle Bill and Mr. French take the twins on vacation to Boston while Cissy spends her vacation time in New York. Everyone seems to be off sync as they miss each other.

programme.title: Maudie
programme.desc: A former sweetheart of French's, once a common worker, is now a wealthy single woman. She asks Mr French to visit her in England, with the hopes to pursue their relationship.

programme.title: Goodbye Harold
programme.desc: Buffy and Jody's pet hamsters seem to always escape their cage and then get out of the apartment building. The twins realize the hamsters want to be free.

programme.title: The Girl Graduate
programme.desc: Cissy graduates from high school and wants to go to an all-night party with her friends.

programme.title: Grandpa, Sir
programme.desc: Cissy, Buffy, and Jody's grandfather visits, but cannot seem to get used to the grown-up children from the young children as he remembers them. Worse, the children do not remember him.

programme.title: Marooned

programme.title: Mr. Osaki's Tree
programme.desc: Jody is giving a bonsai tree from Mr Osaki. When the tree starts to die as Mr Osaki gets sick, Jody is worried the tree means Mr Osaki will die.

programme.title: The Language of Love
programme.desc: A friend of Buffy is deaf, and Uncle Bill asks a friend of his, a doctor who specializes in deaf children, to see if he can do anything for the little girl.

programme.title: The Inheritance
programme.desc: The twins inherit a small amount of money, which to them, seems like riches. They begin to argue about how to spend the money.

programme.title: There Goes New York
programme.desc: When the twins hear a psychic predict that a tidal wave will wash away New York, nothing and no one can change their minds that this is going to happen.

programme.title: Wouldn't It Be Loverly
programme.desc: When Jody & Buffy learn a classmate can do anything he wants in his home, the twins want the same freedom. Uncle Bill and Mr. French decide to let them have what they want so they can learn.

programme.title: The Boys against the Girls

programme.title: The Old Cowhand

programme.title: Angela in the Family
programme.desc: Mr. French tries to help a friend by talking to the daughter about the life of being an actress. His efforts are negated when Bill finds the daughter an acting position.

programme.title: Family in Paradise: Part 1
programme.desc: Bill takes the family and Mr French to Tahiti for a vacation. Everyone enjoys the place.

programme.title: Family in Paradise: Part 2
programme.desc: Uncle Bill considers having everyone stay in Tahiti and live there.

programme.title: The Good Neighbors
programme.desc: Buffy & Jody notice that while they know a lot of the tenants in the building, most of them do not know each other. They ask Mr. French to help them throw a party for everyone.

programme.title: Desert Isle: Manhattan Style
programme.desc: Cissy is babysit the twins, when her boyfriend calls and asks her to go on a trip. She calls someone else to take her place and leaves. The replacement does not get there because of a blizzard.

programme.title: Eastward Ho
programme.desc: Bill offers to let Ming Lee stay at his place. Ming Lee is engaged in an arranged marriage to Bill's friend Eng Ho. Cissy and Gregg take Ming Lee out. She meets someone and refuses to marry Eng Ho.

programme.title: Meet Emily
programme.desc: Bill decides to hire a female employee to help around the house and soften the edges of Mr. French's stiffness. It takes a while, but soon the whole family enjoys having Emily around.

programme.title: Somebody Upstairs
programme.desc: Someone new moves into the apartment building where the Davis' live, and it is a Broadway star. Buffy and Jody can't keep their eyes off her.

programme.title: Star Dust
programme.desc: Bill goes to a party where there are famous people. He meets Carol Haven, a movie star. She takes an interest in Bill and they start dating. He considers proposing marriage.

programme.title: On Again, Off Again, Lohengrin
programme.desc: The bickering Hubbards and Buells are stunned when their kids return from a night out announcing they're engaged. After arguments about the wedding plans are finally settled.

programme.title: Everybody Goes on a Honeymoon
programme.desc: The Hubbards and the Buells show up at the same resort, and when their honeymooning kids unexpectedly arrive, rained out at their original destination, the in-laws spend a sleepless night together.

programme.title: All Fall Down
programme.desc: Eve and Kaye break their legs skiing and are bedridden in the same room.

programme.title: A Night to Forget
programme.desc: Going to a store to return a duplicate wedding gift for the kids, the mothers are unknowingly getting locked in the store when it closes.

programme.title: The Newlyweds Move In
programme.desc: Checking out the place that the kids have rented, the mothers return their deposit and fix up the Hubbards' garage apartment. Their snooping gets them caught hiding in the kids' shower.

programme.title: The Career Girls
programme.desc: To cut down on their wives' meddling, Herb and Roger suggest that they get jobs. Realizing that all their "suggesting, recommending, and advising" might just be too much, they decide to try it.

programme.title: Who's Afraid of Elizabeth Taylor?
programme.desc: When Roger and Herb admit that they would date Liz Taylor if given the chance, their wives console each other at the Buell house, leaving their befuddled husbands to go it alone next door.

programme.title: My Son, the Actor
programme.desc: Jerry decides to major in dramatic arts, giving everyone the showbiz bug. Suzie and all four parents tune up to help him audition for the school musical.

programme.title: How Do You Moonlight a Meatball?
programme.desc: When the kids in a financial bind, Eve and Kaye decide to help pay off Suzie's ring by selling Kaye's famous spaghetti and meatballs on the college campus.

programme.title: I Thought He'd Never Leave
programme.desc: A fugitive bank robber holds everyone at gunpoint at the Hubbards' home, whiling away the time playing gin rummy, and everyone hopes that Kaye's newly acquired karate skills will help.

programme.title: The Return of Maudie
programme.desc: A former friend of Mr. French's visits.

programme.title: It Can't Be Five Years
programme.desc: Cissy, Jody and Buffy talk about when they first came to live with their Uncle Bill and realize it has been five years. They decide to throw a party but Bill almost misses it due to work.

programme.title: Travels with Cissy
programme.desc: Love goes awry when Bill tries to stop Cissy from marrying Gregg. Bill takes Cissy to a party to distract her. Cissy meets a man named Steve and realizes she is not in love with Gregg.

programme.title: Stamp of Approval
programme.desc: Bill and Jody try to get on the good side of female friends in order to get something they want. Bill wants a job at her company, and Jody wants a stamp for his collection.

programme.title: And Baby Makes Eight
programme.desc: Cissy's friend Kathy is pregnant, and her husband is out of town.

programme.title: Say Uncle
programme.desc: Jody and a classmate taunt each other with claims of "my father can beat your father," but the parents refuse to fight each other.

programme.title: Class Clown
programme.desc: Laughter is the best medicine but not for every date. Bill goes out with a female comedian who seems to always be performing her act.

programme.title: The Unsinkable Mr. French
programme.desc: Everything at the Davis' place seems to be in a state of chaos, but Mr. French manages to keep things under control. That is, until one more thing goes wrong.

programme.title: Wish You Were Here
programme.desc: The family goes on vacation to Indiana, where Cissy, Buffy, and Jody grew up. Bill wants them to touch base with the relatives still living there and to see their hometown.

programme.title: Feat of Clay
programme.desc: Buffy and Jody accidentally break a small statue originally from Columbia and try to fix it before Uncle Bill finds out about it.

programme.title: Heroes Are Born
programme.desc: Jody's newest hero figure is a football superstar who is Uncle Ken to one of Jody's friend. When Jody finds out that Ken is suspended from the team for placing bets, Jody is disillusioned.

programme.title: Nobody Here But Us Uncles
programme.desc: The twins play matchmaker for Uncle Bill so he has someone in his life when they get older and move out.

programme.title: Too Late, Too Soon
programme.desc: Emily Turner plays matchmaker to Mr French and Miss Faversham, while being the match-breaker for her son Jim Turner and Cissy's relationship.

programme.title: The Littlest Exile
programme.desc: Buffy & Jody make a new friend with Johnnie. Johnnie and his mother are hiding from militants who are interested in finding their father.

programme.title: Put Your Dreams Away
programme.desc: Russ Brook is a former friend of Cissy's who is now in the Peace Corps. Russ asks Cissy to join him on a mission to Chile.

programme.title: The Joiners
programme.desc: Buffy wants to join a popular group at school, but the group does not think she is right for them.

programme.title: Cinder-Emily
programme.desc: Jody and Buffy decide to help Emily go to her son Jim's graduation celebration. She wants a new outfit and someone to take her.

programme.title: Goodbye, Mrs. Beasley
programme.desc: One of Buffy's friends tells her it is time to give up her doll, Mrs. Beasley, as it is a child's toy. They go to a toy store where the owner looks like Mrs. Beasley.

programme.title: Buffy's Fair Lady
programme.desc: Buffy helps a shy friend meet new friends. Buffy throws a party for Angela and friends, but she experiences some unexpected results.

programme.title: You Can't Fight City Hall
programme.desc: Buffy, Jody, and their friend Ricky find a great place to play in the neighborhood. Then they find out a parking lot is going to be built in the space.

programme.title: Buffy
programme.desc: Bill Davis is ambivalent about taking on the responsibility of raising his niece Buffy after the death of his brother. After suggesting she attend boarding school in Switzerland, she runs away.

programme.title: Jody and Cissy
programme.desc: Jody, Buffy's twin brother, and Cissy arrive while Bill is away. When he returns, he must make a decision as to what to do that would be best for the children.

programme.title: The Gift Horse
programme.desc: When Bill returns from Africa bearing gifts, Cissy presents him with a hand-knitted tie. Buffy and Jody also want to give Bill a gift, and purchase a horse for him from a retiring carriage driver.

programme.title: The Matter of School
programme.desc: Bill decides to send Cissy to a private girls' school in Connecticut, and even though she would prefer to attend high school locally, she reluctantly agrees to go.

programme.title: The Train
programme.desc: Screen greats Burt Lancaster, Paul Scofield and Jeanne Moreau star in this suspense-laden tale of justice and retribution as a French Resistance fighter (Lancaster) attempts to stop a Nazi commander from looting the art treasures of Paris.

programme.title: Run Silent, Run Deep
programme.desc: The legendary Clark Gable and Burt Lancaster star in this gripping, classic military drama aboard a submarine.

programme.title: Pork Chop Hill
programme.desc: As the Korean War rages, Lieutenant Joe Clemons (Gregory Peck) finds himself standing at a crossroad.

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: An Army Major discovers a devious plot by a cabal of enemy leaders bent on political upheaval

programme.title: No Way Out
programme.desc: Kevin Costner and Gene Hackman star in this taut, political thriller that sees Costner, as Naval Commander Tom Farrell, on the hunt for a very real killer and a very unreal Russian mole, and all the clues lead back to himself. Sean Young co-stars.

programme.title: The Package
programme.desc: Gene Hackman and Tommy Lee Jones headline this explosive action-thriller about Green Beret (Hackman) who uncovers a terrifying military conspiracy when he is tasked with escorting a U.S. soldier (Jones) back to the States for a court martial.

programme.title: Death Wish II
programme.desc: Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is no victim: He fights back - with a vengeance! After beginning a new life in L.A., Kersey's daughter is viciously assaulted. Now, he won't rest until he tracks the assailants down...and puts them all in the ground!

programme.title: Death Wish 3
programme.desc: A battle-weary Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) longs to leave his fighting days behind him. But when he arrives in New York to visit a friend and finds him brutally attacked, the silent avenger must wage war again in this no-holds-barred thriller!

programme.title: Death Wish 4: The Crackdown
programme.desc: Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) is on a mission to take down the L.A. drug trade after his girlfriend's teenage daughter tragically dies of an overdose. He's armed and dangerous...and mad as hell in this take-no-prisoners, pulse-pounding thriller.

programme.title: Death Wish V: The Face Of Death
programme.desc: Former vigilante Paul Kersey (Charles Bronson) has moved back to New York and is leading a quiet life. But when his beautiful fiancee (Lesley-Anne Down) is killed, once again upholding the law becomes his way of life...and this time it's for good!

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: In this nail-biting action film, when an aging hitman (Charles Bronson) takes on an eager apprentice (Jan-Michael Vincent) they become an unmatchable team of killers...until the pupil's ruthlessness puts the two on a deadly collision course!

programme.title: Mr. Majestyk
programme.desc: Cinema tough guy Charles Bronson stars as Majestyk, an ex-con and Vietnam vet, whose efforts to run a farm are thwarted by narrow-minded locals and corrupt cops. But when a Mafia hitman destroys his crop, the farmer's fuse is finally blown.

programme.title: Over The Top
programme.desc: A championship title, a huge cash award, and his son's love -- the greatest prize of all -- are at stake when Lincoln Hawk battles his strongest enemy for everything he has ever wanted. Sylvester Stallone stars in this powerful and exciting film!

programme.title: Walking Tall: The Payback
programme.desc: In this action-packed sequel, Kevin Sorbo discovers the quiet town he grew up in is now overrun by a violent gang. And it's up to him to take it back!

programme.title: Hercules (2014)
programme.desc: Dwayne Johnson stars as the most towering myth of all time, revealing the man behind the legend in this bold reimaging of the famed Hercules!

programme.title: Red Dawn
programme.desc: The invasion has begun! Patrick Swayze, C. Thomas Howell, Lea Thompson and Charlie Sheen wage unremitting guerilla warfare in defense of their parents, their friends, their town and their country when Communist invaders storm their hometown.

programme.title: Navy Seals
programme.desc: Charlie Sheen, Michael Biehn and Bill Paxton are three of America's finest Navy commandos. Sent to rescue the crew of a U.S. aircraft carrying Stinger missiles seized by Mideast terrorists, they're thrust onto the frontline of an explosive conflict!

programme.title: The Delta Force
programme.desc: Political extremists have taken innocent people hostage...and only super-soldiers Chuck Norris, Lee Marvin and The Delta Force can rescue them in this explosive adventure filled with wall-to-wall action! Martin Balsam and Shelley Winters also star.

programme.title: Delta Force 2: The Colombian Connection
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is in peak form in this explosive action/adventure that brings back one of his most unforgettable characters, Delta Force Colonel Scott McCoy, for a daring mission to destroy a deadly drug cartel led by the ruthless Billy Drago!

programme.title: Breaker! Breaker!
programme.desc: Breaker! Breaker! stars Chuck Norris at his butt-kicking best as a trucker on a mission to locate his kidnapped brother and bring down a corrupt Judge (George Murdock) who may just have played a role in the disappearance.

programme.title: The Octagon
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is back in this action-packed martial arts showcase co-starring the legendary Lee Van Cleef. Norris takes on his adoptive brother and a training camp where terrorists are being taught the secret killing techniques of the ninja!

programme.title: Missing In Action
programme.desc: American servicemen are still being held captive in Vietnam - and it's up to one man to bring them home in this blistering, fast-paced action/adventure starring martial arts superstar Chuck Norris.

programme.title: Missing In Action 2: The Beginning
programme.desc: Chuck Norris returns as James Braddock in this action-packed prequel to the original hit film. As war rages in Vietnam, Braddock and his men are captured and imprisoned. With fists and sheer courage, he must become an army of one to save his men.

programme.title: Braddock: Missing In Action III
programme.desc: When Colonel James Braddock (Chuck Norris, "Missing in Action") is told that his wife and 12-year-old son are still alive in Communist Vietnam, he mounts a one-man assault to free them...armed with the latest high-tech firepower, of course!

programme.title: Firewalker
programme.desc: Two hapless soldiers of misfortune (Chuck Norris, Louis Gossett Jr.) meet a beautiful girl (Melody Anderson) with a map to a lost gold mine and decide to have one last shot at striking it rich. But the trail to the treasure is no yellow brick road!

programme.title: Lone Wolf Mcquade
programme.desc: Chuck Norris is Lone Wolf McQuade, a Texas Ranger feared by outlaws and respected by other lawmen. When McQuade uncovers a gun smuggling operation, the action explodes, with McQuade wreaking havoc on all those who come between him and the law.
