programme.title: Albert Schweitzer
programme.desc: For generations the name Albert Schweitzer has been synonymous with hands-on compassion and the power of Christ-like sacrifice. Now director Gavin Miller presents a landmark drama about the legendary Christian medical missionary.

programme.title: Dalton Trumbo's: Johnny Got His Gun
programme.desc: Go inside the mind of a soldier, trapped in a severely wounded body, as he struggles to separate his thoughts & memories from the world around him. Filmed in the style of Lars von Trier's Dogville, Ben McKenzie "gives a bravura thespian workout"-Variety.

programme.title: Fakin' Da Funk
programme.desc: A Chinese baby boy is adopted by a black couple in ATL. Seventeen years later he moves with his mom and brother to a black LA hood. A Chinese girl ends up in the same hood for the summer with a black family. Will they fit in?

programme.title: The Last Laugh
programme.desc: Outrageously funny and thought-provoking, THE LAST LAUGH upends comedy's ultimate taboo by asking legends like Mel Brooks if you can joke about the Holocaust, and what else-9/11, AIDS, racism-is off-limits in a society that prizes free speech.

programme.title: A New Year's Ride
programme.desc: Two years after "The Christmas Ride," Georgia is back on the road to get some cash on New Years Eve. When an old flame turns up in her car, Georgia is faced with choices, emotions, and self doubt. What's next for her new year?

programme.title: Meteor
programme.desc: In this disaster movie, Americans and Soviets must put aside their differences to save civilization from a huge meteor bearing down on the planet. Paul Bradley (Sean Connery) enlists the expertise of fellow scientist Alexei Dubov (Brian Keith), who is joined by his beautiful assistant, Tatiana Donskaya (Natalie Wood). Although Paul and Tatiana are attracted to each other, they wisely focus on taking out the meteor, which may still cause massive destruction even if it is partially damaged.

programme.title: Exegesis Lovecraft
programme.desc: A documentary following a filmmaker as he traces the life of H.P. Lovecraft, from woodland cemeteries in Rhode Island to the docks of New York and the streets of Quebec City. A film that proves that the truth is weirder than fiction.

programme.title: Upstairs Inferno
programme.desc: For over 40 years, the 1973 New Orleans gay bar arson was considered the "Largest Gay Mass Murder in US History." Featuring heart-wrenching interviews with survivors, friends of victims, and witnesses, the film vividly examines the forgotten tragedy.

programme.title: An Honest Liar
programme.desc: The incredible true story of the renowned magician turned skeptic and exposer of frauds and hoaxes, James "The Amazing" Randi.

programme.title: A Rough Draft
programme.desc: A video game designer is stripped of his identity and recruited by a mysterious force to be the gatekeeper of a multi-dimensional portal.

programme.title: You Never Know
programme.desc: Immersed in a world filled with crime, drugs and betrayal, a group of friends have a tough time dealing with the daily pressures of life. With the support of one another, they come up with a plan to overcome their reality.

programme.title: The Knock Knock Man
programme.desc: A group of teens dare each other to summon a mysterious figure from an old urban legend. What was supposed to be a harmless game turns deadly when one of them breaks an unspoken rule, unleashing the terrifying entity into the real world.

programme.title: Ashens and the Quest for the Gamechild
programme.desc: Ashens goes on an epic and hilarious quest to find a knockoff Gameboy with a dark past. A bona fide cult classic featuring Star Wars and Harry Potter's Warwick Davis.

programme.title: Festival of Trees
programme.desc: Jacquie's future as a designer could rest on winning the annual "Festival of Trees" competition. But coming up with the perfect design means she will have to remember what Christmas is really all about.

programme.title: Lawrence: After Arabia
programme.desc: Was a motorcycle crash an accident or attempt at assassination by the British Secret Service? "Lawrence: After Arabia" tells the story of the last years of the life of the 20th century hero, T.E. Lawrence - Lawrence of Arabia.

programme.title: A Time For Heaven
programme.desc: Inspired by the incredible true story about a tenacious nurse, who helped people that had reached the end of their lives come to terms with God and heaven, & was assigned an unexpected patient. Creator Craig McMahon of A Box of Faith & Before All Others.

programme.title: Amber Road
programme.desc: The Amber Road is a place in the digital universe where anything can be bought, sold, and traded: a place where a person can fulfill their darkest desire or unleash their deepest depravity.

programme.title: Nosferatu - A Symphony of Horror
programme.desc: Summoned to a bloodthirsty vampire's faraway castle, a young land clerk embarks on a harrowing journey into the unknown as his innocent wife falls under the spell of a terrifying shadow in her dreams.

programme.title: Southeast 67
programme.desc: Spanning 20 years, Southeast 67 follows a group of African American students from Washington, D.C. who were promised college scholarships in 1988 at the age of twelve, yet struggled with survival in a neighborhood devastated by the crack epidemic.

programme.title: Hunter
programme.desc: Lt. Ramsey Hunter's life changes when three cases hit him simultaneously: a rogue cop killer, a beautiful runaway serial killer, and his corrupt police captain blackmailing him. But only one of the cases leads him to an ending of universal truth.

programme.title: Forty Winks
programme.desc: A struggling hypnotist in New York city is blackmailed into being the world's first hypnotist hitman after a mysterious woman finds out his degree is fake.

programme.title: Asperger's Are Us
programme.desc: In this coming-of-age documentary, four friends on the Autism spectrum who have bonded through humor and performed as the comedy troupe "Asperger's Are Us" will prepare for one final, ambitious show before going their separate ways.

programme.title: The Last Laugh
programme.desc: Outrageously funny and thought-provoking, THE LAST LAUGH upends comedy's ultimate taboo by asking legends like Mel Brooks if you can joke about the Holocaust, and what else-9/11, AIDS, racism-is off-limits in a society that prizes free speech.

programme.title: Cycles
programme.desc: An apprehensive young man moves into university halls, and the sudden feeling of isolation forces him into an argument with his older brother about identity, love, and the repression of dreams.

programme.title: Betting on the Bride
programme.desc: A womanizer bets that he can get someone to accept his marriage proposal after just 30 days of dating. What he doesn't know is that the woman he targets has serious commitment issues.

programme.title: Run Robot Run!
programme.desc: Kent Weston lives in the not-too-distant future. He is more organized than a day planner and more regimented than a Marine when His goals of dating his pretty co-worker Allison are thrown into disarray with the arrival of Adam, an all-too-human robot.

programme.title: Sister
programme.desc: Sister brings the timely topic of youth and psychotropic drug prescription to the forefront with insight and grace. Reid Scott delivers a nuanced performance as the estranged brother forced into caring for his troubled adolescent sister (Grace Kaufman).

programme.title: One for the Road
programme.desc: A wife (Louise Platt) suspects her husband (John Baragrey) of cheating on her and decides to do something about it. With Georgann Johnson.

programme.title: Cream of the Jest
programme.desc: An alcoholic actor (Claude Rains) blackmails a producer (James Gregory) to get a part in a play. With Paul Picerni.

programme.title: I Killed the Count
programme.desc: An inspector (John Williams) is confused when two men (Alan Napier, Charles Cooper) confess to the murder of a count.

programme.title: A Matter of Murder
programme.desc: A thief (Telly Savalas) steals a Rolls-Royce, unaware there is a body in the trunk. With Darren McGavin.

programme.title: The Gentleman Caller
programme.desc: When a man and his wife attempt to do away with an elderly lady, they discover that she is not as senile as they had imagined.

programme.title: The Ordeal of Mrs. Snow
programme.desc: A wealthy dowager is concerned for the welfare of her niece who is married to a man beneath her notice.

programme.title: Ten Minutes From Now
programme.desc: An unsuccessful artist (Donnelly Rhodes) accused of bomb threats devises a scheme to steal artworks.

programme.title: Sign of Satan
programme.desc: An actor threatened by Satan worshipers agrees to star in a new film as long as no one knows where he goes upon leaving the studio each day.

programme.title: Who Needs an Enemy?
programme.desc: A frightened embezzler (Steven Hill) stages his own suicide with the help of his double-crossing girlfriend (Joanna Moore).

programme.title: Bed of Roses
programme.desc: Everything's coming up roses for newlyweds (Patrick O'Neal, Kathie Brown) using the garden as a graveyard for blackmailers.

programme.title: The Second Verdict
programme.desc: After winning an acquittal on a murder charge, a lawyer (Martin Landau) discovers he defended a guilty man (Frank Gorshin).

programme.title: I Killed the Count
programme.desc: A Scotland Yard inspector (John Williams) finds he has three murderers who admit to killing the same man (Anthony Dawson).

programme.title: I Killed the Count
programme.desc: A Scotland Yard inspector (John Williams) finds he has three murderers who admit to killing the same man.

programme.title: One More Mile to Go
programme.desc: A man (David Wayne) trying to dispose of his murdered wife's body is stopped by a motorcycle cop (Steve Brodie).

programme.title: Vicious Circle
programme.desc: A hit man (Dick York) is ordered to eliminate his girlfriend (Kathleen Maguire) when she threatens to expose him.

programme.title: The Three Dreams of Mr. Findlater
programme.desc: A man (John Williams) begins to have dreams about his wife's (Isobel Elsom) murder. With Barbara Baxley.

programme.title: Night the World Ended
programme.desc: A reporter's (Harold J. Stone) prank makes a wino (Russell Collins) believe the world will end at 11:45pm that night.

programme.title: Gaethje v. Cobb

programme.title: Gaethje vs. Firmino
programme.desc: In the WSOFNYC main event, undefeated lightweight kingpin Justin Gaethje defends his crown against Luiz Buscape Firmino; WSOFNYC features an unprecedented New Year's Eve world championship extravaganza at Madison Square Garden, New York.

programme.title: Gaethje v. Foster

programme.title: Gaethje v. Guillard

programme.title: Gaethje v. Lauzon

programme.title: Gaethje v. Newell

programme.title: Gaethje v. Palomino 2

programme.title: El que limpio juega, limpio se queda
programme.desc: La madre de un joven soborna al entrenador de su hijo para que no pierda su beca. El joven comienza a imitar las acciones de su madre y soborna a su maestro para obtener ganancias. Una maestra tratará de recuperar los valores dentro de la escuela.

programme.title: A mucho amor, mucho perdón
programme.desc: Julián y Diana son dos adolescentes en busca del amor que casualmente se conocen en el café "El Dicho". Pero Leonardo, el padre de Julián, tuvo otra familia, lo cual desata un gran conflicto.

programme.title: Acciones son amores, no besos y apachurrones
programme.desc: Sin pensar en que podría afectar a toda su familia, Manuel aceptará hacer ciertas cosas ilegales por amor.

programme.title: Amor viejo ni te olvido ni te dejo
programme.desc: Manuel y Sara, dos adolescentes que quieren ser novios, son de diferente clase social. Carlos y Sofía fueron novios en su juventud. Ambas parejas se enfrentan a las diferencias sociales y a la oposición de los padres.

programme.title: Ilusiones rápidas, sufrimientos largos
programme.desc: Chico y Margarita son dos niños que viven en pobreza extrema y que, por ir a buscar comida, entran a escondidas a la casa de Maca y su hija Sofía, quienes los ayudarán a tener una vida mejor.

programme.title: El hombre es como el oso: cuanto más feo, más hermoso
programme.desc: Paco es un chico de 16 años que siempre ha vivido opacado por Aldo, su hermano mayor de 18 años, quien es muy atractivo, atlético y conquistador. Cuando Fernanda llega a su escuela y se interesa en él, Paco no lo puede creer.

programme.title: Es mejor agitarse en la duda, que descansar en el error
programme.desc: Lulú tiene su primera vez con Humberto y, al ser abandonada por él, se da cuenta de que su exnovio no es el amor de su vida.

programme.title: Para hacer una casa o domar a un potro, mejor que lo haga otro
programme.desc: La vida tranquila de una familia de tres mujeres cambia cuando Rita informa a sus hijas que Ramiro, su novio, irá a vivir con ellas. El hombre es un patán que las maltrata; esto pondrá en peligro la unión que hay entre ellas.

programme.title: Andy Discovers America
programme.desc: Andy's knowledge of American history is put to the test by Opie and a new teacher.

programme.title: Aunt Bee's Medicine Man
programme.desc: Colonel Harvey, a traveling salesman, arrives at Mayberry and captivates Aunt Bee, who buys Harvey's dubious elixir and invites him for dinner. When Andy and Barney find Aunt Bee clearly drunk, they analyze Harvey's elixir.

programme.title: Rio Diablo
programme.desc: Newlywed Benjamin Taber is in town with his bride when a bank robbery goes awry, and she disappears in a chaotic shootout. Determined to find her, Benjamin seeks out the help of crusty Quentin Leech, a bounty hunter who has his own reasons for wanting to catch the outlaws. As they follow the group's trail, they receive help from several unlikely sources, including Flora Mae Pepper, the owner of a brothel that doubles as a safe haven.

programme.title: A Reason to Live, A Reason to Die
programme.desc: After surrendering Fort Holman to the Confederacy without there being a single shot fired, Col. Pembroke (James Coburn) faces public disgrace and a potential court-martial unless he's able to recapture the fort now held by the power-mad Maj. Ward (Telly Savalas). To help him on this mission, Pembroke enlists a ragtag bunch of condemned men who are promised their freedom should they survive. Despite much internal strife, the group gradually comes together in time for the assault.

programme.title: Death at Dawn
programme.desc: A member of a powerful gang murders a shopkeeper; the deputized Cartwrights sentence a murderer to hang at dawn when the leader of the gang kidnaps Ben and holds him hostage.

programme.title: The Clampetts and the Dodgers
programme.desc: Los Angeles Dodgers coach Leo Durocher finds a new pitcher in Jethro.

programme.title: Duke Becomes a Father
programme.desc: Love blooms again for Jed when Mlle. Denise returns from Paris to herald the arrival of a litter of poodles.

programme.title: The Clampetts Entertain
programme.desc: The board chairman of Drysdale's bank is determined to meet Jed Clampett, the bank's financial wizard.

programme.title: The Clampetts in Court
programme.desc: Jed acts as his own attorney when he's sued by a couple seeking $100,000 in damages for a fictitious auto accident.

programme.title: Opry Live
programme.desc: Performances from Opry members Darius Rucker, 49 Winchester and Ashley Cooke.

programme.title: Ramblin' Man
programme.desc: Two Montana cowboys (Jerry Reed, Tom Selleck) head for Nashville and help a woman (Morgan Fairchild) find her sister.

programme.title: Django

programme.desc: When a neighbor agrees to sell his property, the Cartwrights fear the loss of water rights for their cattle.

programme.title: Feet of Clay
programme.desc: The Cartwrights befriend a boy whose father has been sent to jail and whose mother has recently died.

programme.title: Dark Star
programme.desc: Little Joe falls for a girl who has been disowned by her people because they think she is a witch and, therefore, an outcast.

programme.title: Death at Dawn
programme.desc: A member of a powerful gang murders a shopkeeper; the deputized Cartwrights sentence a murderer to hang at dawn when the leader of the gang kidnaps Ben and holds him hostage.

programme.title: High Society
programme.desc: Nash and Caitlin ask Jake Cage (Steve Austin) to help identify a dangerous fugitive at a posh wedding.

programme.title: Curveball
programme.desc: Nash and the team must track down a corrupt official who plans to leave the country with $5 million in pension funds; Caitlin accidentally throws one of Nash's prized possessions through a window.

programme.title: Split Decision
programme.desc: An ex-con claims to suffer from multiple personalities when he is caught robbing banks; Nick moves to a high-class retirement home; Harvey confronts Evan about his substance abuse.

programme.title: Get Bananas
programme.desc: Nash and Joe must protect a famous chimpanzee from animal rights activists wishing to release him into the jungle; Jake Cage searches for a wanted murderer; Evan pursues a drug dealer without Nash's approval.

programme.title: Crosstalk
programme.desc: Nash tracks a paranoid, delusional man who randomly kills cell-phone users; Nash and Joe investigate the decapitation of a dummy; Joe's dreams about Caitlin interfere with his waking hours.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: Nash and the team track down a vigilante intent on bringing murderers to justice; Caitlin and Joe form a partnership to deliver doughnuts via the Internet.

programme.title: Rip Off
programme.desc: The team must track down two gangs of robbers, one of which has an informant in its ranks who is tipping off the rival one.

programme.title: Skin Trade
programme.desc: Caitlin is undercover as a madam to stop a pornography and sex-slavery ring; Nash calls Caitlin by his ex-wife's name.

programme.title: Liar's Poker
programme.desc: Nash is undercover as a favor to an FBI agent; Inger and Lucia return from Sweden; Nick's poker buddies get him in trouble.

programme.title: El Diablo
programme.desc: While Nash investigates the death of a woman who plunged off a balcony, Joe gives Evan a second chance to redeem himself.

programme.title: Hit and Run
programme.desc: Nash and Joe's client is killed when the building in which they are meeting explodes; Joe's mother-in-law and Nick fall in love.

programme.title: Cop Out
programme.desc: Nash must catch a man who dons a police uniform and terrorizes people; Nash and Caitlin must learn to get along during work; Nick wants his driver's license.

programme.title: Line of Sight
programme.desc: A drug dealer tries to corner the market by killing his competition; Evan and Cassidy discover they are being stalked when they begin dating again.

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: Nash must infiltrate a thief's base of operation in order to catch him; Joe protects a mean-spirited restaurant critic; Evan returns to the unit; Caitlin may become Nash's boss.

programme.title: Hard Cell
programme.desc: Nash must help a convict in exchange for valuable information; Joe has a hard time with a delivery boy.

programme.title: Missing Key
programme.desc: Joe is the target for murder when a woman plants a key with him; Nick performs in Cassidy's play; Harvey is involved with a complicated woman.

programme.title: Jackpot
programme.desc: A police chief is murdered, and Jake Cage (Steve Austin) returns to assist Nash in the investigation.

programme.title: Jackpot
programme.desc: Nash is undercover in Las Vegas to stop an Asian kingpin; Evan is shot in the line of duty; Cassidy goes to the police academy.

programme.title: Rock and a Hard Place
programme.desc: Soon after Nash's daughter, Cassidy, joins the Special Investigation Unit, an escaped felon convicted with tainted evidence kidnaps her and Joe.

programme.title: Jump Start
programme.desc: Nash flips when he finds out that Cassidy played a hooker to nab a South African diamond smuggler; a new investigator joins the force.

programme.title: Lap Dance
programme.desc: Nash gets more than just a favor from a former lover when trying to take down a criminal with stolen cruise-missile secrets.

programme.title: Land Pirates
programme.desc: Nash and Joe are hot on the trail of a clever ring of thieves that preys on San Francisco's elite; Nash discovers the secret behind a nun's double life.

programme.title: ManHunt
programme.desc: A drug gang knocks over a DEA evidence warehouse and proves elusive for the members of the team; Antwon has a seizure while chasing down the leader of the gang.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: Nash and Joe (Don Johnson, Cheech Marin) find out that someone has been "borrowing" the name of their detective agency. Guest stars: Jenna Lewis, Joel Klug, Sean Kenniff and Gervase Peterson of "Survivor."

programme.title: End Game
programme.desc: Nash and the others uncover a deadly game wherein the players try to assassinate each other; Nash's friend Boz Bishop is framed for murder.

programme.title: Blow Out
programme.desc: Nash and Joe track down former SIU officer Rick Bettina, who escaped during his parole hearing to recover the money he stole.

programme.title: The Messenger
programme.desc: Nash protects a newscaster from a deranged fan; Joe is caught in the middle of a crime while selling his car.

programme.title: Grave Robbers
programme.desc: Nash takes on the case of a clever con man who fakes his own death after ripping off a dangerous organized crime boss; Joe learns that his mother-in-law smokes marijuana.

programme.title: Bear Trap
programme.desc: Nash and Joe bear down on black market poachers selling animal gall bladders; the office buzzes with rumors of a romance between Nash and Rachel.

programme.title: Recover Me
programme.desc: A wealthy accounting adviser sets Rachel up for a murder, and her lack of cooperation confuses Nash until he discovers a secret from her past.

programme.title: Something Borrowed
programme.desc: Nash is flabbergasted to learn that he's legally married to Tamara Van Zant and comes to the conclusion that she's up to her old tricks again; Nick acts as a "beard" for a lesbian friend.

programme.title: Out of Miami
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Rick Hawks comes back to the Bay Area to transport a key witness in an important drug trafficking case.

programme.title: Slam Dunk!
programme.desc: Nash and Joe investigate the murder of a wealthy lawyer; Cassidy and Rachel are caught in a love triangle.

programme.title: The Partner
programme.desc: Nash and the SIU team try to stop a vigilante who is killing the criminals that are under investigation.

programme.title: Blood Bots
programme.desc: Nash tracks the ringleader of a new technical gang who built a small army of remote-controlled robots, fully equipped with heavy artillery, to pull off a string of robberies.

programme.title: Quack Fever
programme.desc: Painful memories and the dangers of the drug trade collide when Nick learns the truth about Nash's older brother Bobby, who was supposedly missing for more than 20 years.

programme.title: Kill Joy
programme.desc: The murder of a newscaster begins a string of stalkings involving women of the same name, and Harvey eventually discovers the killer's motive.

programme.title: Change Up
programme.desc: Cassidy's future in law enforcement comes under question when her and Rachel's attempts to stop a bank robbery can't prevent an executive's death.

programme.title: Cat Fight
programme.desc: Nash turns up a handful of surprises when tracking down two young women responsible for the death of a security guard during a robbery at a rock concert.

programme.title: Fair Game
programme.desc: While questioning her career in law enforcement, Cassidy steps into the wrong taxi at the wrong time when she becomes a killer cabby's fare; Rachel learns that Nash is being set up.

programme.title: Genesis
programme.desc: A San Francisco police investigator (Don Johnson) uses keen instincts, wit and charm on the job but has less success in his personal life.

programme.title: Home Invasion
programme.desc: A gang terrorizes Nash's (Don Johnson) ex-wife (Serena Scott Thomas) and daughter (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe); Joe (Cheech Marin) moves in.

programme.title: Skirt Chasers
programme.desc: A heroin dealer sets up shop in San Francisco, but his penchant for buying time with women gives Nash and his team a shot at taking him down.

programme.title: High Impact
programme.desc: Nash and Joe Dominguez try to protect the mayor when a religious fanatic takes fire and brimstone seriously and detonates bombs all over San Francisco.

programme.title: The Javelin Catcher
programme.desc: A deadly military weapon stolen by gang members leads Nash to work with a military adviser before more gang violence erupts.

programme.title: Vanishing Act
programme.desc: When a sting operation falls apart and Harvey Leek disappears with the government's money, Joe and Nash set out to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Aloha, Nash
programme.desc: Nash puts his romantic vacation with Kelly on hold to pursue the evils behind an incriminating betting book; Ian's girlfriend is taken hostage.

programme.title: Key Witness
programme.desc: Nash sets out to help Lisa, whose eyewitness account of a murder raises some eyebrows when no body can be found; Joe checks out his new investment.

programme.title: Internal Affairs
programme.desc: Nash must clear his name after being suspended following an Internal Affairs accusation that he murdered a suspect in revenge.

programme.title: Till Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: Joe is exposed to a deadly virus after a thief unwittingly releases it into the air while foraging for drugs at a chemical lab.

programme.title: The Great Escape
programme.desc: Nash's daughter, Cassidy, is kidnapped by an escaped anti-government extremist who is out to avenge his imprisonment and separation from his family.

programme.title: Wrecking Crew
programme.desc: Nash and Joe are taken hostage while attempting to nab a gang of professional thieves during a robbery.

programme.title: Trackdown

Let's see which shady looking character wins.

programme.title: SCL 2022 Season 8, Episode 3, Holland Part 2

programme.title: Stage 14 - SOUTH AFRICA - 2024

programme.title: Direct Contact
programme.desc: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given a chance at freedom if he can rescue a kidnapped woman.

programme.title: Trespass
programme.desc: Fast-talking diamond dealer Kyle Miller (Nicolas Cage) and his wife, Sarah (Nicole Kidman), live the good life in a beautiful home surrounded by thick woods. Their dream life turns into a nightmare when violent thieves, led by Elias (Ben Mendelsohn), invade their home disguised as police officers. With Kyle and Sarah now frightened captives, Kyle knows he must use every negotiating trick in his book, for once Elias and his men get what they want, the Millers will likely be killed.

programme.title: Stolen
programme.desc: A former thief frantically searches for his missing daughter, who has been kidnapped and locked in the trunk of a taxi. Starring Nicolas Cage and Malin Akerman.

programme.title: Concrete Canyons
programme.desc: In this thrilling crime drama, a sheriff searches for his son who is accused of murder and on the run from the law.

programme.title: Desert Fiends
programme.desc: Six friends on their way to a concert break down in the middle of nowhere and encounter a deranged family that lives in the desert killing anyone they come across.

programme.title: From Embers
programme.desc: After the tragic loss of her husband Ron, Lily finds herself navigating a challenging new reality with her son Kevin. As they settle into a modest apartment, Lily's encounter with their neighbor Marty brings up an unexpected revelation about Ron's suspicious death. Marty is an alcoholic and his passion for music is only surpassed by his love for his daughter Chloe. When Lily delves deeper into the mystery surrounding Ron's demise, she forms a bond with his co-worker Angela.

programme.title: Wind and Bone
programme.desc: A woman on the run joins a group of college students in rural West Virginia, where they soon encounter the Wendigo.

programme.title: Lilies Not For Me
programme.desc: In the 1920s England, a gay novelist and his psychiatric nurse form an unlikely friendship over a series of doctor-prescribed "dates." Through their conversations, he tells her the story of his relationship with an old friend which spiraled out of control when they turned to a risky procedure to cure themselves of their forbidden feelings for one another.

programme.title: Paradox Effect
programme.desc: estranged from her daughter because of a past life of drug-abuse, Karina is taking all the steps she can towards being the mother she needs to be. One night Karina hears the discharge of a muted weapon and a body breaking through heavy glass. Looking up, she locks eyes with the man who pulled the trigger and she is captured. The mastermind of it all is crime lord Silvio and his vicious gangsters who forces Karina and Covek, a deadly killer threatened by him, to go on a journey against time.

programme.title: Part I: Leaving
programme.desc: Texas Rangers and long-time ranching partners Gus McCrae and Woodrow Call meet their old friend Jake, and decide to strike out from their south Texas base and drive a cattle herd to Montana.

programme.title: Part II: On The Trail
programme.desc: McCrae and Wood's cattle drive faces deadly situations. Sheriff July Johnson heads to Texas, and former prostitute Lorena is abandoned by Jake and kidnapped by the psychotic Blue Duck.

programme.title: Part III: The Plains
programme.desc: Gus and July save Lorena from Blue Duck, but at a deadly cost. Jake runs with a bad crowd and pays the price. July accepts that his wife has left him and stays on at Clara's with his newborn son.

programme.title: Part IV: Return
programme.desc: The cattle drive reaches Nebraska, where Gus and Clara reunite. Drought and Indian attacks take their toll as the drive reaches Montana, and Gus is wounded. Call honors his best friend's request.

programme.title: Part 1
programme.desc: An all-star cast comes together to deliver a powerful adaptation of the Gospels in 1977's Jesus Of Nazareth.

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: An all-star cast comes together to deliver a powerful adaptation of the Gospels in 1977's Jesus Of Nazareth.

programme.title: Inhabitants
programme.desc: Going against the wishes of their family members, Olivia and her boyfriend, Francis, move to California for an exciting new life. However, when Francis starts to sleepwalk and experience night terrors, the couple soon discover they're being haunted by a ghost that wants to punish them for their sins.

programme.title: Great White Summer
programme.desc: From the peaks of Cape Cod's surfing waves to the murky depths below, trouble runs deep on this beloved New England seashore after the first fatal shark attack in eighty years upends the community. With the predator population on the rise, and increasing encounters placing lives and livelihoods in peril, Great White Summer chronicles a season of struggle as people demand action, priorities are questioned, personal allegiances shift, and growing suspicion clouds the waters.

programme.title: Fittest on Earth: Final Showdown in Madtown
programme.desc: A diverse group of elite male and female athletes competes for the coveted title of Fittest on Earth in the 2023 CrossFit Games.

programme.title: Stylebender
programme.desc: An intimate exploration of a bullied outsider's battle to the top of the UFC, revealing Israel Adesanya's brutal, beautiful struggle to become the global phenomenon known as 'The Last Stylebender.'

programme.title: Killer Elite [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Danny Bryce (Jason Statham), one of the world's deadliest special-ops agents, returns from self-imposed exile after his mentor, Hunter (Robert De Niro) is captured. Danny reassembles his former team of skilled commandos to launch a rescue mission, and also to infiltrate the highly feared military unit, the British Special Air Service. The mission will not be easy, for Danny and his team must cut their way through Spike (Clive Owen) and a team of assassins known as the Feather Men.

programme.title: K-19: The Widowmaker
programme.desc: Follows Captain Alexei Vostrikov who, at the height of the Cold War, is ordered to take over command of the nuclear missile submarine K-19, pride of the Soviet Navy. His assignment: Prepare the K-19 for sea and take her out on patrol -- no matter what the cost. But problems with the K-19 arise that may lead to a core meltdown and explosion that will certainly kill all aboard, and possibly trigger a nuclear war. Vostrikov must choose between his orders and the lives of his men.

programme.title: Point Break [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a string of bizarre bank robberies in Southern California, with the crooks donning masks of various former presidents, a federal agent, Johnny Utah (Keanu Reeves), infiltrates the suspected gang. But this is no ordinary group of robbers. They're surfers -- led by the charismatic Bodhi (Patrick Swayze) -- who are addicted to the rush of thievery. But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

programme.title: The Infiltrator [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1986, federal agent Robert Mazur (Bryan Cranston) goes undercover to infiltrate the trafficking network of Colombian drug kingpin Pablo Escobar. Working with fellow agents Kathy Ertz (Diane Kruger) and Emir Abreu (John Leguizamo), Mazur poses as a slick, money-laundering businessman named Bob Musella. Gaining the confidence of Roberto Alcaino (Benjamin Bratt), Escobar's top lieutenant, Mazur must navigate a vicious criminal underworld where one wrong move could cost him everything.

programme.title: Wish Upon
programme.desc: Jonathan Shannon (Ryan Phillippe) gives his 17-year-old daughter Clare (Joey King) an old music box that promises to grant its owner seven wishes. Skeptical at first, Clare becomes seduced by its dark powers when her life starts to radically improve with each wish. Everything seems perfect until she realizes that every wish she makes causes the people who are closest to her to die in violent and elaborate ways.

programme.title: Tomorrow Before After
programme.desc: In a post-apocalyptic world, a lone woman searches for survivors while coping with an unborn child growing inside her.

programme.title: Roswell Delirium
programme.desc: The story of an alternate 1980s where the U.S. is hit by a wave of nuclear attacks, and after the fallout those who remain, pretend like everything is normal even though they are all experiencing radiation poisoning. A young girl named Mayday tries to make contact on a series of ham radios with her father who is in space on a shuttle mission. Instead of making contact she receives an intergalactic distress call from space that leads her on a journey to Spacerock, the land where Area 51 once was.

programme.title: Zoombies
programme.desc: When a strange virus quickly spreads through a safari park and turns all the zoo animals undead, those left in the park must stop the creatures before they escape and zombify the whole city.

programme.title: The Terminators
programme.desc: In the near future, people utilize cyborgs for labor, but the vastly intelligent robots rebel against their masters and begin to take over human civilization through mass destruction. A small group of survivors, led by Sheriff Reed Carpenter (A Martinez), plans to stop the cyborgs, tapping inventor Kurt Ross (Jeremy London) for help. Using a space shuttle designed by Ross, Carpenter and his team head for a control center in outer space that has the power to shut down the machines.

programme.title: The Land That Time Forgot (2024)
programme.desc: Based on the Science Fiction adventure, survivors of an American military vessel sunk by a Russian sub make their way to a tropical island. As those in the sub explore the island, they realize it is full of previously thought-to-be-extinct creatures.

programme.title: Troy: The Odyssey
programme.desc: In the aftermath of the Trojan War, Odysseus must face even greater peril, battling gods and monsters as he journeys home.

programme.title: Megalodon Rising
programme.desc: When history's greatest aquatic predator returns, the armada of modern warships sent to destroy it has no chance at all.

programme.title: Monster
programme.desc: After a massive earthquake in Tokyo, two American filmmakers document the true cause of the destruction.

programme.title: Blood Lake
programme.desc: After chomping through massive fish populations, thousands of starved lampreys begin attacking the citizens of a sleepy lake town, leaving the community scrambling to stay alive.

programme.title: Housemaid
programme.desc: After his wife's consciousness is transferred into their android maid, a widower finds himself trapped in a deadly love triangle when the jealous A.I. goes to terrifying lengths to prevent him from moving on with a new woman.

programme.title: Frankenstein's Bride
programme.desc: On the day of Frankenstein's Monster and the Bride of Frankenstein's Monster's wedding, villagers riot and kill Frankenstein. The Bride escapes, vows revenge, and eventually resurrects Frankenstein's Monster, - leading a trail of blood in her wake.

programme.title: All Good Things Must Come to an End
programme.desc: Our Heroes drive through Los Angeles on their way to the mobile CDC lab. They discover the CDC lab isn't just a lab...it's a submarine! Dr. Merch welcomes our Heroes aboard and not a moment too soon as the Zeros show up hot on their heels.

programme.desc: Lil Twist's birthday party explodes into chaos when Briana and Egypt come to blows; things ignite for Angela and Bow Wow when their romantic past threatens their new business relationship.

programme.title: The Master Demand
programme.desc: Fists fly between Egypt and Briana and the battle lines are drawn; Twist and Sam go head-to-head; Romeo goes ballistic over the drama and enlists Eric to summon everyone to a sit-down; Romeo's request enrages the Simmons family.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: Grey nomads Warren and Jan are on the hunt for a four-legged companion. Mum Karen and daughter Edie meet Parmigiana, a gentle and energetic border collie.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: In Staffordshire, Inspector Charlotte Melvin comes to the aid of two Border Collies living in hazardous conditions. And that's not the only thing troubling her; because their owner is struggling to cope...

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Julian is reunited with an alpaca he delivered by C-section when she develops a mystery eye problem. A heavily pregnant ewe is rushed into the Huddersfield hospital. Peter examines his brother's terrier. Matt treats 3 marmosets.

programme.title: Baby Animals From The UK
programme.desc: The destination is the United Kingdom. Tune in to catch a bunch of feisty Polecat kits create a furry blur as they play fight, go on an adventurous ramble with some baby Red Foxes, plus get up close and personal with a charming Irish Donkey foal.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: The Trainee RSPCA Inspectors have reached the halfway point in their extraordinary year of teaching, testing and on-the-job assessment. If they make it to the end, the students will become fully-fledge Inspectors, but should they fail at any point, they'll be off the course. The group face their toughest challenge of their year so far.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Janine and her two girls are looking for a dog to join their girl squad while the Sulinom family have been waiting over 20 years to adopt a puppy.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Lanita and her two grown-up kids meet a dog with a rough backstory, mum of five Danielle wants a furry friend to keep her company and avid cyclists Jo and Jarvie are ready to join the dog club.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: New Kiwis, the Bolton family meet a cheeky puppy. Kate and Neill are ready for a new four-legged friend after a bereavement and flatmates Amanda and Rob look for a canine addition.

programme.title: Episode 1
programme.desc: It's birthing season on Jackie Barlow's alpaca farm. And after Julian turns up just in time to see one baby born, it's the cria who arrived yesterday that needs his help. Kestrel has deformed legs and he's struggling to walk, let alone run.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Julian battles to save a young cow who's prolapsed her uterus giving birth. Peter rushes to help a choking lamb and also meets Jemima - a little duck with a big attitude. Katy and Julian join forces to try to save a desperately ill, 6-month-old puppy.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Will Sweetie the sassy staffy hit the sweet spot for Hillary and Jaxson' Can senior snaggletooth George find the perfect retirement home that he has been looking for with ex-pat professional Janice'

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Peter's under extra pressure when he heads out to see Charlie the horse - he belongs to his niece Jess. She's always loved horses and rides them competitively, so Charlie needs his wolf teeth removing so they don't interfere with the bit.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Peter and Matt head to cannon hall farm, where their old friend Prince the Reindeer has antler problems. And at Skeldale Peter's also reunited with infamously feisty cockatiel Oscar, who once put a vet in hospital.

programme.title: All Farmers Great and Small
programme.desc: Julian Norton visits the young people putting everything they have into their number-one passion - farming. The programme celebrates the hard work and dedication of four young farmers, as they make their mark on the Yorkshire countryside.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Peter is tasked with castrating an over-amorous chinchilla, and devoted owner Rodney faces putting down his much-loved sheepdog, Millie. Elsewhere in the programme is a three-foot-monitor lizard that tends to bite and not let go, and a house-trained pig that is supposed to be 'micro', but in truth she is anything but.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: When two dogs are confined to one room without food or water, inspector Anthony Pulfer is straight on the scene. We follow the recovery of Snoopy, a young dog found collapsed on the edge of a road. The lurcher was just skin and bones when she was spotted. In Shropshire, inspector Kate Parker comes to the aid of Rocko, a tiny puppy living in unsuitable conditions.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Peter heads up Sutton Bank for a lambing with a view. However, there's no time to admire the surroundings because a lamb is stuck and it is too late for a C-section. Julian meets a pug with an unusual name and an unusual problem.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Julian and head nurse Sarah tend to an injured swan at a fishing lake. Meanwhile, Bobby (a canine member of the North Yorkshire police force) is brought in to the surgery to have an operation.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Julian Norton tries to save the lives of a heifer and her unborn calf, while his colleague Peter Wright also faces a dramatic labour with a Yorkshire Terrier cross

programme.title: Desert Babies
programme.desc: Today we visit some of the deserts and dry areas of the world. Coyote pups, meerkats, and baby bison are some of the animals that are featured.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Julian faces the tricky task of castrating a group of alpacas whose owner has been using holistic techniques to pacify them. Peter treats a Yorkshire Terrier and the team try to save a stray cat whose leg has been snapped in two.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: In this episode, Peter is mystified by the contents of Khufu the cat's stomach after his owner is concerned that he has totally lost his appetite. Peter performs surgery on the cat but when he opens its stomach, he gets the shock of his life!

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: In the Malawi Special, we follow Anthony and vet Riaz Rhemu as they rescue a roadside stray and go undercover to investigate the illegal puppy trade. They also help out at an open-air surgery on World Spay Day and vaccinate an astounding number of dogs against rabies.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Two brothers are worried about their cow, who is foaming at the mouth. Peter also has a daunting visit to the Greens' farm. Dusty the cat has an injury, but won't be easy to help. An animal lover finds a pigeon with a deformed leg.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Kris Walker visits a property and finds Missy, one of the most matted dogs we've ever seen on the show. Inspector Keira Benham is concerned when she finds two dogs living in hazardous conditions. Can Rex and Tyson's owner clean up her act or is it too little too late? And it's d-day for Ted. Find out if the rescue Spaniel has what it takes to become a fully-fledged police sniffer dog.

programme.title: Episode 13
programme.desc: As night falls, Matt rushes out to help a young farmer's pregnant sheep whose life is in danger. Peter treats Jean Green's trusty old rescue dog Reuben, who's couch bound with arthritis.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Following the comings and goings at the World's most famous vets - James Herriot's old practice, Skeldale Veterinary Centre in Thirsk, North Yorkshire now run by former Herriot trainee, Peter Wright and partner, Julian Norton. In this episode Julian goes head to head with Hilda the Highland Cow - battling to remove a large lump from between her horns.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: A newborn lamb is brought to the hospital after being found abandoned by the roadside. The lamb arrived in a bag for life, but Matt and David have their work cut out to save his life.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: The RSPCA are called to the aid of elderly crossbreed, Ben. In Lancashire, a couple must improve their living conditions or face losing their beloved Bichon Frise. We catch up with Molly. On Valentine's Day, Cardiologist Chris Linney tries to fix the tiny Terrier's broken heart. And see the incredible transformation of Zeus, a Dogue de Bordeaux is given a second chance.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: Peter treats two wild owls brought into his practice. Shona rushes to the aid of a horse that has trodden on a nail. Julian has to learn sign language in order to communicate with a deaf dachshund that requires surgery.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Will 3-year old Ollie and his family find a forever friend in staffy puppy Tiger? Can Frankie the pup help Simon overcome a childhood dog attack trauma? And will Jaran be Liz and Scott's first dog?

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Julian Norton is called out to examine an alpaca, new vet Helen Blackburn performs an emergency caesarean on a beagle and Peter tries to save the eyesight of Whisper the lamb.

programme.title: Episode 2
programme.desc: Single Dad Rinesh and his two girls are looking for a puppy. Newlyweds Heidi and Steve are excited to rescue a fur baby and sisters Sally and Megan met a nervous dog with a traumatic history.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Melissa is looking to begin her journey as a first-time dog owner, and carer for the elderly Jillian hopes for a furry companion who will enjoy the social side of her job.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: The Ashcroft-Schulz family are excited to adopt a rescue dog, but son Arlo is nervous. Hamilton mother of eight Jo wants a furry friend and newlyweds Hannah and Lynda meet a Swiss Shepherd.

programme.title: Forest Babies
programme.desc: Our day is taking place in the forests of the world. We see grizzly bear cubs, baby gibbons and owl chicks among the many babies featured who live in the forest.

programme.title: More Spring Babies
programme.desc: Coyote pups enjoy a romp, baby fox cubs spend time attacking mum's tail, and beavers have fun in the water.

programme.title: Episode 12
programme.desc: What do comedy icon Denise Scott, Australian Survivor champion Mark Wales and his Survivor wife Sam, and tennis legend Mark Philippoussis have in common? They're all looking for the perfect pooch.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Farmer Rob rushes into the Grace Lane practice with a struggling pregnant ewe belonging to his son, William. Julian and Anne deal with a lump on an alpaca's lip. Shona and Martin remove a tumour from a Springer Spaniel's rib-cage.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Peter heads to a local farm to try and save a sheep and her unborn lambs. A little pug has a broken leg and Julian meets Lucy the overweight llama.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: Julian rushes to a dramatic emergency at Jackie Barlow's alpaca farm, where a new mum desperately needs his help. But rural North Yorkshire isn't always the ideal place to drive when time is of the essence, and Julian gets stuck behind not one, but two tractors.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: There's a royal appointment at Cannon Hall Farm as Matt helps a goat with a broken leg in front of a high-profile onlooker - Her Royal Highness Princess Anne. Julian treats a tiny tortoise and has to check if Nigel's cows are pregnant.

programme.title: Snow Babies
programme.desc: This day takes place in some of the coldest regions on the planet. Polar bear cubs, penguin chicks, fox kits, and elk calves are among the many animals featured.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: A special episode focusing on births and babies. Julian heads to a local farm where a cow is struggling in labour. And with bringing new life into the world such a vital part of a vet's job, Julian's also hoping to assist in the birth of a career.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Peter Wright treats a pet sheep with flystrike, resulting in maggots living in its ear. The Huddersfield team perform spinal surgery on a French bulldog. Julian Norton meets pet pig Pumba that has hay netting tangled around its teeth.

programme.title: At Christmas
programme.desc: It's Christmas but life never stops at the practice! At John Swales' farm one of his prize-winning Limousins is struggling to give birth. The calf won't budge and the lives of both mum and baby are at risk. Can Peter save them both or is he too late?

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: Collette and her son Cailean are fanatical ferret fanciers and have 39 at their home! But their prize-winning, champion ferret favourite, Teddy, has a problem. They've spotted a lump and Collette fears the worst. Can Peter save Teddy?

programme.title: More Autumn Babies
programme.desc: Our day is being spent hanging around with more of autumn's babies. Goofy panda cubs, meerkats, and a show-off baby jaguar are some of the babies featuring this time.

programme.title: African Savanna Babies
programme.desc: Our day is taking us on to the vast African Savanna. With its endless grass plains, leafy acacias and tropical climate its one of the richest environments on Earth, supporting millions of animals. Among them we see featured baby elephants, lion cubs, and wildebeest calves.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: In the middle of a storm an an alpaca gave birth to a cria. Peter gets the call to see if he has more than just a chill. Julian introduces us to their rabbit Luna, but she has to learn to share as they take in a new stray Boris. In order to welcome him into the family Boris will need to be castrated.

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: When the RSPCA receives a report that a couple who are banned from keeping animals have got new dogs, Inspector Clare Wilson is quick to act. But, when she arrives at the property, it looks like the job is going to be slightly bigger than first anticipated...

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Emily hopes that bringing a dog into their home will offer a calming influence to her Neurodiverse son Jacob. And will Digger the Jack Russell prove worthy of being emotional support for young Harper?

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Julian returns to Jacki Barlow's alpaca farm to investigate a worrying lump in the mouth of one of the animals. Peter carries out dental surgery on a Yorkshire terrier and Julian examines a pygmy-goat.

programme.title: Episode 3
programme.desc: Julian heads to the historic Harewood House near Leeds to check on some goats who are moving to a new enclosure. But catching them isn't going to be easy. In fact, it proves quite painful!

programme.title: Summer Babies
programme.desc: This time we see the baby animals in the summer. Among the animals featured are tigers, orangutans, and green sea turtle hatchlings.

programme.title: Episode 4
programme.desc: A labrador needs surgery after eating the sock her puppies were playing with, and Peter must find another way to feed a foal that is unable to ingest its mother's milk. A cockatoo fights back when the vets attempt to file down its overgrown beak, two emergencies occur at the same farm in the middle of lambing season, and a newborn calf is running a fever, leaving the owners fearful of pneumonia.

programme.title: Solar
programme.desc: The sun is the biggest source of energy in the solar system; innovators search for new ways to capture more of the sun's power and make it available through the night, everywhere.

programme.title: Wind
programme.desc: Engineers race to generate vast power from thin air: the wind; one of the world's biggest wind farms is being built in harsh conditions along the coast of England; a Norwegian team works on the world's first floating wind farm.

programme.title: Aviation
programme.desc: A new breed of aviators is innovating new ways to fly from clean and green electric aircraft to autonomous sky taxis.

programme.title: Fusion
programme.desc: Exploring the quest to produce fusion -- an ultimate energy solution that has been likened to "bottling a star."

programme.title: Tidal
programme.desc: The power of the oceans' tides is the last great untapped energy source on Earth; from sub-sea kites to floating platforms, teams of engineers race to perfect the technology to harness the vast flows of water.

programme.title: Maritime
programme.desc: Shipping companies and engineers create remarkable new machines to make their industry greener, using a resource that has moved man across the world's oceans for thousands of years: wind.

programme.title: The Takeover
programme.desc: In under two centuries, favorite food brands span continents and cultures, spur innovation and technology, and forever change the food landscape.

programme.title: The Taste
programme.desc: Food preferences are influenced by dozens of factors, including genetics, environment and habit, but the taste is also about perception; the color, texture and weight of food are as important as the flavor.

programme.title: The Marketing
programme.desc: At one point, each and every food brand had to come up with a plan to get people to try them; today, the food and drink marketing industry is worth about $900 billion and growing.

programme.title: The Supply Chain
programme.desc: With every single bite or sip that people take, they participate in one of the most sophisticated journeys around the world ever taken; the global food supply chain is part of an $8 trillion network that produces over 4 billion tons of food annually.

programme.title: The Impact
programme.desc: Food brands travel around the world, stick around and change the places they visit; once the food is adopted by eager taste buds, it becomes part of local culture and tradition.

programme.title: The Future
programme.desc: Climate change, a global pandemic, and a booming world population mark an opportune time to be in the food business, not unlike the first wave of the industrial food revolution that gave people the first globally mass-produced, processed foods.

programme.title: Part Three

programme.title: Part Four
programme.desc: (4/4) When the Doctor releases two alien justice machines from prison, he gets a death sentence.

programme.title: Part Two

programme.title: Part Four

programme.title: Part One
programme.desc: (1/4) On the third moon of Delta Magna, the Doctor and Romana are soon caught up in a conflict.

programme.title: Part Two

programme.title: Part Three

programme.title: Part One
programme.desc: (1/6) The Doctor and Romana arrive on the war-torn planet of Atrios.

programme.title: Part Two

programme.title: Part Three
programme.desc: (3/6) As the Marshal prepares to launch his attack, the Doctor meets the commander of Zeos.

programme.title: Part Four
programme.desc: (4/6) With Mentalis on a countdown to destruction, the Doctor takes desperate measures.

programme.title: Part Five

programme.title: Part Six

programme.title: Part Three
programme.desc: (3/4) Davros has awoken from his centuries long slumber and is taken prisoner by the Doctor.

programme.desc: (1/4) While on holiday in Paris, the Doctor and Romana experience a time distortion.

programme.title: Part Two
programme.desc: (2/4) Scarlioni is planning to steal the Mona Lisa. Yet he has six in his cellar - all genuine.

programme.title: Part Three
programme.desc: (3/4) Count Scarlioni is really Scaroth, last of the Jagaroth.

programme.title: Part Four
programme.desc: (4/4) Scaroth intends to travel back in time to save his own people from destruction.

programme.desc: Tegan falls once more under the influence of the Mara and directs the TARDIS to the planet Manussa - but why?

programme.title: Part Two
programme.desc: As the Doctor begins to unravel the legend of the 'Great Crystal', Tegan remains under the Mara's control as it attempts to regain its hold over the planet Manussa.

programme.title: Part Three
programme.desc: Still able to influence Tegan from its 'inside world', the Mara set the TARDIS co-ordinates for Manuusa.

programme.title: Part Four
programme.desc: As the festivities begin, nothing seemingly stands between the Mara and its spectacular return... except the Doctor and a crazy old man in the mountains.

programme.title: Part One
programme.desc: (1/4) The Doctor and Romana follow a distress signal to the jungle world of Chloris.

programme.title: Part Two
programme.desc: (2/4) The Doctor escapes Adrasta by going into the mine, but there's something lurking inside.

programme.title: Part Three
programme.desc: (3/4) The Doctor makes contact with the creature and realises that all is not as it seems.

programme.title: Part Four
programme.desc: (4/4) The truth of Adrasta's scheme is revealed but a terrible retribution is already in motion.

programme.desc: (1/4) A hyperspace accident results in two ships fusing together and releasing a deadly menace.

programme.title: Part 2
programme.desc: (2/4) The Doctor and Romana discover that someone is smuggling the dangerous narcotic, Vraxoin.

programme.title: Part 3
programme.desc: (3/4) The Mandrels have escaped from the Eden projection and are attacking the passengers.

Buried under the smoldering looks, suspicions and even lines spoken in dialogue poetic couplets, there's even a murder mystery.

programme.title: It's Worth The Dirt
programme.desc: Wondering if you should give up because progress feels slow?Wisdom isn't choosing what's easiest, it's choosing what's worth it.If you're tempted to quit because it's hard, remember:God uses pressure and patience to prepare you for something greater.

programme.title: Take Your Notes On The Boat!
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick shares how remembering God's Word builds trust before answers come.

programme.title: What If I Got It Wrong?
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches you to take doubts to Jesus and trust God's purpose over your expectations.

programme.title: Filled By Faith!
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick teaches how to move forward in faith through grief, fear, and uncertainty.

programme.title: It's Hard To Hear God
programme.desc: Pastor Steven Furtick explains how to recognize, trust and obey God's voice amid noise and uncertainty.

programme.title: When God Gets Ready
programme.desc: People label, but God names. You don't have to chase identity or earn worth, because you've always been called, loved, and set apart for something more.

programme.title: When God Says Let Go
programme.desc: Is your faith being tested? If you've been waiting on the details of what God has next, remember that God doesn't give a test without a lesson first, so if He's calling you to let go of something, you can trust He's already provided you with what you'll need to take that step.

programme.title: This Might Be My God Moment
programme.desc: Are you standing over a situation that's too big for you? If you feel like your hope, logic, and options are at a dead end, pay attention because this might be your God moment.

programme.title: All Those Times You Didn't See
programme.desc: The efforts you make when no one's watching are the ones God uses to shape you. Just because you don't see the outcome yet doesn't mean He's ignoring you; He's positioning you. Keep showing up while you wait.

programme.title: All You've Got To Do Is Don't
programme.desc: We all find ourselves in seasons when we feel like we don't have what it takes, and we don't know what to do. But don't be afraid or discouraged, because God isn't late - He's working according to His timing. Don't lose hope, and don't give up.

programme.title: The God Of Pieces
programme.desc: The devil wants to keep you overwhelmed by your situation, but God wants to show you how to deal with it piece by piece. And as you learn to praise God for the piece you have, you'll experience the peace you've been praying for.

programme.title: I Thought It Was Through
programme.desc: When despair sets in, it's easy to assume it'll always be this way. But what if a shift in thinking could break that cycle? Your thoughts have the power to disrupt your despair, especially when you stop focusing on what happened and start trusting the God who never left you.

programme.title: When God Gives A Thought To You
programme.desc: We live in a world that values things more than thoughts, so when God speaks to us, we don't always value it like we should. In this message, learn some of the ways God speaks, when to ask for it, and how to recognize it when He does.

programme.title: The Hardest Part Is Behind You
programme.desc: Don't judge any one part of your life in isolation or let unmet expectations define your future. God's not finished with your story, and He didn't bring you this far to let you turn back now.

programme.title: Not As Long As My Song!
programme.desc: Hitting your limit isn't a sign of weakness; it's an invitation to shift your perspective. When the enemy brings the battle to your mind, remember that he only attacks what's valuable. And God's goodness is your secret weapon to win the fight.

programme.title: Hand Him The Plan
programme.desc: Sometimes the battle in your mind is proof that God's trying to do something great in your heart. What you see isn't the full picture of what God has for you. When you hand God your plans, you make room for His purpose.

programme.title: Sinking In The Storm
programme.desc: When you feel like you're starting to sink in the storm, call on the name of Jesus. He's near, and He won't let you go down. Don't panic and obsess over the problem, because when you sync up with Jesus, things can change just that quick.

programme.title: Delivered Daily
programme.desc: God, can You get me out of this? It's a prayer we've all prayed. But what if God's answer isn't escape, but endurance? What if His rescue comes one day at a time? This message will help you recognize God's faithful provision in every season and learn how to trust His hand as He leads you through.

programme.title: Same Lies New Loops
programme.desc: The enemy loves to trap you in the same old lies: It's not enough, and You're not loved. But God's truth breaks the cycle. When you change what you say, you change what you see, and His presence opens a new loop of peace and hope.

programme.title: This Is Then
programme.desc: Some things look stupid to the world… until God uses them to change everything. If you've been holding back because you need everything to make sense, this will call you to trust what God promised and practice gratitude in the hard place.

programme.title: War In Russia: The Siege of Leningrad
programme.desc: The siege of Leningrad began on 8 September 1941, lasting 872 days. It was one of the most destructive sieges, marked by massive casualties and systematic starvation.

programme.title: German Intelligence in WWII
programme.desc: They were the top spymasters in the Third Reich... two rivals who were shrouded in mystery and sworn to secrecy.

programme.title: Vietnam: Alpha Strike
programme.desc: American pilots fought the enemy and their own political leaders in the skies over Vietnam.

programme.title: Secret Weapons of the Third Reich
programme.desc: They were weapons systems that were far beyond anything the Allies had or could have imagined in World War II.

programme.title: The Balkans Tinderbox
programme.desc: The secret strife behind the Balkan states, from the single gunshot in Sarajevo that started World War I to the Nazi occupation in World War II.

programme.title: The Gulf War: Secrets in the Sand
programme.desc: An investigation into the clandestine operations by British S.A.S. Commandos and U.S. Special Forces during the Gulf War.

programme.title: Prisoners of War, Part Three - Code of Conduct
programme.desc: From brainwashing in Korea to courageous acts of heroism in Vietnam and the Gulf War, a unique examination of POWs, their families, and their secrets.

programme.title: Field of Operations: The U-Boats
programme.desc: Explore the perilous WWII naval warfare between German U-Boats and Allied forces, with over 100,000 lives lost.

programme.title: Field of Operations: Manchuria
programme.desc: The Soviet invasion of Manchuria on 9 August 1945 was the largest campaign of the 1945 Soviet-Japanese War, resuming hostilities between the USSR and Japan.

programme.title: Field of Operations: The War in the Mediterranean
programme.desc: On June 10, 1940, Mussolini declared war on France and Britain, leading to battles in the Mediterranean.

programme.title: Field of Operations: The Battle of Arnhem
programme.desc: The incredible story of one of the most radical ideas of the entire second world war. Operation Market Garden was the plan that caused over 10,000 paratroops to be whittled down to just 2000.

programme.title: News of War: 1943
programme.desc: Military camera operators capture the raw reality of World War II, revealing heroic victories, battles, and daily life.

programme.title: Guadalcanal: Invasion in the Pacific
programme.desc: In 1942, the Battle of Guadalcanal was a key Allied victory, halting Japanese expansion in the Pacific.

programme.title: Russia at War: Objective Balkans WWII
programme.desc: Hitler's campaign against the U.S.S.R. was initially set for 1943 but moved to 1941 due to British resistance and U.S. opposition.

programme.title: Churchill: The Road to Victory
programme.desc: Military veteran and politician Winston Churchill takes office as prime minister in 1940, then leads Britain through trying times and on to victory in World War II.

programme.title: Death from Above: Air Combat Vietnam War
programme.desc: The Vietnam War was a massive conflict, the longest in U.S. history, marked by extensive bombings and aircraft use.

programme.title: Hitler: Empire of Evil
programme.desc: Hitler's rise to power led to a brutal era in history, leaving a lasting impact on Germany and Europe.

programme.title: Surviving Hitler's Mad Doctors
programme.desc: The Nazi Regime imposed some of the most insane form of eugenics the world has seen. Between 1939 and 1945, at least 70 medical projects, involving cruel and lethal experimentation on human subjects, were conducted in concentration camps.

programme.title: Hitler's Defeat: Victory Against All Odds
programme.desc: The British people's courage and 'Keep Calm and Carry On' attitude led to victory against Hitler. Women took on essential war work, facing evacuation, bombings, and the absence of men at war.

programme.title: Space Force: The Dawn of Galactic Warfare
programme.desc: Space warfare is a major threat. Satellites are vital for society and defense. Explore humanity's space journey and the dawn of galactic warfare.

programme.title: Spies in the Sky
programme.desc: From primitive balloons to supersonic spy planes and amazingly sophisticated satellites, they are the ultimate intelligence resource.

programme.title: Mao's Secrets
programme.desc: The roots of China's conflict with Taiwan date back to the Second World War.

programme.title: Hitler's Last Days
programme.desc: Secret Nazi attempts to turn the tide of war as Berlin crumbled.

programme.title: Cold War: Inside the K.G.B.
programme.desc: Untold stories behind the headlines in the unseen cold war battles between Western intelligence agencies and the KGB.

programme.title: Psychological Warfare
programme.desc: The soldiers who employ "Psy Ops" use every means available to destroy the will of the enemy to resist.

programme.title: Cold War: Eisenhower's Operatives
programme.desc: The Supreme Allied Commander of World War Two relied on the covert arm of the CIA to an unprecedented scale during his presidency.

programme.title: 19 Years in Vietnam: Murder Mines and Mayhem
programme.desc: The Vietnam War's enemy, 'Charlie,' used guerrilla tactics, spreading terror and causing division in the U.S.

programme.title: 1933: The Fall of the Weimar Republic
programme.desc: The Weimar Republic comes to bear for many the humiliation of World War I and the blame for all its hardships; issues such as hyperinflation and the Great Depression drive many Germans into the arms of radical and extremist political parties.

programme.title: Hitler's Henchmen
programme.desc: Hitler's disturbed henchmen, driven by loyalty, committed atrocities, hiding genocide behind propaganda.

programme.title: As It Happened: Guadalcanal
programme.desc: US Marines' first Pacific War attack leads to a six-month battle against the Japanese, captured through lost photos and footage.

programme.title: 19 Years in Vietnam: Beans, Bullets and Bandaids
programme.desc: The Vietnam War was a costly conflict requiring strategic logistics to supply soldiers with essentials like "beans, bullets, and bandaids."

programme.title: Ukraine 2022: Attack on Freedom
programme.desc: Russia's invasion of Ukraine on February 24th, 2022, shocked the world. Despite Putin's claims, Ukraine's spirit endures. President Zelenskyy inspired resilience, and sanctions were imposed on Russia.

programme.title: Military Mayhem In Vietnam II
programme.desc: The Vietnam War was a long, costly, and divisive conflict that pitted North Vietnam against South Vietnam and its principal ally, the United States. The Vietcong, familiar with the jungle terrain, used it to their advantage, engaging in hit-and-run guerrilla warfare against inexperienced American soldiers, many of whom were young conscripts.

programme.title: Nazi Manhunt
programme.desc: The war is over, and the atrocities have been discovered. Thousands of Nazi officers attempt to flee the country, heading towards South America, believing they will find sympathy and evade justice. The allied forces, Britain, France, the United States, and Russia, all agreed to prosecute any living Nazi party officials for the crimes they had committed.

programme.title: The Korean War: No Longer Forgotten Part I
programme.desc: The Korean War, underestimated yet impactful, forced rapid military advancements amid a fierce ideological battle.

programme.title: As It Happened: Saipan
programme.desc: In June 1944, US forces landed on Saipan, marking their first step on Japanese soil. The battle was brutal, lasting three weeks. Reconnaissance photos and firsthand accounts provide unique insights.

programme.title: Führerbunker: Adolf Hitler's Final Days
programme.desc: As Germany falls in WWII, Hitler hides in the Führerbunker, abandoning his people. These are his final days.

programme.title: Aerial Assault Vietnam
programme.desc: Decades after it ended, the Vietnam War might seem like a distant memory. It was the longest war in American history and the only one from which the USA did not emerge victorious. A greater tonnage of bombs was dropped than in WWII. The war saw helicopters come into their own, transporting troops and supporting air power. For every pilot, there were dozens of support staff. The aerial bombardment of Vietnam remains one of the most staggering sustained attacks in history.

programme.title: Victory at Last: WWII is Over
programme.desc: Germany's defeat led to celebrations in the UK and North America. In London, crowds gathered at Buckingham Palace, where King George VI, Queen Elizabeth, and Winston Churchill appeared.

programme.title: Hitler's Best Kept Secret: The Eva Braun Tapes
programme.desc: Eva Braun, Hitler's mistress, documented life among Hitler's inner circle. The film reveals the Eva Braun tapes.

programme.title: On the Front Line: WWII Britain
programme.desc: World War II, a continuation of unresolved WWI disputes, resulted in 60 million deaths. Britain's front line efforts were pivotal in winning the war.

programme.title: Field of Operations: Balkans
programme.desc: Examining the early months of 1941 in the Balkans when Italy's offensive had stalled and a Greek counter-offensive pushed into Albania.

programme.title: D-Day Deceptions
programme.desc: It was the greatest secret of World War Two... the time and place of the D-Day invasion.

programme.title: Casillas mueve su ficha
programme.desc: Aurelio secuestra a la periodista Uzcategui, la intimida y le exige que consiga citas con los candidatos presidenciales para hacerles una propuesta. El Cabo promete cambiar.

programme.title: El Cabo vs. el presidente
programme.desc: El presidente de México, borracho y drogado, amenaza al Cabo y el colombiano advierte que si no hay resultados, la sociedad se cae. Aurelio no imagina qué le espera cuando se tope con Diana.

programme.title: Casillas se burla del régimen
programme.desc: Sorprendiéndolo con los pantalones abajo, Casillas se ríe de Valdés y le da una propinita para sacárselo de encima y compensar las bajas causadas en la Isla. Diana le miente al Chivo.

programme.title: Aurelio y Ambar, tal para cual
programme.desc: Aurelio y Ámbar son de la misma especie, hacen negocios por la adrenalina y el gozo que les produce; no por dinero. La DEA cae en la trampa de Quezada, llega al laboratorio, pero es un señuelo.

programme.title: Acorralan a Casillas
programme.desc: Quezada mantiene su mentira con alfileres, exige la complicidad de El Cabo y el silencio a la guerrilla para engañar a Casillas. Navarro felicita a Corina, pero aún desconfía de su lealtad.

programme.title: Aurelio amenaza a la guerrilla
programme.desc: En Colombia, Aurelio increpa a los guerrilleros para que le digan la verdad, luego que Corina le informa que la muerte de Quezada puede tratarse de una farsa. Javi, oculto, ve a Rutila.

programme.title: La DEA tras El Cabo
programme.desc: Castillo toma una foto de Milton Jiménez y la comparte con los jefes como parte del plan para acabar con el narcotráfico. Kashi le miente a Milena. Ámbar entrega el detonador a los terroristas.

programme.title: Aurelio llega a Cuba
programme.desc: El señor de los cielos se salta a los subalternos y exige ver al que mueve los hilos en La Habana para aclarar asuntos de producción y jerarquía en los negocios. El Cabo tiene un soplón.

programme.title: Casillas provoca al diablo
programme.desc: Aurelio deja en claro que él manda en el negocio y reta a Valdés, segundo al mando de la Revolución cubana, a que se pronuncie. Recibe silencio por respuesta. Casasola interviene para conciliar.

programme.title: El Cabo se enamora
programme.desc: Milton Jiménez queda deslumbrado con la belleza de Evelina, la prometida del Pastor Felipe, por quien se deshace en halagos y le da una jugosa limosna. Casillas huye de Cuba y arrestan a Ámbar.

programme.title: El Cabo al descubierto
programme.desc: Casillas alista una lluvia de plomazos contra el Cabo, luego de enterarse de que es el responsable de los ataques a su familia en Veracruz y otros atentados. Rutila trata de asociarse con su padre.

programme.title: Rutila se entera que Javi vive
programme.desc: Para borrar sus penas, Rutila va a la cama con El Dasa, pero luego se entera de que Superjavi no murió. El Cabo mata a El Pastor, para quedarse con Evelina. Castillo le pone el ojo a Zuleta.

programme.title: Rutila se reencuentra con Javi
programme.desc: Tras conocer la buena noticia, Rutila llora de emoción y viaja a Colombia para abrazar a Superjavi. El Cabo consuela a la viuda, Evelina. Valdés presiona a Ámbar con el oro, o va al calabozo.

programme.title: El Cabo roba terreno a Aurelio
programme.desc: Casillas descubre que el presidente protege al Cabo. Mientras, el colombiano ejecuta a sus hombres y le roba espacios al Señor de los cielos. La DEA va contra Zuleta.

programme.title: Rutila seduce a Super Javi
programme.desc: Rutila lleva a Javi a Las Minas del Coltán y deja que sus curvas y el contacto de la piel hagan más por su memoria que el sonido de las palabras. Zuleta y Omar están en complot frente a Castillo.

programme.title: Casillas mueve su ficha
programme.desc: Aurelio secuestra a la periodista Uzcategui, la intimida y le exige que consiga citas con los candidatos presidenciales para hacerles una propuesta. El Cabo promete cambiar.
