programme.desc: Sorprendiéndolo con los pantalones abajo, Casillas se ríe de Valdés y le da una propinita para sacárselo de encima y compensar las bajas causadas en la Isla. Diana le miente al Chivo.

programme.title: Javi y Rutila salvan a Kashi
programme.desc: Super Javi y Rutila se la juegan por Kashi cuando Garañón la ataca. Castillo investiga la muerte de Gilberto y conoce a Diana. Preparan la bienvenida a Valdés en México.

programme.title: Aurelio evalúa presidenciables
programme.desc: Capaz de poner y quitar presidentes a su antojo, Casillas secuestra a Begoña Morejón y pone en duda si quiere subir al poder para beneficiar a los ricos, a los pobres o a su club de amigos.

programme.title: Casillas va por la droga legal
programme.desc: Para acabar con la guerra, Casillas plantea el comercio legal de las drogas a la candidata, Morejón; pero no está dispuesta a negociar. Evelina firma, desconfiada, los papeles al Cabo.

programme.title: Ámbar debe entregarse a la DEA
programme.desc: Corina alerta a Casillas que su extradición inmediata está aprobada, así que él obliga a Ámbar a ir con la DEA y seguir sus instrucciones.

programme.title: Rutila enfurece con Súper Javi
programme.desc: Antes que Javier lo descubra, Rutila prefiere revelarle que el presidente fue su amante, y su reacción, cae como una bomba que desata una discusión. El Cabo y Evelina recorren los templos.

programme.title: Aurelio rapta a otro candidato
programme.desc: Aurelio encierra a Gómez Labrador en una iglesia y le exige que confiese todo sobre la amnistía que propuso. Aunque el candidato se resiste a negociar, le pide un acuerdo con los otros carteles.

programme.title: Casillas ordena a sus mujeres
programme.desc: Después del crimen de dos agentes de la DEA, Casillas quiere que Corina abandone la agencia y lo acompañe para pelear contra el mundo. Y a Ámbar le ordena que llame a Colon, para entregarse.

programme.title: Ámbar vs. Corina, como leonas
programme.desc: Corina le da instrucciones a Ámbar: debe entregar a uno del Cartel de los Soles para distraer a la DEA. Maldonado pide sexo con Casillas como parte de pago. Diana y el Cabo son socios.

programme.title: El Cabo en guerra con Diana
programme.desc: Diana Ahumada no quiere seguir con el negocio del narco, pero "El Cabo" la obliga a continuar. Si no lo hace, causará un atentado contra su familia. Javier recuerda cuando conoció a Rutila.

programme.title: Diana desafía al Cabo
programme.desc: Pese a las advertencias, Diana Ahumada mata a dos hombres del Cabo y le exige a Ricardo que refuerce la seguridad de su familia. Dona Alba revela que Aurelio podría tener un medio hermano.

programme.title: El Cabo en la mira
programme.desc: Armada hasta los dientes, Diana apunta al Cabo cuando llega con sus hombres y le indica dónde le dejó su última entrega. Arelys rompe en llanto y le cuenta toda la verdad a su jefa.

programme.title: Ámbar negocia con la DEA
programme.desc: La DEA exige a Ámbar que le entregue a cinco involucrados con la droga del gobierno venezolano.

programme.desc: Mitón Jiménez va hasta Monclova a asustar a Diana. Amenaza a su familia. LA CIA alerta a la DEA sobre Águila Azul.

programme.desc: Diana le revela a su madre que el verdadero negocio de la familia es el transporte de drogas a EE. UU. Casillas ordena investigar a Zuleta. Maldonado manipula a Navarro.

programme.desc: Aurelio sostiene que la mejor defensa es el ataque, así que gira instrucciones para conseguir los planos de los Pinos. El sabotaje en la recepción presidencial pone en evidencia a Terán.

programme.title: Casillas mata a Zuleta
programme.desc: Como un francotirador, Casillas mata de un plomazo a Zuleta y le advierte al presidente, que el que juega con fuego, se quema. Ismael tortura al Mocho y Rutila impide que siga haciéndolo.

programme.title: Duelo entre Casillas y el Cabo
programme.desc: Después del bazucazo contra los Casillas y el tiroteo desatado entre los carteles, el Cabo jura hacerle pagar a Aurelio, con la misma moneda: liquidar a su familia. Evelina y el Mocho huyen.

programme.title: El Cabo balea a Casillas
programme.desc: Cuando Aurelio cree que mató a su enemigo, El Cabo lo sorprende y le dispara en la cabeza, dejándolo malherido. Aurelio pide ayuda a un viejo amigo. Alba y compañía llegan al Rancho Ahumada.

programme.title: Casillas lucha por su vida
programme.desc: Herido de gravedad, Casillas busca refugio con El Rayo, un viejo amigo de la infancia, que trata de mantenerlo con vida. Rutila, celosa con Kashi.

programme.title: Águila Azul revela su rostro
programme.desc: Tal como lo había anunciado, Amado Leal, alias Águila Azul, mata a González, otro exagente y descubre que Colon es aliado de sus enemigos. Casillas está en coma y El Rayo podría entregarlo.

programme.title: Intensa búsqueda tras Casillas
programme.desc: Mientras el presidente y El Cabo quieren a Casillas muerto, la DEA lo busca vivo para hacerle pagar todos sus crímenes, lo extraditarán a EE.UU. Águila Azul va por Colón y el agente lo sabe.

programme.title: Van al refugio de Casillas
programme.desc: Corina descubre que atribuyen a Águila Azul, ser cabeza de una organización criminal; pero es falso. Se reencuentran y juntos buscan a Casillas. La DEA fracasa. Garañón y El Cabo son aliados.

programme.title: Aurelio y Amado son hermanos
programme.desc: Águila Azul admite que él y Aurelio son hermanos. El Cabo revisa la lista de gimnasios de boxeo en Tepito.

programme.desc: Milton Jiménez llega con sus hombres y destruye a punta de plomo y fuego el escondite de Casillas, pero termina enfrentándose con Águila Azul. Aurelio empeora, su herida sangra y está infectada.

programme.desc: Cam's mother shares too much information while attending a charity event; Uncle Julius wants to be Cam's "talent scout."

programme.title: Mad Money
programme.desc: After her husband loses his job, upper-crust housewife Bridget Cardigan (Diane Keaton) is forced to take a job as a janitor at the Federal Reserve Bank of Kansas City, Mo. Spotting a weakness in the bank's security system, Bridget convinces her two new friends Nina (Queen Latifah) and Jackie (Katie Holmes) to help her steal a fortune in worn-out bills that have been earmarked for destruction.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: The topic of gossip shifts toward Kyung Seok as rumors swirl about his family. Woo Young plans a housewarming party.

programme.title: Episode 8
programme.desc: Mi-rae and Kyung-seok go to the movies and have dinner together; Kyung-seok goes in search of new lodging.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Kyeong-seok and Yeon U-yeong compete for Mi-rae's affections; Mi-rae deals with her low self-confidence when Su-a reveals her true colors.

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: Mi Rae convinces herself that her unnatural beauty is not good enough for Kyung Seok. Kyung Hee and Hye Sung try to rebuild their relationship.

programme.title: My Little Brother
programme.desc: Three siblings must figure out what to do with a younger brother whom they were suddenly introduced to and did not know even existed before.

programme.title: Twenty Hacker
programme.desc: White hacker club 'Better World' and a genius hacker 'HEX' have an inevitable showdown with the black hackers as they hack the biggest cryptocurrency exchange in South Korea. To take revenge for his father and protect the love of his life against the black hackers young and reckless Jae-min a.k.a HEX now must prove his hacking ability to the world.

programme.title: Life is Beautiful
programme.desc: A wife asks her husband to find her first love for her birthday leading to an unexpected journey together.

programme.title: You Call It Passion
programme.desc: A young female reporter struggles to survive as an intern in a team led by a high-tempered chief editor.

programme.title: Red Family
programme.desc: A group of North Korean spies disguised as an ordinary South Korean family work as spies in South Korea.

programme.title: 4:44 : Time Of Fear
programme.desc: Missing persons. Eerie sounds. Shadows at night. Bukchon Apartment hides more than secrets.

programme.title: Cabriolet
programme.desc: Thirty-year-old Ji-ah purchases a new Mercedes convertible with her entire savings. She sets off on a road trip with her ex-boyfriend, but the liberation she seeks is nowhere to be found.

programme.title: Nailed
programme.desc: Jae-gu and Sun-yeong a couple that runs an auto-shop off set off an chain of events headed for catastrophe.

programme.title: 4:44 : Time Of Fear
programme.desc: Missing persons. Eerie sounds. Shadows at night. Bukchon Apartment hides more than secrets.

programme.title: Red Family
programme.desc: A group of North Korean spies disguised as an ordinary South Korean family work as spies in South Korea.

programme.title: Episode 9
programme.desc: Han Se Gye's metamorphosis amuses Seo Do Jae, but it puts her in a bind when her mother shows up and later wants to know when her daughter will marry.

programme.title: Episode 10
programme.desc: Han Se Gye's passing remark about her ad upsets Seo Do Jae, who's left feeling helpless when the change happens at the worst possible moment.

programme.title: Episode 11
programme.desc: Seo Do Jae gets unexpected advice from his mother and later arranges a surprise getaway for Han Se Gye. Kang Sa Ra finds Ryu Eun Ho's actions baffling.

programme.title: Episode 13
programme.desc: Seo Do Jae and Han Se Gye grapple with what it truly means to be with someone, no matter the circumstances. Seo Do Jae makes a surprising revelation.

programme.title: A Day
programme.desc: A world-famous father gets stuck in a loop as he continues to fail to save his daughter only to find that this phenomenon is related to his past.

programme.title: True Fiction
programme.desc: Kyung-suk is a strong candidate to be the next mayor. He heads toward a cottage in order to hide slush fund.

programme.title: Very Ordinary Couple
programme.desc: A couple keep their relationship a secret at their shared workplace and wage all out war on each other when they break up.

programme.title: Go Back
programme.desc: Ji-won a motivated new police officer is strangely bothered after meeting O-sun a social worker. On a hot summer day a kidnapper sends a message saying 'If you want to save the kidnapped child donate money to the welfare center.' The incident becomes a national concern as the media report it. Somehow Ji-won doubts the link between the case and O-sun.

programme.title: Race to Freedom: Um Bok Dong
programme.desc: "Guns and swords aren't the only ways to change the world." Based on true events a cyclist brings hope and optimism to the Korean people during the Japanese colonial period.

programme.title: Me And Me
programme.desc: Soo-hyuk an elementary school teacher in a rural village has a secret. Every night his wife Yi-young turns into another person.

programme.title: HITMAN: AGENT JUN
programme.desc: Jun, a former human weapon turned webtoon artist, must protect his peaceful family life amid a massive battle.

programme.title: The King
programme.desc: Tae-su turns his gangster life around when he learns where the real power lies. However once he becomes a prosecutor he is disillusioned by the unglamorous life of low-level prosecutors. By chance he is taken under the wing of Han Kang-sik the prosecutor with absolute power and experiences the extravagant lifestyle of the top 1%. Driven by an insatiable hunger for power Tae-su gets more entangled in the political game only to see the cruel truth behind it.

programme.title: Start-Up
programme.desc: A runaway teen learns how to lead a life as an adult when he gets involved with a mysterious chef at a Chinese restaurant.

programme.title: Episode 13
programme.desc: Mi-rae starts to see herself in a new light after she sees a worrying glimpse of Su-a, and makes a decision about Kyeong-seok.

programme.title: Episode 14
programme.desc: Mi Rae and Kyung Seok try to keep their new relationship a secret but almost nowhere is safe from watchful eyes.

programme.title: CHICKEN STOCK
programme.desc: Every great kitchen needs a big pot of good stock and with this pot of stock, Lidia will make three delicious dishes. She starts by making a flavorful chicken stock made into "Stracciatella", laced with eggs and spinach. She then uses the stock in her succulent Stuffed Veal Chop with oozing Fontina. Finally, she prepares a Braised Kale with Bacon, a wonderful dish that she has been eating since she was a child.

programme.title: The Start Of The Season
programme.desc: Cannellini pesto dip and a crudite spread; spaghetti primavera with courgette, green beans, peas and asparagus; spinach, bread and ricotta frittata.

programme.title: ANTIPASTI
programme.desc: There is a party in the air with an Italian flair. Lidia teaches the viewer several dishes that will work for any party - including a selection of varies cheese, cured meat and Giardiniera Style Vegetables; an easy and quick Sweet and Sour Zucchini Dish and lastly Stuffed Mushrooms made with a delicious mixture of scallions, red peppers and fresh parsley. Lastly there is still time for a delicious salad of poached seafood featuring shrimp, mussels and calamari.

programme.title: VEGETABLES
programme.desc: Whether used in soups, roasted or stuffed, the Italians love their vegetables. In this episode, she makes a platter full of Roasted Peppers Stuffed with Tuna. She then creates a mellow dish of Savory Onions Stuffed with Lamb and Sweet Raisins. The Cauliflower and Tomato Soup is one that warms the heart and any kitchen table.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Life's Milestones
programme.desc: Join Lidia Bastianich on a deeply personal culinary journey in celebration of life's milestones, sharing in the wonderful diversity of American culture and food. Milestones include sweet sixteen, baptism, graduation, and a house blessing.

programme.title: Best of Baked Dishes
programme.desc: The oven is on in today's episode! With a little bit of prep time and a hot oven, you can enjoy the appetizers with the friends and family while the rest is baking. Today's recipes include: Spicy Stuffed Clams; Roasted Chicken with Pomegranate; and Potatoes Stuffed with Sausage & Mushrooms.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: Grilled corn, courgette and tomato salad; spicy lobster linguine.

programme.title: Kneading Dough
programme.desc: The tradition of kneading dough has always been around in Lidia's family. She recalls kneading with her grandmother as a small child and continues to do it with her own grandchildren today. In this episode, she prepares a buttery, flaky Crostata with Kale, Butternut Squash and Ricotta, a delicious Butternut Squash and Brussels Sprouts Panzanella using leftover bread, and finally Pappardelle with Mixed Fresh Mushrooms.

programme.title: A Dinner Party
programme.desc: Entertaining comes in many forms, and today Lidia creates a menu that is perfect for an intimate gathering of friends and family. This simply elegant dinner menu includes Swordfish alla Bagnara, a delicately steamed swordfish made with an aromatic mix of lemon, capers and garlic - a traditional dish from the Calabrian town of Bagnara. She'll then do a spicy Bloody Mary, followed by a classic Lagane e Ceci - ribbons of fresh pasta made with chickpeas and pepperoncino.

programme.title: Vegetable Favorites
programme.desc: Italy is a garden year round, and Lidia celebrates an array of beautiful vegetable dishes including: Celery Stalks Stuffed with Gorgonzola and Apples; an elegant Asparagus and Scallion Salad; a refreshing Fava Sesame Dip, that pairs beautifully with flat breads and finally a Linguine with Swisschard made with walnuts and creamy fresh ricotta.

programme.title: Welcome to my Home
programme.desc: Today's recipes are perfect for entertaining and include a savory Onion-Tomato Focaccia, restaurant inspired spreads for fresh bread and Skillet or Grilled Calamari.

programme.title: FOCACCIA
programme.desc: Focaccia is an irresistible, crunchy Italian flatbread. It's great for sandwiches and even to stuff. Lidia begins by making a Classic Rosemary and Lemon Focaccia; she then moves on to a Filled Focaccia with Smoky Speck and Fontina Cheese. To finish these two lunchtime and snack favorites, she creates a Salad of Shrimp, Fava and Cranberry Beans.

programme.title: The Fish Market
programme.desc: Potato and pasta soup; a salad of green beans and new potatoes; ditalini with potatoes and provoke.

programme.title: Surf N Turf
programme.desc: Surf n' Turf might not be an Italian tradition, but a Crispy Shrimp, Swordfish Skewers with Sweet and Sour Sauce go beautifully with a Maremma Style Steak! Tutti in Cucina! Everyone in the kitchen today!

programme.title: Italian Cakes
programme.desc: The oven is on today in Lidia's Kitchen, and she is sharing some of her best cakes. There is a Gianduia Cake - a Piedmontese tradition and a dream for hazelnut and chocolate lovers; a delicious and moist Chocolate and Zucchini Cake; and finally a nutty Walnut and Espresso Cake.

programme.title: Italian All Stars
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia shares some of her all-time favorites - Tomato and Onion Salad alla Calabrese, a great salad to make in the summer when tomatoes are sweet and ripe. Everyone loves meatballs, and Lidia shows viewers how to use leftovers in a Leftover Meatball Panini. Finally, Lidia stuffs Pizza Rolls with broccoli rabe and sausage and with ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: Eggs and My Chickens
programme.desc: As a child, Lidia's courtyard was home to several animals. She spent a lot of time with chickens, as she would tend to them and gather their eggs. In this episode, Lidia recollects those fond memories and creates a medley of vegetables, salumi, cheese and hard boiled eggs for her Chopped Salad with Frisee and Fennel. She also prepares a Chicken Cacciatore as well as a Potato and Egg Frico.

programme.title: Respect The Ingredients
programme.desc: Steamed broccoli, cannellini and egg salad; skillet tuna with aubergine and courgette in puttanesca sauce.

programme.title: Game Day Bites
programme.desc: Whether it's American football or Italian soccer, game day parties are always popular. Lidia believes that there is nothing like a bountiful spread of food that will fuel the guests and get them cheering. On today's menu, she serves Fried Mozzarella Sandwich Skewers; Carrot and Chickpea Dip and Pizza Rolls - made with both broccoli rabe and sausage AND ricotta and leeks.

programme.title: A Stovetop Dinner
programme.desc: The stove can do a lot of work in any home kitchen, and many recipes can be created simultaneously. In this episode, Lidia shares recipes for: Cannellini and Pancetta Bruschetta; Ziti with Kale and Crispy Bacon; and Monkfish Meatballs in Tomato Sauce

programme.title: Make it Zucchini
programme.desc: Oven-braised pork chops with red onions and pears; beef and root vegetables braised in red wine; tomato-braised cauliflower recipe.

programme.title: The Versatile Tomato and All things Italian
programme.desc: Tomatoes are known in the Italian culture although the tradition goes way beyond the simple tomato sauce. Lidia gathers some of her favorite tomato based recipes and shares them in this episode including: Tomato and Mint Salad, Tomato and Ricotta Crostini, Spaghetti with Quick Pantry Sauce. She finishes with a Gluttonous Tomato- a perfect appetizer or lunch dish starring oven baked tomatoes stuffed with bread, grated cheese and seasoning and topped with farm eggs. Yum!

programme.title: Something For Everyone
programme.desc: Butternut squash and cannellini beans; a quick and easy dessert of strawberries and balsamic; roasted spaghetti squash with spicy tomato sauce.

programme.title: Spice it Up
programme.desc: Spices impart a lot of flavor to a recipe, and today Lidia shows viewers how to use different spices. First on the menu is Mussels with Fennel and Saffron, an elegant and luxurious way to serve mussels. Lidia loves peperoncino in almost any dish, especially when making Spicy Stuffed Clams. And finally, Lidia makes Chicken and Zucchini Salad with Horseradish Dressing.

programme.title: Chicken for Dinner
programme.desc: Pan pizza and a mozzarella cheeseburger using focaccia, mozzarella, pickled peperoncino and a grilled tomato; crispy baked chicken cutlets.

programme.title: The Winter Vegetable Punch
programme.desc: Winter always proved to be a tough time for the garden, but this only made cold weather crops more valuable on Lidia's family table. Recipes in this episode include a delicious Orecchiette with Breadcrumbs, Pancetta, and Cauliflower, and a unique and flavorful Cabbage Salad topped with a warm dressing.

programme.title: Steak Night With London Broil
programme.desc: There is nothing better than a great piece of meat! In today's episode, Lidia takes a less expensive cut, London Broil, and marinate it to perfection. Her menu includes a delicious Vegetable Patty served with green salad which works as an appetizer or by itself as a quick lunch, London Broil with Sun Dried Tomato Marinade and one of her Grandma Rosa's favorite Corn and Walnut Cake

programme.title: Fishing the Adriatic with Uncle Emilio
programme.desc: Lidia fell in love with the sea growing up near the Adriatic's beautiful rocky beaches. Fishing trips with Uncle Emilio were always a lot of hard work, but definitely worth the delicious reward. Today, she prepares a Grilled Calamari Salad with Tomato Coulis, Toasted Bread with Basil Cannellini, and a Whole Roasted Branzino where everything is done in the oven for a trouble-free cleanup.

programme.title: FRESH PASTA
programme.desc: Fresh pasta is an Italian family tradition passed through the generations. Today she starts with a silky pappardelle pasta dressed with pesto made from walnut, basil and parsley. She then takes the same pasta dough and shapes it into Tortelloni stuffed with spinach and ricotta, dressed with a classic marinara sauce.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Return of the Artisans
programme.desc: Lidia Bastianich travels the country to meet with American makers who are mastering the art of meat curing, coopering, coppersmithing, jam-making, cider-making, and more-and finds out what inspires and fuels them. She sees how artisanal crafts and small businesses are a fulfilling way to earn a livelihood, and how many craftspeople are bringing their skills back to their own communities.

programme.title: A Little Spice With A Hint of Beer
programme.desc: There is nothing more delicious than butterflied poultry with super crispy chicken. In this episode, Lidia starts with a Spicy Butterflied Cornish Hen made with hot cherry peppers, rosemary and wine. She then pulls out the beer to add to her Potatoes Baked in Beer .Our favorite Grandma Erminia joins Lidia to taste the Squash and Ricotta Tart.

programme.title: Cooking as a Kid in New York
programme.desc: Lidia's first home economics class as a teenager in New York confirmed her passion for food. Despite the differences compared to what she was used to, she was determined to explore it all. Lidia starts off with Lasagna with Ricotta and Mozzarella, a dish she remembers from when she was first introduced to Italian American food. She follows this with a flavorful Escarole Olive Oil Mashed Potatoes, and finishes with Baked Stuffed Vegetables, a very satisfying mixture.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: Freedom & Independence
programme.desc: Join beloved chef and cookbook author Lidia Bastianich on a deeply personal culinary journey to four celebrations of independence, to share in the wonderful diversity of American culture and food.

programme.title: A Cheesy Craving
programme.desc: Italians love cheese, and back in the kitchen, Lidia shares her favorite cheesy appetizers - Baked Goat Cheese, Fava, and Artichoke Dip, baked to golden to perfection; and Baked Stuffed Vegetables, a recipe Lidia often makes when cooking for her family.

programme.title: Holiday Celebrations & Special Occasions
programme.desc: When a holiday or special occasion goes around, it's time to go above and beyond with an extra special feast. Today, Lidia shares some of her best recipes to do just that. Her Wedding Soup is a classic Italian dish that marries the vegetables and meatballs in a delicious pot of soup; Prosecco Punch, made with raspberries and nectarines is a real crowd pleaser, and finally you can't go wrong with a beautiful Roasted Lamb Shoulder with Carrots and Parsnips, a rich and flavorful one pot meal.

programme.title: A Day at the Market
programme.desc: Lidia has always loved trips to the food market. From her days as a small child preparing to go to the market with her grandmother to searching for seasonal produce today, it has always been an adventure. Recipes in this episode include a Shrimp, Roasted Pepper and Olive Salad and a delicious vegetarian Eggplant Parmigiana Stacks.

programme.title: Starring Olive Oil
programme.desc: Olive oil is an essential staple in every Italian home. It's the easiest way to add flavor to any soup, and Lidia shows you how when making Cannellini Bean and Lentil Soup. Olive oil is also used in desserts, and she makes Olive Oil Cake.

programme.title: Family Favorites
programme.desc: Today's recipes are dedicated to the family. They can be made for a weeknight dinner or a large gathering or holiday and include: Oven Braised Pork Chops with Red Onion and Pears; Cherry Jam Tart. To start, Lidia enjoys a special Cherry Bellini.

programme.title: Eggs All Day
programme.desc: In today's episode, Lidia shows you how to brunch Italian-style. On the menu are Herb Frittata Roll-Ups, a wonderful appetizer to pass around at a cocktail party or for a buffet brunch; Pancetta with Fennel-Flavored Eggs and Apples, a delicious breakfast or brunch dish served with lots of crusty bread; and Potato and Egg Frico, a favorite breakfast dish in Lidia's family, in which potatoes and cheese are baked together.

programme.title: Italian Essentials
programme.desc: A light version of chicken parmigiana; rice balls stuffed with sausage ragu; Lidia's traditional Bolognese sauce.

programme.title: The 1970s Italian American
programme.desc: As a teenager in the seventies, Lidia was always curious about Italian-American cuisine, which was extremely popular especially in New York City and all the boroughs. Today she honors the Italian-American culinary culture and prepares a Chicken Parmigiana Light, a leftover Meatball Panino, and a Baked Pasta with Tomato Sauce, Meatballs, and Eggs, which will be sure to leave everyone satisfied.

programme.title: An Italian Cookout
programme.desc: Sausages with fennel and green olives; seared lamb chops with mint salsa and roasted potato wedges; fragoncello.

programme.title: Rethink Risotto
programme.desc: Skillet shrimp with asparagus features sauteed shrimp over grilled bread; skillet gratinate of pork, aubergine and zucchini; one-pot soft polenta.

programme.title: Just Braising
programme.desc: Oven-braised pork chops with red onions and pears; beef and root vegetables braised in red wine; tomato-braised cauliflower recipe.

programme.title: Olive Oil
programme.desc: Olive oil reigns in Lidia's kitchen, and in this episode she teaches the viewer how to use it from appetizer to soup to dessert. She'll start with a delicious Tomato and Bread Salad - a delicious tossed salad of country bread and juicy ripe tomatoes known as panzanella; a nourishing Rice and Lentil Soup and a Cannoli Napoleon, a new twist on the old cannoli: ricotta cream with crunchy almonds and chocolate layered between fried pastry.

programme.title: A Meal To Make You Smile
programme.desc: Radicchio, endive, apple and pecorino with cheese toasts; skilled ricotta mini meatloaves dressed in a mushroom sauce.

programme.title: Tiny Kitchen, Big Flavor
programme.desc: A light version of chicken parmigiana; rice balls stuffed with sausage ragu; Lidia's traditional Bolognese sauce.

programme.title: Cheese Please!
programme.desc: Chopped salad with frisee and fennel; a summertime-inspired tomato and courgette bread lasagna; braised beef rolls.

programme.title: An Easy Holiday
programme.desc: Today is all about stress-free cooking for a holiday celebration or special occasion. Lidia makes Marinated Mushrooms that can be part of an antipasto spread or as a nibble with drinks. Vin Brûlé, the Italian version of mulled wine, is a warm and welcoming drink to make for any holiday celebration. Last on the menu is Turkey Breast with Apricots, an easy and quick way to serve turkey without having to cook a whole turkey.

programme.title: A Kind Gesture
programme.desc: A Belgian and endive salad that features a rich egg yolk vinaigrette; naked ricotta dumplings with a sage-butter sauce; stuffed tomatoes.

programme.title: Storytime with Grandma
programme.desc: Lidia's mother, Erminia, is known to all as "Grandma." She is known for her laughter, singing and entertaining culinary moments with Lidia. In this episode, featured recipes include Corn and Zucchini Minestra, Fried Risotto and Beef & Root Vegetables Braised in Red Wine. "Salute" to Grandma!

programme.title: Gnocchi
programme.desc: They have been called the "gnocchi family", and in this episode, Lidia shares two of her more unusual versions of this dish: Her Butternut Squash Gnocchi are light and slightly sweet as they showcase this welcome vegetable in the potato mix. Her next dish is Plum Gnocchi, which is typical of her homeland and even sweeter, sometimes eaten as a dessert. Made with toasted breadcrumbs, cinnamon and butter, it doesn't get any better than this!

programme.title: Eggs: All Different Ways
programme.desc: It's an episode devoted to the fresh, simple egg, and it highlights some of Lidia's all-time favorites: Stracciatella: a simple chicken stock laced with ribbons of egg and tender spinach; Frittata with Ricotta: a luscious frittata filled with ricotta, tomatoes, onions and basil; Baked Eggplant and Eggs: a baked dish showing off of one of summer's best vegetables.

programme.title: Crespelle
programme.desc: Italians love their crepes either savory or sweet and this episode, Lidia shows two of her favorite crespelle dishes, along with some great chef tips. She will start by highlighting the thin pancakes that can be made into so many things; then she'll make a savory Italian favorite with them - Manicotti and for a sweet version, she will show the Chocolate and Walnut Crespelle that will satisfy any sweet tooth.

programme.title: Party Fixings
programme.desc: Lidia says that the key to a great party is always the food, and in this episode she features some of her best party recipes from over the years. Bruschetta is always a great snack to pass around, and the combinations are endless. Her Fig & Prosciutto Bruschetta is a unique and delicious party item that she includes at almost any gathering. She'll also prepare a colorful Marinated Winter Squash that is a favorite at her home parties.

programme.title: Grandma's Favorites
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia honors the Grandmothers of the family. She starts with a delicious and quick Skillet Gratin of Mushrooms and Chicken, one of her mother's favorites. As the chicken is cooking, she heads.to the side dish, Celery Potatoes and Tomatoes. Joing her at the end of the show is Lidia's granddaughter, Julia to taste Grandma Rosa's Apple cake.

programme.title: SAVORY BAKING
programme.desc: In this episode, the oven is on for the fish dish, the vegetable dish and for the chicken drumsticks! Lidia creates three great main course ideas that are just right for days when you want to do everything in one dish and put it in the oven until it's ready to serve. She makes a Baked Fennel with Tomatoes and oozing Cheese. She then creates a Rollatini of Sole with flavored breadcrumbs baked in a light and delicate sauce of fresh herbs, lemon and white wine.

programme.title: Stretch Your Meal
programme.desc: Fennel and Asian pear salad; cheesy veal chops with cabbage served in a butter sauce; lentil crostini.

programme.title: Lidia Celebrates America: A Salute to First Responders
programme.desc: Chef Lidia Bastianich travels the country visiting men and women who've worked quietly in the shadows and now find themselves thrust into the spotlight by crises facing the country in 2020. From coast to coast, Lidia follows dedicated police officers, firefighters, paramedics, military and medical workers, and observes the prominent role that food plays in these first responders' lives.

programme.title: Is Dinner Ready?
programme.desc: Spicy sheet pan pork chops and broccoli; how to revive leftover soup for an easy weeknight meal; apricot jam half-moons.

programme.title: RISOTTO
programme.desc: If you can't make it to Milan for a dish of "Risotto alla Milanese" bring the dish to your kitchen! Lidia begins today's meal with a Creamy Risotto alla Milanese with Saffron and Marrow bone followed by a Succulent Quail Stuffed with Italian Sausage and Mushrooms. For dessert, it's an Italian classic - light and creamy Panna Cotta with Seasonal Berries.

programme.title: Garlic and Onion Steal the Show
programme.desc: Garlic and Onions appear in many Italian dishes, and in this episode they actually become the "star ingredients." Lidia starts the meal with a quick and easy Savory Onion tart followed by a delicious, mild and creamy Garlic Risotto. For dessert, it's all about chocolate with the moist Torta Caprese.

programme.title: An Easy Effort
programme.desc: Balsamic chicken stir fry; traditional frico with montasio cheese; a sweet grape and ricotta pizza that can be served as dessert, for brunch, or as a snack.

programme.title: More Family Favorites
programme.desc: In this episode, Lidia prepares three regional Italian dishes- from Piedmont to Tuscany to Emilia Romagna. Her colorful Peppers Piedmontese are a great addition to any antipasto or buffet table, her Malfada Michelangelo Style is a delicious pasta dish based on dish attributed to Michelangelo. lastly, she shares a Filet Mignon Italian Style with Balsamic Reduction using this liquid gold from the area of Modena.

programme.title: Carry on Tradition
programme.desc: Chopped salad with frisee and fennel; a summertime-inspired tomato and courgette bread lasagna; braised beef rolls.

programme.title: Bolognese
programme.desc: It's a world famous technique but made with milk, it is famous only in the Italian region of Emilia Romagna.

programme.title: Fish Festa
programme.desc: Fish is a staple on Lidia's table all year long, and she loves to plan a dinner that showcases the best and freshest of seafood. The menu is diverse today, as she prepares Mussels with Fennel and Saffron, a fun and elegant dish that is served with grilled bread; Cucumber Salad, a refreshing salad dressed with sweet honey, tangy vinegar and crunchy celery; and finally Baked Striped Bass with Lemon Sauce - made with cheese flavored breadcrumbs and baked to golden perfection.

programme.title: The Flavors of Northern Italy
programme.desc: After the introduction of the southern Italian classics to American cuisine, the flavors of northern Italy began to arrive as well. Lidia takes us through a Layered Casserole with Beef, Cabbage, and Potatoes, a comforting dish that she likes to cook when the cold weather sets in. She then shares her Herbed Frittata Rollup with Prosciutto Cotto, which can be served hot or at room temperature, followed by a family classic- Cavatappi with Beef Guazzetto.

programme.title: Simply Delizioso
programme.desc: Today, Lidia shares three simply delicious Italian classics - a Shaved Fennel, Radish, Red onion and Prosciutto Cotto appetizer. Lemony Shrimp over Zucchini take the stage for her main course and a light Olive Oil Cake is a perfect finish to the meal.

programme.title: DOUGH AND CRUSTS
programme.desc: Italians will wrap anything in dough, whether it's savory or sweet, and still have time for a classic. Lidia begins this meal with a savory Zucchini and Rice Crostata. She then turns to the sweets with a celebration of Zeppole, a fried delicious dough stuffed with creamy ricotta. Grandma Erminia, who has the sweet tooth in the family, joins Lidia for this segment.

programme.title: Crazy for Mushrooms
programme.desc: Lidia loves earthy, delicious mushrooms and today shares some of her favorite mushroom recipes that she has prepared over the years. She'll start with a Warm Mushroom Salad, a medley of warm wild mushrooms on a bed of frisee' topped with crispy pancetta and a poached egg. She'll also make Funghi Marinati, marinated button mushrooms in a flavorful mix of rosemary, orange and garlic; Her last dish is a hearty, flavorful and vegetarian Chestnut and Mushroom Ragu.

programme.title: Familiar Flavors
programme.desc: Roasted chicken with pomegranate and a chocolate ricotta cheesecake; baked beans.

programme.title: A Perfect Weeknight Meal
programme.desc: Preparing a delicious and nutritious weeknight meal for the family is not always easy but Lidia shares some of her quickest and simplest recipes that willw ork in any kitchen. The menu includes: carrots and Apple Salad, Salmon Fillets with Prosecco served with Savory Potatoes and Apple Crumble- a dessert that can be made with almost any fruit.

programme.title: Family Meal
programme.desc: Balsamic chicken stir fry; traditional frico with montasio cheese; a sweet grape and ricotta pizza that can be served as dessert, for brunch, or as a snack.

programme.title: Southern Italian Salads
programme.desc: Calabria is famous for its fiery salami spread, 'Nduja. It is delicious on warm grilled bread, and Lidia shows viewers how to make a Bruschetta with 'Nduja; she then makes Raw and Cooked Salad for Summer with green beans and tomatoes, a wonderful way to enjoy seasonal vegetables.

programme.title: Sweetest of Sweets
programme.desc: Today's episode features a collection of the best of Italian dolce or sweets- from cookies to cake to pudding. Lidia begins this episode with Anise Cookies, then prepares a Mint Granita, a light and heavenly Angel Cake with Fresh Berries, and lastly a Rice Pudding with a Blessing, inspired by one of the convents in Italy.

programme.title: Family Favorites
programme.desc: It's all about family in this episode as Lidia shares three of her favorite family recipes. Marinated Meatballs, Zucchini Parmigiana, Artichoke Carbonara and Jam Filler Mezzaluna are the stars of this episode.

programme.title: CRESPELLE
programme.desc: Italians love their crespelle or crepes. In this episode, Lidia teaches viewers how to stuff them with tomato and grated cheese. Today's menu includes: Celery, Artichoke and Mortadella Salad, "Crespelle Manicotti" stuffed with ricotta and mozzarella and for dessert, an Italian classic - beautiful Strawberries Topped with Balsamic Vinegar, a Lidia favorite.

programme.title: What's Baking
programme.desc: With the oven on, Lidia creates sweet and savory dishes her viewers can easily make at home. Gratins are delicious, and she starts with a Leek and Prosciutto Gratin made with Gruyère and walnuts; next is Roasted Chicken with Pomegranate, marvelously moist inside and with a crispy, caramelized exterior. While the oven is still on, she bakes crumbly and chewy Raspberry and Walnut Butter Cookies for dessert.

programme.title: The Power Of Food
programme.desc: Fuzi with chicken ragu; no-bake chocolate ricotta brick cake.

programme.title: Let's Make Dinner
programme.desc: Penne with cauliflower and green olive pesto; poached chicken and giardiniera salad.

programme.title: Breakfast at Lidia's
programme.desc: Fried potatoes with sausage and eggs; breakfast risotto featuring bacon, egg and cheese; ricotta pancakes.

programme.title: Italian American Favorites
programme.desc: Italian American food: Is it Italian, American or a piece of Americana with Italian roots? Today Lidia pays homage to the cooking of Italian American immigrants. Recipes include: Caesar Salad; a luscious Baked Eggplant Stuffed with Meat and Vegetables; and finally Stuffed Mushrooms, a true crowd pleaser.

programme.title: The Olive Grove
programme.desc: Lidia remembers Grandma Rosa's olive trees and the excitement surrounding the late fall harvest of one of Italy's most prized products- newly pressed extra virgin olive oil. Lidia's recipes in this episode showcase this treasured product and include a delicate Striped Bass with Braised Broccolini and Olive Oil Cake, a culinary creation that is perfect for a snack, breakfast, and dessert.

programme.title: Potato, Potato
programme.desc: Potato and pasta soup; a salad of green beans and new potatoes; ditalini with potatoes and provoke.

programme.title: A Bright Summer Feast
programme.desc: Lidia loves bringing people together in her kitchen, and she shares two recipes that are wonderful for a buffet-style meal, her favorite way of entertaining guests. She starts with a quick and easy Lemony Shrimp over Zucchini with a sauce of garlic, butter, white wine, lemon, bread crumbs and parsley. Next on the menu is one of Lidia's favorite soups, Clam Soup, served with plenty of grilled bread on the side.

programme.title: FISH AND SEAFOOD
programme.desc: It doesn't get any better in an Italian kitchen than when Lidia makes fish and vegetables. In this episode, she prepares a nice and refreshing Pan Seared Shrimp with Arugula Pesto. Her next dish is Butterflied Trout, fried in a pan with Bacon and Basil served with a Zucchini Dish made with Anchovies and Capers.

programme.title: Crowd Pleasers
programme.desc: Today is all about feeding a large crowd, and Lidia cooks up recipes that all your guests will love, no matter whom you are hosting - Sausages and Apples, a flavorful one-pot meal that is great for family-style dining; Spaghetti with Roasted Garlic Pesto, a delicious and economical addition to any party; and finally, Chocolate Ricotta Cheesecake, a chocolatey twist to the classic Italian ricotta cheesecake.

programme.title: It's Pasta Night!
programme.desc: Everyone loves pasta, and today Lidia shows you the fun and economical way to make all your friends and family happy at the dinner table with a pasta party. On the menu is Spaghetti with Anchovies and Breadcrumbs, a delicious Southern Italian favorite; a Pasta Chinja - a heart-warming Baked Pasta with Tomato Sauce, Meatballs and Egg. Finally, Lidia will share her Fusilli with Roasted Tomato Pesto - a complex bowl of pasta that will become a staple in your house.

programme.title: The Oven is On
programme.desc: There is nothing like a warm oven that makes guests feel invited in a kitchen. The heat and the aromas permeate and bring smiles to everyone's faces. In this episode, Lidia shares three of her favorite oven baked dishes. Eggplant and Rice Parmigiana, Vegetable and Meat Casserole, Bread Puddign with Pears.

programme.title: Redemption Season: A DIY Public Land Elk Hunt
programme.desc: Eastmans' videographer Lindsay steps in front of the camera with an October public-land elk tag. Warm weather, fog and a high snow line keep the post-rut bulls in the timber, so she glasses new country solo off an onX waypoint, hunting for one more chance before the season runs out.

programme.title: Waterfowl Hunting: The Ultimate Mixed Bag Morning
programme.desc: The Wingmen crew and family hit a river goose spot on a warm, windy December morning. With mild weather keeping the birds scarce, it turns into a slow-burn hunt, as widgeon, a mallard and a rare gadwall hen fall over the decoys. Along the way, they explain how to tell a mature widgeon hen from a juvenile by its wing feathers.

programme.title: Would You Hunt with the 22 Creedmoor? Speed Test & Hornady Review
programme.desc: Can a .22-caliber rifle reach 1,500 yards? Todd Helms puts Hornady's 22 Creedmoor to the test with four loads: Precision Hunter, Match, V-Match and Superformance CX. He shoots groups and clocks velocities over the chronograph, and shares the Wyoming mule deer he took with the 80-grain ELD-X.

programme.title: Grit Pays Off! DIY Elk Bow Hunt with Brian Barney
programme.desc: Twelve days into a tough September elk season, Brian Barney and buddy Dylan Ness pack a lightweight spike camp into public-land bowls and glass for a mature six-point. With an hour of light left, they ditch their packs, sprint to the next ridge and use the terrain to stalk into bow range. Then comes the hard part: breaking down the bull and getting the meat off the mountain on no sleep.

programme.title: 3-Man Limit! River Duck Hunt with Wingmen
programme.desc: Crawl in the blind for a late-season waterfowl hunt on the river with the Wingmen crew. Todd Helms is joined by good friends Josh and Greg for some fellowship, and hopefully decoying a few ducks. Weather has been mild and the local birds are stale, but the guys manage to fill out a three-man limit on greenheads with some bonus geese in the mix.

programme.title: Sig Sauer Image Stabilizing Binoculars
programme.desc: Mike Eastman reviews Sig Sauer's Zulu6 HDX image-stabilizing binoculars. He shows how stabilization takes the shake out of glassing in the wind, why the 20-power model can replace a spotting scope in your pack, and how the upgraded HDX glass performs in low light.

programme.title: Public Land Beast! Bow Hunting Big Bulls with Brian Barney
programme.desc: Join Eastmans' Elevated podcast host Brian Barney on this Beyond the Grid episode to bow hunt elk in the rugged backcountry in pursuit of arrowing a bugling bull! This DIY bow hunt is packed with navigating new valleys, winter weather, and Brian's signature spot-and-stalk tactics. From glassing ridges at first light to heart-pounding moments with screaming bulls, this is elk hunting in the raw.

When she meets police cadet Tony (Kevin Dillon), the two decide to take up the investigation themselves, and romantic sparks soon fly. But Mary has no idea of the danger that awaits her.

programme.title: Lizzie
programme.desc: In 1892 Lizzie Borden lives a quiet life in Massachusetts under the strict rules established by her father. Lizzie finds a kindred spirit in the live-in maid, Bridget, and friendship soon blossoms into a secret romance. But tension mounts in the Borden household, leading to a violent breaking point.

programme.title: The Bling Ring
programme.desc: A teenager (Israel Broussard) and his gang of fame-obsessed youths (Katie Chang, Taissa Farmiga) use the Internet to track the whereabouts of celebrities, then rob their homes.

programme.title: Priscilla
programme.desc: When teenage Priscilla Beaulieu meets Elvis Presley at a party, the man who is already a meteoric rock 'n' roll superstar becomes someone entirely unexpected in private moments: a thrilling crush, an ally in loneliness, a vulnerable best friend.

programme.title: Candyman: Farewell to the Flesh
programme.desc: As her brother stands trial for the killing of an outspoken New Orleans professor, inner-city schoolteacher Annie Tarrant begins hearing rumors of the Candyman, a murderous, knife-handed figure of urban legend. Skeptical of the Candyman's existence, Annie follows the procedure for summoning him and suddenly finds herself celebrating the most horrifying Mardi Gras of her life. Meanwhile, Annie's mother harbors a dark family secret.

programme.title: Solstice
programme.desc: While vacationing with friends, a teenager (Elisabeth Harnois) believes that her dead twin sister is trying to contact her.

programme.title: True Crime
programme.desc: Mary (Alicia Silverstone), a precocious high school senior, longs to be a cop. She idolizes her late father, a policeman, and intently studies her favorite magazine, "True Crime." When a classmate dies and the case remains unsolved, Mary becomes obsessed, pestering a local cop (Bill Nunn). When she meets police cadet Tony (Kevin Dillon), the two decide to take up the investigation themselves, and romantic sparks soon fly. But Mary has no idea of the danger that awaits her.

programme.title: So Undercover
programme.desc: The FBI hires a young private detective to go undercover at a sorority to guard the daughter of an important witness in an organized-crime case.

programme.title: Fatal Beauty
programme.desc: Detective Rita Rizzoli (Whoopi Goldberg) is accustomed to donning costumes and going undercover to nail crooks. But she'll be required to use all of her get-ups and more when a major cocaine ring is suspected of turning out a potent new strain of the drug, called "Fatal Beauty." With the help of her partner, Jimenez (Ruben Blades), and a former bodyguard for a local cartel (Sam Elliott), Rita will do whatever it takes to find out who's dealing Fatal Beauty and stop them.

programme.title: Paradise Hills
programme.desc: Young women must band together to escape from a seemingly idyllic island that holds a sinister secret.

programme.title: The Lazarus Effect
programme.desc: Medical researcher Frank (Mark Duplass), his fiancée Zoe (Olivia Wilde) and their team have achieved the impossible: they have found a way to revive the dead. After a successful, but unsanctioned, experiment on a lifeless animal, they are ready to make their work public. However, when their dean learns what they've done, he shuts them down. Zoe is killed during an attempt to recreate the experiment, leading Frank to test the process on her. Zoe is revived -- but something evil is within her.

programme.title: Return to Green Acres
programme.desc: Cast members from the original TV series are reunited when Oliver tries to save Hooterville from greedy developers.

programme.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
programme.desc: This remake of the classic horror film is set in San Francisco. Matthew Bennell assumes that when a friend complains of her husband's strange mood, it's a marital issue. However, he begins to worry as more people report similar observations. His concern is confirmed when writer Jack Bellicec and his wife discover a mutated corpse. Besieged by an invisible enemy, Bennell must work quickly before the city is consumed.

programme.title: Frankenstein
programme.desc: In this re-imagining of Mary Shelley's classic, Dr. Frankenstein is Dr. Victor Helios (Thomas Kretschmann), who has found the means to prolong his life into the present. Portrayed as the villain, Helios has amassed a collection of monsters that are killing people in New Orleans. Detectives Carson O'Connor (Parker Posey) and Michael Sloane (Adam Goldberg) team with the doctor's first creation, Deucalion (Vincent Perez), to track down and stop the crazed evil scientist.

programme.title: Georgia Rule
programme.desc: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

programme.title: Janet Planet
programme.desc: Enthralled by her own imagination, 11-year-old Lacy spends the long summer at home with her mother and three strangers.

programme.title: The Eternal Daughter
programme.desc: Returning to a hotel now haunted by its mysterious past, an artist and her elderly mother confront long-buried secrets in their former family home.

programme.title: Meta inalcanzable
programme.desc: Lola le ofrece a Simón dinero para que enamore a Jazmín; Lety le dice a Fernando que no alcanzarán la meta ni siquiera con el contrato millonario y Fernando le pide apoyo a Marcia para tomar una decisión.

programme.title: Cumpliendo una promesa
programme.desc: Fernando acepta disfrazarse de travesti; Jazmín sale a comer con Simón; Luigi, Ricardo y Fernando firman el contrato; Martha les pone una trampa a Jazmín y a Simón.

programme.title: La iniciación
programme.desc: Alicia le da un cheque a Marcia, acepta comprar la ropa a crédito y le dice que Omar regresó con ella; Fernando acepta pagar por anticipado al proveedor de Panamá y Lety expresa su desacuerdo.

programme.title: Odisea nocturna
programme.desc: Fernando le pide ayuda a Lety y ella sale en busca de Celso; Fernando patea la reja de Conceptos y lo detiene la policía por armar un escándalo en la vía pública.

programme.title: Puras mentiras
programme.desc: Fernando le tiene que explicar a Marcia por qué le pidió ayuda a Lety y no a ella; Paco deja a Clarita con Martha; Fernando le dice a Marcia que viajará a Nueva York para cerrar el negocio del equipo.

programme.title: Espía descubierta
programme.desc: Leticia encuentra a Alicia esculcando su oficina. Jazmín y los niños le cuentan a las secretarias sobre el choque de Simón. Fernando regresa de su viaje y Simón no se atreve a confesarle que chocó su carro. Ariel cancela su alianza con Alicia.

programme.title: Equipo de grabación confiscado
programme.desc: Fernando le aclara a Simón que el empleado del restaurante fue despedido por chocar el automóvil; Omar le cuenta a Fernando que se reconcilió con Alicia; un cargamento es confiscado en la aduana por ser contrabando.

programme.title: Malos negocios
programme.desc: Alicia informa a Ariel lo que le dijo Marcia sobre los proveedores de Nueva York; Lety y Fernando inscriben ante el notario la deuda de Conceptos con Filmo Imagen.

programme.title: Embarazo confirmado
programme.desc: Martha recibe un cheque para comprarse un automóvil; Marcia le dice a Fernando que Alicia sí está embarazada; Ariel cuestiona a Marcia sobre el embarazo de Alicia.

programme.title: Grandes avances
programme.desc: Marcia le dice a Fernando que Bella Life y la agencia de publicidad aceptaron que Conceptos se encargue de lanzar la campaña; las secretarias convencen a Martha de hacerse una liposucción.

programme.title: Embargo inminente
programme.desc: Omar le cuenta a Fernando sobre el abogado que le recomendaron para embargar Conceptos; Omar le da un cheque a Alicia para ayudarle con el embarazo; Paula María le promete a Jaimito conseguirle un mejor papá.

programme.title: Remordimientos
programme.desc: Las chicas del Club de las Feas sospechan que Alicia no está embarazada. El abogado de Filmo Imagen hace efectiva la demanda de embargo. Fernando tiene muchos remordimientos por la grave situación económica de Conceptos.

programme.title: Situación crítica
programme.desc: El esposo de Martha se decepciona porque ella decidió operarse. Los padres de Fernando llegan de viaje y le piden un informe acerca de la situación de la empresa. Simón intenta que incluyan a Jazmín en la coreografía de Bela Life.

programme.title: Embargo precautorio
programme.desc: Las del club escuchan a Alicia decir que se hizo unos análisis de sangre; Martha habla al laboratorio y, a nombre de Alicia, pide que hagan una prueba de embarazo y se la envíen.

programme.title: Abierto coqueteo
programme.desc: En el ensayo del comercial, Fátima le coquetea a Fernando y Marcia se lo reclama; Lety le pide discreción al licenciado Sánchez para levantar el embargo.

programme.title: Intriga y curiosidad

programme.title: La casa del millón

programme.title: El regreso
programme.desc: La familia López se queda sin hogar por un incendio. A causa de la desgracia, deben remodelar y volver a empezar. La policía arresta a Plácido por comprar muebles robados.

programme.title: Los muebles
programme.desc: Plácido regresa a su casa después de haber sido arrestado por la compra de muebles robados. Gaby y Plutarco logran conseguir muebles para la casa, también de dudosa procedencia.

programme.title: A trabajar todos
programme.desc: Plácido está preocupado a causa del desbalance económico que han sufrido por el incendio. Durante una reunión familiar, Plácido establece nuevas reglas y les exige a todos conseguir un trabajo.

programme.title: La venta del edificio
programme.desc: El administrador del edificio notifica a la familia López la venta del edificio donde viven, por lo que deben desalojar el departamento en menos de 24 horas, ya que un nuevo supermercado será construido ahí.

programme.title: Ahí va el agua
programme.desc: La familia López es notificada de que se les cortará el servicio del agua en su departamento. Los miembros de la familia intentan averiguar quién es el responsable de que les hayan retirado el servicio del agua.

programme.title: Tome su turno
programme.desc: Plácido expresa ante su familia su sentir acerca de la falta de intimidad que existe en su hogar. La nueva dinámica para poder vivir en casa de los López es aportar dinero, de lo contrario deben tomar su turno para poder residir ahí.

programme.title: El embarazo no deseado
programme.desc: La familia López se reúne con Tecla para que confiese la verdad sobre su embarazo. Tecla admite que lo hizo porque le gustó y reitera que lo volvería hacer. Tecla confiesa que fue con Adolfo y que fueron tres veces.

programme.title: Germ Z
programme.desc: When a meteor, host to an alien germ, falls to Earth, a small town is infected. The local deputy and his girlfriend must battle their way through an army of infected townsfolk as they struggle to save themselves and their loved ones.

programme.title: Replace
programme.desc: Afflicted with a dermatological disease, young and beautiful Kira discovers that she can replace her skin with that of other girls. Helped by her lover, she plots a murder and the victim becomes her donor, but when the disease returns, she is forced to find more victims.

programme.title: Cosmos
programme.desc: Three amateur astronomers accidentally intercept what they believe to be a signal from a distant alien civilization, but the truth they uncover is more incredible than any of them dare to believe.

programme.title: A Fistful of Lead
programme.desc: Four of the West's most infamous outlaws carry out a daring bank heist in the gold-rush town, Bath Water. As the posse takes chase, things take a turn for the worse, as the bandits realize they've been double-crossed - but by who?

programme.title: Darknet EP 4
programme.desc: A hospitalised woman, unable to move or speak, knows her attacker is back.

programme.title: The Elf TV Cut
programme.desc: Nick is haunted by night terrors stemming from a tragic murder he saw when he was young. After inheriting an old toy shop, he discovers a cursed elf doll sealed inside an ancient chest with a naughty list of his family's names written on it. He soon discovers that the elf was an evil conduit meant to unleash a supernatural killing spree during the Christmas Holidays by whomever set it free.

programme.title: Gonjiam: Haunted Asylum
programme.desc: An internet broadcaster recruits a handful of people to appear on their 'experience the horror' show that will take place at the Gonjiam Mental Hospital, known as one of the world's 7 Horrorific Sites.

programme.title: Leap
programme.desc: After 12 years, the Chinese women's volleyball team again reached the Olympic final. The ups and downs of the Chinese women's volleyball team for more than three decades have slowly spread away.

programme.title: The Mad Whale
programme.desc: Inmates at a women's mental asylum stage a theatrical production of Herman Melville's 'Moby Dick.'

programme.title: Blood Fight
programme.desc: Years after retiring from the world of free fighting martial arts, a man returns to the ring of fighting after his best student is killed in the tournament.

programme.title: Atlantic Rim
programme.desc: When giant monsters crawl out of the Atlantic Ocean and attack the Eastern Seaboard, the U.S. government is forced to trust A.I. robots to defend the country.

programme.title: The Rogue
programme.desc: Nick and Amanda protect a man from an immortal rogue agent seeking revenge.

programme.title: The KAOS Brief
programme.desc: Hacked footage reveals mysterious events surrounding the disappearance of four teenagers.

programme.title: Big Ass Spider!
programme.desc: The unlikely heroic duo of a blue-collar exterminator and Latino security guard must save the day when a military major loses control of a giant spider rampaging through the city of Los Angeles.

programme.title: Repossession
programme.desc: Gerald Chew as Jim, Amy J Cheng as Linda, Sivakumar Palakrishnan as Vinod, Rachel Wan as Ashley, Matthew Loo as The Boy

programme.title: Mermaids
programme.desc: Mermaids is a documentary about the transformative power of a universal myth as seen through the eyes of five tail-donning women.

programme.title: Recon
programme.desc: At the close of WWII, four American soldiers are sent on a reconnaissance mission led by a Italian man with indeterminate loyalties. Hunted by a mysterious sniper, they must fight to make it out alive.

programme.title: Jo: The Opera
programme.desc: "Jo' takes the audience behind the scenes of Paris' most iconic locations, as we follow St-Clair in his relentless pursuit of justice.

programme.title: House of Salem
programme.desc: A group of kidnappers become a child's unlikely protectors after discovering they have unwittingly been set up to take part in a satanic ritual. As they begin to uncover the truth of the house they find themselves trapped, they must battle demonic forces and uncover a legacy of over a hundred years of murder in the name of the Devil.

programme.title: Paranormal Apparition
programme.desc: Paranormal malevolence makes Danni's dream home turn into the house from hell as she is tortured and haunted by an evil apparition.

programme.title: She's Missing
programme.desc: When her best friend goes missing at a rodeo, Heidi goes on a search across the desert, digging up secrets and encountering the violence of life on the road.

programme.title: Part 3: Broken Silence
programme.desc: Criminologist Prof David Wilson conducts a series of interviews with convicted murderer Bert Spencer, the man suspected of - yet never charged with - killing paperboy Carl Bridgewater in 1978.

programme.title: La Rusa
programme.desc: Tito es un hombre de 50 años que atraviesa una crisis personal y decide regresar a su ciudad. Cuando llega, se encuentra con un pueblo mucho más tranquilo y deprimido, dominado por la familia Crespo.

programme.title: Dead on Arrival
programme.desc: Amanda wants the head of a high-tech bank robber, while Nick seeks an antidote for the poison that is slowly killing him.

programme.title: Ip Man 3
programme.desc: When a band of brutal gangsters led by a crooked property developer make a play to take over the city, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.

programme.title: The Elf TV Cut
programme.desc: Nick is haunted by night terrors stemming from a tragic murder he saw when he was young. After inheriting an old toy shop, he discovers a cursed elf doll sealed inside an ancient chest with a naughty list of his family's names written on it. He soon discovers that the elf was an evil conduit meant to unleash a supernatural killing spree during the Christmas Holidays by whomever set it free.

programme.title: Freaks
programme.desc: Kept locked inside the house by her father, 7-year-old Chloe lives in fear and fascination of the outside world, where Abnormals create a constant threat - or so she believes. When a mysterious stranger offers her a glimpse of what's really happening outside, Chloe soon finds that while the truth isn't so simple, the danger is very real.

programme.title: The Jack in the Box
programme.desc: When a vintage Jack In The Box is unearthed and donated to a museum in the heart of the woods, it's not long before a staff member realizes that the creepy clown doll inside has a life of its own and that his colleagues are dying one-by-one.

programme.title: Hoax
programme.desc: An investigative team travels deep into the wilderness after a group of campers are murdered by what may be Bigfoot.

programme.title: Missing 10-Year-Old

programme.title: All-Nighter

programme.title: Monday Night Murder
programme.desc: When a man's family and co-workers lose touch with him and can't find any trace of him for days, the police are sent to his apartment to investigate and see what they can figure it out. But what they find is far worse than any of them expected.

programme.title: Summer of Fear
programme.desc: Random shootings, rapes, and robberies leave almost all of the residents of Phoenix, Arizona scared. On top of that, authorities are seemingly powerless against serial killers that are waging a war of terror on the streets of this Arizona city.

programme.title: The Reclusive Millionaire

programme.title: Takedown with Chris Hansen

programme.title: Murder of Sherry Ziessler
programme.desc: Wendy Ralston and her 5-year-old son Peyton vanished without a trace. Police later found them murdered and buried behind their home, uncovering a horrifying crime committed by Wendy's ex-boyfriend.

programme.title: Tased & Confused
programme.desc: Ohio woman tased after allegedly ramming cop cars.

programme.title: Drunk Teen
programme.desc: Teen shocks police with what was hidden in her pajamas.

programme.title: Body on the Shore
programme.desc: A missing woman's body is found washed up on the shore of a tidal estuary; CCTV, DNA and a cryptic note lead investigators to her ex-partner.

programme.title: Surviving Prison
programme.desc: How do inmates survive within the strict confines of Singapore's only women's prison?

programme.title: Melissa Huckaby

programme.title: Fatal Run
programme.desc: The serene ambiance of Marcq-en-Barroeil was shattered by the abrupt disappearance of Natacha Mougel during her routine jog.

programme.title: Nadine Aburas
programme.desc: In 2012, Cardiff's Nadine Aburas met New Yorker Sammy Almahri on a Muslim dating site. Their intense online relationship led to Nadine visiting New York in July 2014. However, once there, she discovered a different, troubling side to him.

programme.title: Notting Hill Horror (part 2)
programme.desc: John Christie kills at least eight women during the 1940s and 1950s, including his wife; he eluded capture for many years.

programme.title: The Brighton Trunk Murders
programme.desc: On a hot summers day in 1934, a horrifying discovery was made in a trunk at the left luggage office of Brighton Train Station.

programme.title: The Devil
programme.desc: In June 2011, a man is arrested for brutal domestic homicide. This horrible story is the story of a sadistic pulsion.

programme.title: Melissa Huckaby
programme.desc: Vivica guides us through the case of a bipolar Sunday school teacher, Melissa Huckaby, who was accused of sexual assault and murder of 8-year-old Sandra Cantu.

programme.title: Exotic Dancers
programme.desc: When club dancers are confronted by law enforcement, it's not sexy.

programme.title: Bedlam & Brawls
programme.desc: A catfight tears up the dance floor in a Florida nightclub; a raging racer gets into a rival's face feet-first; soccer hooligans clash in a pregame rumble.

programme.title: A Finding in the Loch
programme.desc: Scottish police divers training in Loch Lomond make a chilling discovery: human body parts.

programme.title: The Runaway Murder
programme.desc: In 1978, the body of teen Krisann Baxter is found in Spokane, Washington. The case troubles investigators for over 40 years, but now a forensic technique may solve the mystery.

programme.title: Night Caller
programme.desc: In Clymer, south of Buffalo, NY, there is concern that school superintendent Keith Reed Jr. has disappeared. Police discover he had enjoyed a passionate night of sex with a married woman from Virginia - who has a jealous husband.

programme.title: Smoke and Mirrors
programme.desc: In Morgantown, WV, fire crews discover the body of Jimmy Michaels in bed. There's no obvious explanation for why he wouldn't have tried to escape the burning building until news of an affair starts to provide answers.

programme.title: Shattered Lives
programme.desc: In Emporia, KS, a pair of hikers discover a body floating in the Cottonwood River. It looks to investigators as though a car careened off the road, and the driver was flung out and killed as a result of the impact.

programme.title: Troubled Waters
programme.desc: In Green Bay, WI, Police respond to a 911 call from teacher Bob Bulik, who says he can't revive his wife Pam, 35, who he found floating in their bath tub. Bob claims that his wife was distraught over their failing marriage.

programme.title: See No Evil
programme.desc: In Peru, IN, Susan and Jim Grund are a power couple who seem to have it all. But beneath the surface their marriage is in trouble. Susan's spending too much cash while also enjoying steamy nights in the arms of other men.

programme.title: Love Blind
programme.desc: In Buford, GA, Jennifer Corbin's marriage hits trouble when she starts a cyber affair with a 'man' - who turns out to be a woman. Her husband Bart, a dentist, won't stand for it - and hides a dark secret.

programme.title: Mall Weapon
programme.desc: Officers in Toledo, Ohio, search for a man waving a sword in a mall while officers in Wilkes-Barre, Penn., are dispatched to reports of an intoxicated male; officers in Daytona Beach, Fla., respond to a possible home invasion.

programme.title: Protecting His Woman
programme.desc: The Bounty Hunters track a fugitive at a truck stop just outside Raleigh, North Carolina. Our Bounty Hunters are in Southern California looking for a female fugitive who's boyfriend is heavily armed and has sworn he won't let his girlfriend be captured.

programme.title: Attack Dog
programme.desc: With the charges of theft for receiving stolen property, a fugitive tries hiding out at his girlfriend's house. Bounty Hunters and trained attack dog named "Gunn" are called in facing dangerous fugitives charged with fraud and forgery.

programme.title: The Elusive Rapist
programme.desc: Wrongly convicted, David Milgaard spends 20 years in prison before DNA evidence proves his innocence and reveals the real killer.

programme.title: Sharon Siermans
programme.desc: 29-year-old Ballarat mum Sharon Siermans sought love online and met Jason Godfrey in January 2013. When he arrived at the train station looking nothing like his photos, Sharon, embarrassed, made the disastrous choice to invite him to her home.

programme.title: The Perverted Preacher
programme.desc: A Mobile preacher, killed his wife for discovering his abuse of her daughter. The truth emerges when the girl, pregnant with his child, reveals all.

programme.title: Stephen Port
programme.desc: Stephen Port preyed on young men through his Grindr account, ultimately taking the lives of four individuals. The sisters of victim Jack sought to prove he hadn't died from a self-inflicted overdose, but was murdered, alongside the other men.

programme.title: Murder of Byrd and Melanie Billings
programme.desc: A wealthy Florida couple was murdered in their home as nine of their children slept nearby. Detectives eventually charged eight people in connection with the brutal burglary-motivated killings.

programme.title: Police Chase
programme.desc: Sweaty thieves stop at nothing to steal an air conditioner and flee from police.

programme.title: Indecent Exposure
programme.desc: A navy sailor stationed in Key West gets arrested after he allegedly dropped his drawers at several bars.

programme.title: Tonya Harding
programme.desc: Tonya Harding was one of the best ice-skaters in the world when her greatest rival Nancy Kerrigan was attacked 6 weeks before the 1994 Winter Olympic Games. When Tonya's ex-husband fesses-up, he drags Tonya down with him.

programme.title: In Losing It
programme.desc: In Singapore's only women's prison, about 800 inmates eat, sleep and live together in close confines.

programme.title: Lee Rodarte Jr.
programme.desc: Lee Rodarte Jr., a chef at Bonefish Grill in Jacksonville, Florida, murdered his colleague and ex-lover Savannah Gold.

programme.title: A Gunman In the City
programme.desc: Paris found itself gripped by fear in the aftermath of AbdelHakim Dekhar's violent rampage.

programme.title: Carly Ryan
programme.desc: Carly Ryan thought she'd found her dream boy in 18-year-old musician Brandon Kane. They chatted online for 18 months under her mother's watch. Unbeknownst to them, both Brandon and his stepfather were personas created by 50-year-old Garry Newman.

programme.title: The Acid Bath Murders
programme.desc: As police investigated the disappearance of wealthy widow, Olive Durand Deacon, in early 1949, they could not have imagined the gruesome confession.

programme.title: The Towpath Murders
programme.desc: The day before the coronation of Queen Elizabeth II, a body of a teenage girl was found floating in the River Thames

programme.title: Under Pressure
programme.desc: In the fall of 2013, a 23 years old man, volunteer in the army, is arrested for killing his brother.

programme.title: Lee Rodarte Jr.
programme.desc: Lee Rodarte Jr., a chef at Bonefish Grill in Jacksonville, Florida, murdered his colleague and ex-lover Savannah Gold.

programme.title: Spring Break
programme.desc: The wildest spring break arrests in Florida.

programme.title: Stopped by the Law 4
programme.desc: A lead-footed drug addict leads police on a chase; a routine traffic stop takes a harrowing turn when a woman jumps off a bridge, taking an officer with her; a drug runner gets nabbed with cocaine.

programme.title: Body in the Bag
programme.desc: A murdered woman is found in a duffle bag washed up on the Florida coast; her married, military lover is the prime suspect and a single gold earring seals his fate.

programme.title: Strangled in the Sand
programme.desc: When Clare Holman is murdered in 1994, her case quickly goes cold, and many assume it will stay that way. But twenty years later, new technology finally provides answers.

programme.title: The Ramsey Street Rapist
programme.desc: A string of rapes in the mid-2000s shrouds the community of Fayetteville, North Carolina in fear. Years later, a forensic DNA technique brings the twisted perpetrator to justice.

programme.title: Intruder
programme.desc: In Wilkes-Barre, Pennsylvania, Police respond to a report of a vicious home invasion, while in Olathe, Kansas, a brutal murder sends shock waves through Bible country.

programme.title: Ashes to Ashes
programme.desc: At Lake Mohave, Nevada, a fisherman stumbles across a human skull. In the North West of England, a husband claims his wife has left him for another man. But where is she?

programme.title: Friend or Foe
programme.desc: In Lexington, Kentucky, a newly wed wife parties like there's no tomorrow until a body is dumped on a golf course. In Brisbane, Australia, a mannequin on the street highlights there are fears for the safety of a missing wife.

programme.title: Romance Is Dead
programme.desc: In Poughkeepsie, New York, a Police officer discovers evidence his wife is guilty of cheating on him leading to a deadly encounter, while in Orlando, Florida, a newly wed wife gets herself a boy toy - with fatal results.

programme.title: Trespassing Juveniles
programme.desc: Officers search for juveniles suspected to be armed; officers are called to assist a fearful woman barricaded in a bathroom; officers pursue a vehicle; officers respond to a fight with a gun present.

programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
