programme.title: Masks of Terror
programme.desc: After Jeanette Osborne decorates her home with Haitian masks, eerie events escalate, leading her son Grier to believe they are cursed. When an unseen force attacks him, Jeanette seeks help from a voodoo priest and paranormal expert John Zaffis. As malevolent energy threatens her family, Jeanette must confront the spirits' wrath before their home becomes a place of irreversible terror.

programme.title: The Diabolical
programme.desc: How would reality change if we couldn't perceive or communicate in conventional ways? For Marie, this question is daily life. Her daughter Julie, unable to walk or talk, interacts with unseen forces. Marie wonders if they're angels-until she comes face to face with a demon. A Ouija board session turns their home into a portal for darkness, proving that evil can lurk in the most ordinary places.

programme.title: Demon Unearthed
programme.desc: Jennifer and Norman Rice buy a historic mansion in Garden Grove, Iowa, but renovations uncover eerie rumors of a buried body. As the paranormal activity intensifies, Jennifer and their son are tormented while Norman is away. When he returns, he too falls victim to the evil force. Even the church's blessing fails, forcing the family to flee their dream home before it destroys them.

programme.title: Heartland Horror
programme.desc: Teenager Nolan Lydolph has seen ghosts all his life, but after a ghost tour in Branson, MO, his family's Iowa farmhouse becomes plagued by sinister shadows. When attacks turn violent, Nolan and his mother call paranormal investigator Wesley Fox. He and his psychic wife uncover a calculating demon targeting Nolan, forcing him into a life-threatening battle for survival.

programme.title: Demon Whispers
programme.desc: When Phil Pritchard's beloved father dies, he falls into a deep depression that renders him vulnerable to an unearthly evil that begins influencing him and will stop at nothing to render him a pawn in its relentless thirst for misery and murder.

programme.title: Dark Dreams
programme.desc: Michigan attorney Chris Gibbons and his family move into their dream house, which quickly becomes a nightmare. A bizarre combination of terrifying dreams and ghost sightings force Chris to do battle with the supernatural.

programme.title: The Lake Club Horror
programme.desc: In Springfield, Illinois, the Lake Club was once a lively dance hall where fortunes were won and lost. In 1974, Bill and Tom transform it into a rock club and soon uncover eerie secrets. Phantom music and chilling cold spots make them believe they are not alone. Others share their fears, and a young woman receives a ghostly warning: one of the owners is about to die.

programme.title: Fear House
programme.desc: Childhood fear is pure, untempered by adult rationality. After his divorce, Steven LaChance dismisses his children's nightmares as stress-until he experiences chilling disturbances himself. Shadows lurk, screams echo, and an unseen force preys on them. He flees, but when another family moves in, he vows to help them. If you enter the spirit world, the spirits enter yours.

programme.title: Bewitched
programme.desc: When Sidney's girlfriend moves in, he and his mother, Jaime, experience disturbing events, escalating from eerie calls to physical attacks. They soon discover an ex-friend is using witchcraft to tear them apart. As Jaime becomes the target of a deadly assault, the family, fearing for their lives, seeks the help of paranormal investigators before the dark forces succeed in their sinister plan.

programme.title: Tunnel of Death
programme.desc: After Candace and John St. Clair visit a haunted tunnel where slaves were buried alive, something follows them home. Their daughter has terrifying nightmares, dishes shatter, and the entity soon turns violent. Attacked and terrified, they call paranormal experts to cleanse their home-before they're forced to flee from the malevolent presence.

programme.title: Mind Control
programme.desc: In 2012, Amanda Morrisson and her family clean a relative's home to fund his care but uncover satanic objects. Soon, they face terrifying events-Nate sees shadows, David has nightmares, and Alliah spirals into depression. When Amanda encounters a sinister entity, they seek a demonologist, who traces the haunting to an evil necklace David took from the house.

programme.title: Ghost Hunter
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator Stacy Jones feels confident letting her son Jamie join her at a cemetery investigation. But after returning home, Jamie finds strange scratches on his leg and experiences terrifying activity-objects flying and unseen forces attacking him. When Stacy witnesses a demonic assault on her son, she calls in expert John Zaffis to help save Jamie from possession.

programme.title: Game of Lies
programme.desc: In 2012, Olivia and Jesse Barbour's daughter Marie befriends a boy named Jackson-who isn't real. At first harmless, Jackson soon frightens Marie, leaving bruises and urging her to follow him to heaven. When she's found with red marks on her neck, the family seeks help. Investigators reveal Jackson is a cruel spirit-an old man disguised as a boy to torment Marie.

programme.title: Portal of Doom
programme.desc: While preparing their late friend Paul's house for sale, Anita Intenzo and her son Chris encounter his spirit-along with something much darker. When a violent entity attacks Chris, Anita seeks help. A medium warns of a demon linked to a mysterious artifact Paul acquired abroad. As chaos erupts in their home, Anita and Chris must locate the artifact before the demon destroys them.

programme.title: Casa de los Muertos
programme.desc: Latin jazz guitarist Eddie Benitez moves to Arizona to revive his career, but his home is haunted. Strange occurrences escalate when his son falls mysteriously ill. With no medical explanation, Eddie discovers the room was the site of a horrific suicide. Fearing the spirit is slowly killing his son, Eddie turns to his Puerto Rican roots to battle the deadly entity before it's too late.

programme.title: A Haunting in Ireland
programme.desc: The Fahey family has lived in their Galway townhouse for decades. When Martha brings home her newborn, eerie disturbances begin. Unexplained cries echo through the night, objects vanish, and a chilling presence fills the house. A priest offers no relief, but a healer reveals a dark secret-Martha's child has awakened the psychic energy of a long-buried crime that prayer alone cannot erase.

programme.title: Marked by Evil
programme.desc: After rejecting a friend's advances, Stephanie Winters is cursed. Soon, in their new Virginia home, she and her husband experience strange noises and objects moving. When the entity violently scratches and chokes Stephanie, they seek help. A paranormal investigator suspects a demonic ritual, leading them to a demonologist and the church to battle the dark force before it destroys Stephanie.

programme.title: Back from the Grave
programme.desc: North Carolina natives Jamie and Aaron live a 'perfect' Southern lifestyle until a dark entity begins communicating with and terrifying their children. The family risks ridicule by neighbors and family when they call paranormal experts to the rescue.

programme.title: Cursed
programme.desc: Modern science suggests we are all connected by energy. This may explain why Romie feels drawn to an abandoned house in Tucson, Arizona. After moving in, nightmares bleed into reality, and she sees a shadowy spirit. A clairvoyant urges her to communicate with it, but fear holds her back. As the entity targets only her, Romie begins to question her sanity-is the house haunted, or is she cursed?

programme.title: Evil Never Dies
programme.desc: Jennifer Hoke and fiancé Jamie Jones find their dream home in Pensacola, FL, but something dark lurks within. Strange noises and shadows soon escalate to violent attacks. Jamie is pulled from bed, and the family is trapped in terror. Seeking answers, they turn to a local empath, who uncovers a history more sinister than they ever imagined.

programme.title: Devil Inside Me
programme.desc: John Drenner Jr. unknowingly unleashes a demon after finding a satanic bible in an abandoned shack. Plagued by violent attacks and nightmares, he spirals into depression. Just as the entity threatens to claim his life, he finds hope in a young woman who helps him seek deliverance. With time running out, exorcist Bill Bean must act fast to drive out the demon before it's too late.

programme.title: Trapped in Terror
programme.desc: Taylor Jones reconnects with her estranged mother, Joyce, unaware of the darkness she brings. When Taylor finds Joyce practicing black magic in her daughter's room, she cuts ties-but it may be too late. Isabelle soon has an invisible friend, then grows terrified to be alone. As the haunting escalates, a paranormal team uncovers a tragic past in the attic, trapping tormented souls forever.

programme.title: Ghost Soldier
programme.desc: It's said that every photograph steals a piece of a soul. What happens when the subject is dead? Lisa becomes obsessed with a photo of her boyfriend's brother, killed in Vietnam. As her fixation deepens, she experiences waking visions of the soldier and believes the picture has a life of its own. When her daughters report supernatural encounters, Lisa realizes the spirit is taking control.

programme.title: Provoking Evil
programme.desc: Sam Baltrusis' séance performance leaves him possessed and desperate for safety. A Shaman battles the spirit, so Sam can regain control of his life.

programme.title: The Well to Hell
programme.desc: Mark Corvo rents out rooms in his childhood home, dismissing strange noises as quirks of an old house. But when a tenant, Ashley, dabbles in dark arts, sinister activity intensifies. A paranormal team confirms a portal has been opened. Mark, an empath, is targeted by dark forces and nearly dies after being pushed from his roof. After recovering, he learns to manage his gift and protect his home.

programme.title: Grave Awakenings
programme.desc: When ghosts confront Zoe Dei, she makes the harrowing discovery that her home harbors a paranormal portal which has awakened her dormant ability as psychic medium, forcing her to learn how to live with her newfound ability to see the dead.

programme.title: Gateway to Hell
programme.desc: In life, people can be tormented by their own crimes. The same may be true in death. In Wilder, Kentucky, a nightclub stands by the Licking River, said to draw murderers and Satanists. Club owner Bobby Mackey dismisses the legends-until his wife and an employee are attacked by unseen forces. Beneath the club, an old slaughterhouse well harbors an ancient evil, waiting to claim its next victims.

programme.title: The Haunted Cabinet
programme.desc: After James Hilton and his girlfriend Sandy bring an antique cabinet into their home, they capture actual video evidence proving it's haunted. Sandy fears the entity from the cabinet is taking James over and turns to paranormal investigators for aid.

programme.title: Ghost Inferno
programme.desc: Kim and Craig settle into their dream home in Bagley, Iowa, but eerie encounters shake their peace. Kim senses an intruder, and her daughter befriends a strange man-one no one else can see. When the unseen entity turns violent, a paranormal investigator confirms the presence of a vengeful spirit. Desperate to protect their family, they turn to a demonologist to drive out the ghost.

programme.title: The Apartment
programme.desc: Newlyweds Bill and Myrisa Spencer move into a renovated apartment, eager for a fresh start. But ghostly figures soon roam the halls, and their dream home turns into a nightmare. Unable to break their lease, they endure the hauntings-until a violent attack on Bill forces them to seek help. With local ghost hunters, they uncover the building's dark past and the entities that still linger.

programme.title: Face of Evil
programme.desc: Joy expects a fun girls' trip to a haunted plantation, but after returning home, a sinister spirit torments her children. When she sees its face in a trip photo, she realizes the entity is attached to her-not the plantation. As the spirit grows more aggressive, a determined paranormal investigator helps Joy uncover a terrifying past connection and fight to save her family.

programme.title: Ashes to Evil
programme.desc: Amelia and Calvin Braddy move into a Tennessee apartment, unaware it was once the site of a deadly fire. Amelia senses a presence, believing the spirits of lost children haunt their home. But when the activity turns violent, they realize a darker force is at play-one targeting their family. Desperate for safety, they seek paranormal investigators before it's too late.

programme.title: Norman the Doll
programme.desc: Paranormal investigator, Stephen Lancaster, doesn't believe in haunted objects until he captures proof the doll he recently acquired is haunted. Fearing he is in over his head, he attempts to get rid of it, but the doll has other plans.

programme.title: Ghosts of War
programme.desc: When Dennis Pongratz discovers his late father's WWII memorabilia, including a Nazi armband, eerie phenomena erupt in his home. A vengeful soldier's spirit seeks havoc, while another tries to stop it. As their home becomes a battleground between good and evil, Dennis and his wife Debbie must find a way to end the terror before it consumes them.

programme.title: Nightmare in the Attic
programme.desc: In 1983, the Fox family moves into a historic Arkansas home, but their daughter Mary quickly becomes the target of an unseen evil. An angry ghost and a demon haunt her dreams and waking life, hinting at the home's dark past. As the attacks intensify, the family turns to a psychic, who confirms their worst fear-Mary is in grave danger.

programme.title: House of Nightmares
programme.desc: When Tracey Berrios experiences paranormal activity inside her new home, she suspects spirits tied to the house's history. But after something evil attacks Tracey, she fears for the safety of her family and turns to paranormal investigators for help.

programme.title: Nightmare in Bridgeport
programme.desc: When his mother's house is haunted by a demon, Connecticut paranormal investigator Bob Baker calls in colleagues and a Bishop for help. But when they fail to cleanse the home, it's up to Bob to do the job, using experience from his own 'haunted' past.

programme.title: Demon Child
programme.desc: Some believe ghosts are human spirits seeking peace, while others say they are inhuman entities that feed on fear. Jan's lonely son Cody seems happy with his imaginary friend-until his behavior turns violent. When Cody reveals his friend lives in a red box in a cemetery, Jan seeks help from a Native American shaman. Through ancient rituals, she battles a force far more sinister than a lost soul.

programme.title: Ghost Fury
programme.desc: Alicia and Scott Cain's daughter befriends spirits of two boys who died in a fire, but their presence brings terrifying consequences. When Alicia and her older daughter encounter a blood-soaked apparition, they uncover a brutal murder tied to their home. Paranormal investigators and a priest intervene, but will they be able to free the family from the grip of these vengeful spirits?

programme.title: Where Demons Dwell
programme.desc: The Bible tells of a man possessed by a legion of demons. In Stamford, Connecticut, 12-year-old David has nightmares of a demonic old man flying toward his home. His terror grows daily. His mother is unsure how to respond-until David is physically attacked by an unseen force. Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren discover demons within him. They must act before he is lost to darkness.

programme.title: Haunted Past
programme.desc: As Deborah Utley begins experiencing paranormal events in her home, she turns to her faith for protection. But when her children are targeted by the entity she seeks the aid of paranormal investigators to end the cycle of terror.

programme.title: The Haunting of Summerwind
programme.desc: On the shores of West Bay Lake, Wisconsin, a mansion known as Summerwind stands between the living and the dead. Ginger falls in love with the house despite warnings and moves in with her family. As she restores it, a supernatural force pushes her husband toward madness. With their family unraveling, Ginger and her children fear the house will consume them all.

programme.title: The Forgotten
programme.desc: April and Matt buy a Victorian home in Salt Lake City, eager to restore it. But an unseen force detests change. Renovations stall, voices whisper, and April's son sees movement in his closet. Then, a dark entity appears, determined to drive them out. A medium warns that the house holds tormented children's spirits-and if they don't fight back, they too will become forgotten.

programme.title: Eternal Grief
programme.desc: After moving into a rural Indiana home, Jennifer Patterson hears voices and smells strange scents, suspecting the deceased former owner still lingers. Hoping to coexist, she stays-until the activity turns violent after her boyfriend moves in. Fearing for their safety, the couple seeks help from paranormal experts to uncover the dark truth behind their haunting.

programme.title: The Dark Side
programme.desc: America is full of forgotten cemeteries, some buried beneath new homes. Bobby Wilcott buys a historic manor in Indiana, hoping renovations will strengthen his marriage. But strange occurrences strain their bond-doors won't stay shut, lights flicker, and unease grows. Paranormal experts Ed and Lorraine Warren confirm the worst: a demonic presence is feeding on their fear.

programme.title: Dangerous Game
programme.desc: Carl, Keith, and Cynthia use a spirit board to contact a ghost in their home. At first, it seems harmless, but as violent activity increases, Keith senses danger. Carl, obsessed with the entity, ignores the warnings-until Cynthia is attacked. Realizing they've unleashed something sinister, the brothers call in a paranormal investigator to stop the terrifying presence before it's too late.

programme.title: Sallie's House
programme.desc: Deb and Tony are excited to start their life together in Atchison, Kansas. With their first child on the way, they settle into a charming home, hopeful for the future. After their son is born, his toys move on their own. Deb believes he has a ghostly playmate-until Tony suffers whispers, ghostly footsteps, and bloody wounds. A psychic warns that a darker force is using the spirit to wreak havoc.

programme.title: Black Magic
programme.desc: During renovations, Debbie Guy notices strange activity in her historic Pennsylvania home. After a guest dabbles in black magic, the disturbances turn violent. A ritual sacrifice unleashes a dark force that torments the household. A pastor's blessing fails, and paranormal investigators face their toughest case yet as they battle an evil entity that refuses to be controlled.

programme.title: Dark Forest
programme.desc: Time slowly erases reminders of the past. Old roads are abandoned, and their destinations forgotten. When Clara's family moves to rural Hinsdale, NY, they expect peace but find eerie disturbances. Ritualistic chanting echoes from the woods, and neighbors whisper of roaming ghosts. A psychic warns that spirits are drawn to their home-and to a gruesome secret hidden in the crawlspace.

programme.title: A Haunting in Connecticut
programme.desc: With the help of a psychic and an exorcist, the Parker family battles evil spirits that have invaded their home... and the lives of their children.

programme.title: A Haunting in Georgia
programme.desc: The parents of four-year-old Heidi Wyrick are terrified to learn that their daughter's 'imaginary playmate' is the ghost of a man who once lived- and died- in their suburban Atlanta neighborhood.

programme.title: Halloween Special
programme.desc: Join Bex, Sean and the team as they investigate The Wellington Hotel for Halloween. Based in Halewood, this public inn has more haunting inside of its walls than the spirits behind the bar.

programme.desc: After saving, Crystal is ready to buy a spectacular southern Florida home.

programme.title: Dan and Leigh
programme.desc: Dan and Leigh want to trade their city apartment for their own country home.

programme.title: Crystal and JP
programme.desc: JP and Crystal want to move out of his parent's place and into a home of their own.

programme.title: Billy and Yenna
programme.desc: Billy and Yenna hope to buy a spacious, feng shui-friendly suburban home.

programme.title: Ashli & Pete
programme.desc: Newlyweds Ashli and Pete search for their first home in southern Florida.

programme.title: Cara and Alvaro
programme.desc: Cara and Alvaro want the perfect house at the perfect price, but can't seem to agree on anything else.

programme.title: Piece of Boston Pie
programme.desc: Christina and Clarence search for a suburban home where they can start a family.

programme.title: Rodney & Brenda
programme.desc: A couple searches for a three bedroom home in San Diego that they can afford.

programme.title: James
programme.desc: A young professional is tired of his daily commute and wants to move out of his parent's home.

programme.title: Sherri
programme.desc: After ten years of traveling the world as a humanitarian nurse, Sherri is ready for her next mission. She's hoping to invest her sizable nest egg in a two-bedroom Toronto oasis where she can unpack her gear for good.

programme.title: Lynette and Ryan
programme.desc: Lynette and Rob have no clue how to begin buying a house; property expert Sandra Rinomato is exactly the person to help.

programme.title: Crystal
programme.desc: After saving, Crystal is ready to buy a spectacular southern Florida home.

programme.title: Tracy & Paul
programme.desc: A couple tries to find a dream home.

programme.title: 170 Sq. Ft. Rustic Bike House
programme.desc: Sarah and Tabatha ask John and Zack to help them build a rustic tiny house that can withstand all the dirt and grit of farm life.

programme.title: A Texas-Sized Tiny
programme.desc: Ashley and Angel want to move into a tiny house in their backyard; building a tiny home where the not-so-tiny Texas couple can stretch out and get comfortable pushes Zack's ingenuity to new heights.

programme.title: Going Tiny in Music City
programme.desc: John and Zack head to Tennessee to help an aspiring musician and his growing family as they relocate and downsize into a tiny home at the same time.

programme.title: No Fall Zone
programme.desc: John and Zack head north to Coeur d'Alene, Idaho, where Army veteran Newt and his wife, Brooke, are building a tiny home on wheels with plans to travel the country after Newt completes his sixth and final deployment.

programme.title: 275 Sq. Ft. Nomad's Nest
programme.desc: Jeremy and Lindsay have traveled the world, and they are finally ready to settle down in a tiny house. Lindsay is a fantastic baker who needs functional kitchen space; Jeremy is 6'5 and isn't sure he will even fit in a tiny house.

programme.title: 560 Sq. Ft. Taking Tiny Roots
programme.desc: Jason and Emily and their two kids have been living in what some might consider a McMansion, but this family is ready to start a new chapter, and it all begins with going tiny.

programme.title: 350 Sq. Ft. Outdoor Adventure House

programme.title: The Torch
programme.desc: A concentration camp survivor who is in need of a heart transplant learns the donor was a neo-Nazi terrorist.

programme.title: Sail Away
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark assist a novelist who's given up. Also, they motivate the man's grandson, who has yet to tap into his literary potential.

programme.title: Children's Children
programme.desc: A reporter uncovers a secret about the past of a woman who runs a home for unwed mothers.

programme.title: A Special Love - Part 1
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark persuade a youngster with Down's Syndrome to join the Special Olympics.

programme.title: A Special Love - Part 2
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark's friend Scotty wants to adopt the boy with Down's Syndrome. A custody battle occurs with the biological parents.

programme.title: For the Love of Larry
programme.desc: A man whose son died in Vietnam learns that he has an Amerasian grandson.

programme.title: Another Kind of War, Another Kind of Peace
programme.desc: The father (Ernest Borgnine) of a dead veteran rebels when his son's Vietnamese family tries to immigrate.

programme.title: That's Our Dad
programme.desc: Two orphans face coldheartedness when they ask their favorite children's TV host (Ned Beatty) to adopt them.

programme.title: Love at Second Sight
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark pose as recreation directors to help an angel on a difficult assignment in a retirement community.

programme.title: Love and Marriage - Part 1
programme.desc: Jonathan helps members of a feuding family to see what life would have been like without their loved ones.

programme.title: Love and Marriage - Part 2
programme.desc: Before marrying her fiancé Brad, Mark gives his friend a lesson about marriage that he hopes she will hold dear to her heart.

programme.title: Code Name: FREAK
programme.desc: A 12-year-old genius at college is treated like a social outcast by his less intelligent but more socially adept schoolmates.

programme.title: Man to Man
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark help a dying tycoon to reconnect with his only son; they decide it their mission to help the family reconcile their differences before it is too late.

programme.title: Jonathan Smith Goes to Washington
programme.desc: Jonathan tries to convince a powerful senator to restore severe budget cuts dealing with health-care. However, the assignment seems doomed when the senator suffers a fatal heart attack.

programme.title: Oh Lucky Man
programme.desc: Mark plans to give a recent windfall to a boys' club. But first he must deal with some con artists.

programme.title: Basinger's New York
programme.desc: Jonathan's assignment at Christmas is to show a disillusioned columnist that there's still good out there.

programme.title: All That Glitters
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark pose as priests in order to reopen an abandoned church as a shelter when a major fire breaks out in a neighborhood.

programme.title: Wally
programme.desc: Wally is a hobo and street puppeteer whose caring and goodness have made him an angel without him knowing it.

programme.title: A Song of Songs
programme.desc: After suffering a heart attack, a blind pianist turns to Mark and Jonathan to help him start a new life.

programme.title: A Night to Remember
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark, posing as high-school teachers, help a diverse group of students deal with the trauma of the upcoming senior prom.

programme.title: A Mother and a Daughter
programme.desc: Fearing success may end Jonathan's stay on Earth, Mark hampers efforts to reconcile a mother and daughter.

programme.title: Normal People
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark visit a halfway house for people who were confined to mental facilities but released because they were deemed no longer a danger to society.

programme.title: The Hero
programme.desc: A disabled Vietnam War hero takes drastic steps to get money for dental work; with Anne Curry and Daniel Ziskie.

programme.title: A Father's Faith
programme.desc: A fisherman's livelihood is in jeopardy because of the amount of time he devotes to his comatose son.

programme.title: A Heavy Date
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark play matchmaker for two young people, a reckless young man and an unmarried, pregnant teenager; they learn a lesson about love and responsibility.

programme.title: Ghost Rider
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark (Michael Landon, Victor French) help a lonely writer (guest star Didi Conn) meet a secret agent (guest star Warwick Sims) murdered in 1968.

programme.title: The Gift of Life
programme.desc: A cold-hearted businessman is given the opportunity to relive the last week of his life. And he tries to do the right thing this time.

programme.title: Man's Best Friend - Part 1
programme.desc: A lost dog becomes the missing link between an orphan and a married couple, who are unable to have children.

programme.title: Man's Best Friend - Part 2
programme.desc: The orphan boy has formed an attachment to the dog, although he is going away to living with a new foster family.

programme.title: Fight For Your Life
programme.desc: A trainer is reminded of his own shady past when a fighter he's been mentoring is asked to take a fall.

programme.title: The People Next Door
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark must help a doctor confront a secret he's kept from everyone, including his own family.

programme.title: I Was a Middle Aged Werewolf
programme.desc: On Halloween, Jonathan helps a little boy get over his fears and in the process get even with his sister!

programme.title: Playing for Keeps
programme.desc: Jonathan casts a retired comic and his movie-star son in a play about a father and son who never got to know each other.

programme.title: Amazing Man
programme.desc: A youngster turns to a fantasy world and a comic-book superhero to cope with the pain of his father's death.

programme.title: All the Colors of the Heart
programme.desc: A counselor at a camp for the blind enlists Jonathan to prevent the suicide of a man losing his sight.

programme.title: Why Punish the Children?
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark clash with a warden over reforms that would unite female inmates with their children.

programme.title: A Dream of Wild Horses
programme.desc: The patriarch of a ranch family feels he's too old to rein in some wild horses.

programme.title: In With the "In" Crowd
programme.desc: A cop is working undercover at a school to put an end to drug use, but faces suspension because of a mistake Mark has made.

programme.title: With Love, The Claus
programme.desc: At Christmastime, Jonathan and Mark try to get a divorced couple to work together for their son's sake. Meanwhile, the holiday may be in jeopardy when a department store Santa is arrested.

programme.title: A Mother's Love
programme.desc: Four brothers go on the run to escape a court order that would split them up.

programme.title: Country Doctor
programme.desc: A country doctor's (Roscoe Lee Browne) dedication to his community's medical needs nearly ruins him physically and financially. With Renee Jones.

programme.title: Time in a Bottle
programme.desc: A zealous district attorney tries for a felony conviction of a vagrant accused of stealing a bottle of wine.

programme.title: Back to Oakland
programme.desc: Mark returns to Oakland to become a police officer again, and is reunited with his old partner. However, he discovers his old beat has become a storm of racial hatred.

programme.title: We Have Forever - Part 1
programme.desc: Jonathan hopes that he'll be released from his duties to be reunited with his wife when she passes away.

programme.title: We Have Forever - Part 2
programme.desc: Jonathan hopes that he'll be released from his duties to be reunited with his former wife when she passes away.

programme.title: The Correspondent
programme.desc: A war correspondent finds himself imprisoned and facing execution. Meanwhile, Jonathan and Mark show him what's he's missed during his life by putting work ahead of family.

programme.title: Aloha
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark (Michael Landon, Victor French) help a former dancer (Mokihana) overcome her bitterness at being disabled.

programme.title: A Dolphin Song for Lee - Part 2
programme.desc: Jonathan and Mark convince teenager Lee to lobby in the state senate for broader environmental protection.

programme.title: Heaven Nose, Mister Smith
programme.desc: Jonathan must stop an angel who's back on Earth with the intention of breaking up his son's marriage.

programme.title: The Whole Nine Yards
programme.desc: Jonathan intermediates for a football coach whose attitude about winning-at-all-costs has alienated his son.

programme.title: Skarhult Castle
programme.desc: Cuisine Royale gives a glimpse behind the scenes of the grand parties and dinners of the noble families of today.

programme.title: Casting The Net Wide On Tybee Island
programme.desc: Tybee Island is home to fun locals, a deep history, and, of course, seafood so delicious that it, alone, was enough reason for Skye to make a return trip.

programme.title: Mambo Italiano
programme.desc: Italy has given us many of food greatest hits, and we give a great big grazie with three Italian delicacies. The journey begins with delicious pizza, then we dive head first into spaghetti and meatballs and we finish it all off with cannoli.

programme.title: Bring It On, Birmingham!
programme.desc: Damaris Philips and Rutledge Wood are sold on Birmingham, Alabama's, Southern hospitality and amazing eats! At the charming 1950s hot dog shop Gus's Hot Dogs, the duo feasts on a spicy wiener packed with decidedly Southern flavors and spices. Next up is Johnny's restaurant where they're serving up a classic meat n' three with a surprising Greek twist. Finally, a trip to the charmingly rustic Ovenbird where a feast of locally raised, Braised Goat and buttery grits awaits.

programme.title: Veggin' Out!
programme.desc: In the bountiful farmlands of Idaho, Little Big Town's Kimberly Schlapman visits an organic farmer whose diverse and naturally grown crops yield a delicious, healthy harvest year-round. After tasting the farm flavor, Kimberly takes some of the fresh greens back to the kitchen, where singer Eric Paslay joins her as she whips up a healthy and hearty meal straight from the heartland.

programme.title: Taco Tuesdays
programme.desc: Pull up a seat and enjoy Taco Tuesdays on Xumo Free Food TV, featuring mouth-watering Mexican cooking shows.

programme.title: QUICK AND DELICIOUS BRAISES
programme.desc: Lidia loves long cooking techniques and braising but often, one just wants to prepare quick and delicious meals using the same technique. In this episode, she teaches the viewer to do just that. Her first dish is a velvety Lettuce Soup in a Fontina Gratin; she then makes a juicy but super quick Pork Tenderloin with Balsamic Onions. Lastly, she prepares String Beans with Rocky Mashed Potatoes made with garlic and olive oil.

programme.title: FISH AND SEAFOOD
programme.desc: It doesn't get any better in an Italian kitchen than when Lidia makes fish and vegetables. In this episode, she prepares a nice and refreshing Pan Seared Shrimp with Arugula Pesto. Her next dish is Butterflied Trout, fried in a pan with Bacon and Basil served with a Zucchini Dish made with Anchovies and Capers.

programme.title: The Industry of Food
programme.desc: Industrialization triggers the second great food revolution, transforming people's diets.

programme.title: Fieldtrip Harlem
programme.desc: Accomplished Chef J.J. Johnson shares why he chose his beloved Harlem to open Fieldtrip Harlem where rice is culture, and Historian Lana Turner takes us back in time to when the Harlem that we know to

programme.title: The Lamb Show
programme.desc: Julia makes her classic Leg of Lamb Roast with Herbs and Mustard, and guest chef Moncef Meddeb serves Maine Lobster in Shallot Butter Sauce. Wine expert Richard Sanford of the Sanford Winery in Santa Ynez, California offers suitable wines.

programme.title: episode 2
programme.desc: Beetroot salad with St. Tola hoats' cheese, honey and pomegranate. Grilled t-bone steak with horseradish cream and salsa verde. Oven roasted chips. Salad of organic greens. Almond and cinnamon thins with pears.

programme.title: episode 3
programme.desc: Green vegetable soup. Roast leg of lamb and mint relish. Chickpea and coriander puree. Carrots with lemon. A 'plain cake' served with strawberries, crème anglaise and cream.

programme.title: A Moveable Feast with America's Favorite Chefs
programme.desc: Join Jose Andres, Lidia Bastianich, Rick Bayless, Chris Kimball, Ruth Reichl and Ming Tsai as each chef cooks up a single course, shares memorable stories and samples each other's dishes at a one-of-a-kind progressive dinner party.

programme.title: Bucket List Dishes
programme.desc: Nadia G serves up gnudi, pulled pork sandwiches, and inverted lemon meringue, sharing bold flavors and life lessons, while The Spice Agent and Panos dish sage and pork secrets.

programme.title: Quick Bites
programme.desc: Chef Dev prepares some of his favorite street food dishes that are easy to eat on the go, including Peruvian Ceviche, Tteokbokki from South Korea, and Manakish Flatbreads from Lebanon.

programme.title: Lazy Salmon and Sides
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Lazy Salmon and Sides! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Steak 'n' Kimchi Mac 'n' Cheese
programme.desc: Lazy and curmudgeonly chef and ex-Gusto writer Zach cooks one of his all-time favorite dishes - Steak 'n' Kimchi Mac 'n' Cheese! While cooking, he tells aimless stories, cracks bad jokes, and berates Sydney, the beleaguered camera person.

programme.title: Mayo (Castlebar) / Larnaka, Cyprus
programme.desc: In this Tastes Like Home episode, our contributors are Parents and Daughter, Lorcan + Betty and Colleen. Colleen has been living in Larnaka for 4 years now. She lives there with her husband Julian and their twin daughters, we first meet Betty and her husband Lorcan cycling on the Greenway route to find out who is the family member living away from home.

programme.title: Robin Roberts and Joseph Sikora
programme.desc: Patti LaBelle makes a slow-cooked Southern meal for her good friend and morning show anchor Robin Roberts. She's treated to Patti's mouth-watering Corn Beef served with Fierce Fried Cabbage and rice with homemade gravy. Later, actor Joseph Sikora from the hit show Power gets his appetite satisfied with a tender T-bone steak and sauteed Brussels sprouts with turkey bacon served alongside garlic Yukon gold mashed potatoes.

programme.title: Kym Whitley and Ledisi
programme.desc: Patti LaBelle invites funny girl Kym Whitley over for a family-style meal including roasted Cornish hens stuffed with her famous "Don't Block the Blessing" Dressing served with an oven-roasted vegetable medley. It's all about food, family and fun as these two eat a little and laugh a lot. Patti takes singer-songwriter Ledisi back to her New Orleans roots with a slamming shrimp creole dish -- a meal so good they both have to sing about it.

programme.title: Robin Thicke
programme.desc: Robin Thicke talks growing up with famous parents, songwriting with Michael Jackson, and so much more.

programme.title: Cambodia
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay leaves his hectic professional life behind him as he embarks on a pilgrimage for fresh flavors in Cambodia.

programme.title: Apples & Trout
programme.desc: Chefs Erica and Josh Karbelnik go head-to-head to see who can come up with the more tantalizing dish! The catch? Each of their plates must prominently feature both apples and trout!

programme.title: Episode 5
programme.desc: This week, Melvyn explores Taiwan. He scales the altitudes of Taiwan's central mountains to meet an aboriginal woman. With her, Melvyn discovers some unique local produce and learns how to prepare a dish that dates back to the hunting days of the Atayal men.

programme.title: Barbeque
programme.desc: When it comes to cooking, barbecue is the broadest category of them all. It could be a cooking method, astyle of food, a flavor or sauce, a name for a type of gathering, or even the actual machine used to cook foods! But when you mix all of that up together...the end result is a shockwave of salty... smoky... and juicy... flavors trapped inside a mouthwatering piece of meat.

programme.title: Morocco
programme.desc: Discover the world through some of the most delicious and unusual dishes from countries like China, Morocco and Venezuela. In each episode, we will explore colourful local markets, discovering new flavours and regional produce. The ingredients we find will form the basis for some very special dishes that are simple to make at home.

programme.title: Episode 7
programme.desc: In tonight's programme, Gordon takes his son Jack fishing in the Scottish Highlands and then gets the rest of the family to help turn an old Robin Reliant into a salmon smoker in his garden.

programme.title: The Future
programme.desc: Climate change, a global pandemic, and a booming world population mark an opportune time to be in the food business, not unlike the first wave of the industrial food revolution that gave people the first globally mass-produced, processed foods.

programme.title: Petits Fours
programme.desc: Julia Child demonstrates how to turn sugar and water into white fondant icing which can be used to ice and decorate petits fours.

programme.title: El Rincón
programme.desc: The "Semana Santa" belongs to Marqués de Griñón and his family. During the Holy Week, simple meals are traditionally served but the Count has invited the cultural and social elite of Madrid for a Gala Dinner to El Rincon.

programme.title: Riegersburg Castle
programme.desc: Riegersburg Castle is one of the largest castles in Austria and in the ownership of Prince Emanuel von und zu Liechtenstein.

programme.title: Asparagus
programme.desc: Andre Pachon is the leader of the French chef community in Japan. Several of his apprentices have already appeared, but this time Pachon sends his number one man.

programme.title: Pork Belly
programme.desc: The younger sibling of the Liang brothers, rulers of Cantonese cuisine in Japan, faces the Iron Chef Chinese.

programme.title: Edinburgh
programme.desc: Michelin starred Chef, Tom Kerridge takes Fred to Edinburgh for a fine dining experience at Kitchin, the Michelin starred restaurant of Chef Tom Kitchin. Kitchin specialises in showcasing Scottish ingredients, sourced from a network of suppliers to ensure that the menu really captures a taste of Scotland.

programme.title: Northeast India
programme.desc: Gordon immerses himself in the life of a local tribe in Nagaland, visits Assam to enter a housewives' competition and sets up shop on the streets of Calcutta.

programme.title: Leftovers
programme.desc: Find out why "nasty bits" deserve to be on the kitchen table.

programme.title: London
programme.desc: Travel with Chef April Bloomfield to London, where her cooking career began.

programme.title: Spain
programme.desc: This episode is all about Spain's influence on Chang's career. He visits with some of his idols--Juan Mari Arzak and Andoni Aduriz, makes fideos, salt cod omelet and a sponge cake from chef Albert Adria.

programme.title: Episode 14
programme.desc: In Lancashire, Molly is bringing her latest commission to life: a two-foot square beach scene complete with jelly sea, crispy marshmallow rocks and dozens of hand-carved bathers.

programme.title: Episode 6
programme.desc: Molly tackles a cake with some bite with a giant white shark birthday cake.

programme.title: Rule 7: Think Before You Speak
programme.desc: The rule is simple, guests must take at least two bites of the dishes presented to them by host Khleo Thomas.

programme.title: Rule 8: Three's A Crowd
programme.desc: The rule is simple, guests must take at least two bites of the dishes presented to them by host Khleo Thomas.

programme.title: PASTA
programme.desc: Everybody loves pasta and so does Lidia. Today, she makes three dishes that viewers will love. Her first dish is an Orecchiette with Clams and Zucchini, made with scallions, pepperoncino and garlic. Her Spaghetti Caruso is made with a hearty sauce of mixed mushrooms, tomatoes, peas and chicken livers. She finishes with a unique dish of Rigatoni with Cauliflower, Saffron and Golden Raisins.

programme.title: Friday Final Number Four
programme.desc: Professional chefs Nigel Haworth, Atul Kochhar, Ryan Simpson and Mary Ann Gilchrist pair up with their chosen home cook partners and go head to head. Pierre Koffmann judges.

programme.title: Celebratory Food Traditions
programme.desc: Rutledge Wood and Damaris Philips find themselves in the unofficial Cajun capital of the south -- the French Louisiana region of Acadiana in Lafayette, Louisiana. Their first stop is Cafe Vermilionville for their New Orleans-inspired Crawfish 'Beignets' and Turtle Soup. Next, it's off to roadside stop Best Stop Boudin for their Boudin Blanc, Boudin Balls and fan-favorite Cracklins.

programme.title: Biloxi's Big Eats
programme.desc: In a city like Biloxi, Mississippi, it's a must to indulge in all the fresh seafood fished daily from the gulf so Damaris Philips and Rutledge Wood waste no time settling in. Their tour starts at local favorite seafood joint Hook with their fresh-caught fare like speckled trout smothered with a scratch-made Pass Christian sauce. On a visit to White Pillars, they feast on exceptional farm-to-table fare, chowing down on chicken-fried rabbit with black rice and grits.

programme.title: Special Occasion Comfort
programme.desc: Dinner worth celebrating: burgundy chicken stew with porcini-mushroom grits and pancetta, and whole roasted pork belly with fresh salsa verde.

programme.title: Comforting Family Faves
programme.desc: Nostalgia on a plate: moussaka crown, Italian herb roast halfchickens in sundriedtomato cream sauce, and velvety eggnog crème caramel.

programme.title: Canadian Comfort
programme.desc: Spencer puts a Canadian spin on comfort: meat tourtière pies, Newfoundland-style figgy duff with mapleliqueur, and West Coast salmon rolls.

programme.title: Hot Soup Comfort
programme.desc: Spencer ladles up comforting bowls, including spicy spinach and Taleggio wonton soup in chorizo broth, jerk-rubbed chicken ramen, and rich cream of mushroom soup.

programme.title: Steak Night With London Broil
programme.desc: There is nothing better than a great piece of meat! In today's episode, Lidia takes a less expensive cut, London Broil, and marinate it to perfection. programme.title: Savannah's Top Banana
programme.desc: Jesse Cole, the visionary owner of the Savannah Bananas, turned a failing college summer baseball team into a $500 million entertainment empire by doing the exact opposite of what everyone else did. Suzy Kolber traces how a man in a yellow tuxedo built a global phenomenon by asking a question nobody else was: What if the fans and true fun are the whole point? Jesse opens up about being nearly $2 million in debt and the critics who were certain he was out of his mind - right up until he wasn't.

programme.title: Off Mic
programme.desc: For four decades, sports broadcasting pioneers Suzy Kolber and Lisa Salters have told everyone else's story. The championship runs. The comebacks. The night Damar Hamlin's heart stopped, and millions hung on their every word. Through all of it, their own stories - flourishing in a male-dominated business, juggling single motherhood with a demanding career - stayed off the mic. Until now.

programme.desc: Patricia hosts an all-male dinner party to avoid drama, but Whitney and Thomas wind up fighting; Craig invites Shep and Whitney to his parents' house; the gang gets dressed in formal attire to attend a ball; Kathryn ends up home alone.

programme.title: Unaware in Delaware
programme.desc: After the Founders Ball, Craig encounters his boss and learns the consequences of his partying ways; Kathryn resolves to become a different person; when Shep and Whitney head to Delaware, secrets are revealed and friendships tested.

programme.title: Jekyll and Snide
programme.desc: Landon invites the gang to her hometown for a weekend getaway; Kathryn upbraids Whitney; after Craig and Kathryn spend a night on the beach alone, an explosive accusation threatens to upend Thomas' political aspirations.

programme.title: Election Day
programme.desc: Thomas deals with the aftermath of the accusations as election day approaches; Kathryn makes a far-reaching decision; Whitney suspects Kathryn is behind the allegations; the gang gathers at a restaurant to hear the election results.

programme.title: Dysfunction Junction
programme.desc: As Thomas adjusts to his new post-election life, Kathryn cannot seem to let go of the past; Patricia organizes a charity event to benefit Wounded Warriors; Shep and Craig agree to participate in a date auction; relationships are pushed to the brink.

programme.title: Hashtagnewcraig
programme.desc: Craig throws himself a welcome back party and invites the gang to get back together again; Thomas and Kathryn have officially called it quits, and their tumultuous relationship continues to create a wedge between them and their friends.

programme.title: Miss Domesticated
programme.desc: Thomas realizes he must co-parent with Kathryn in a harmonious way; Cameran decides to show off her domestic skills by throwing a dinner party; Craig comes to Kathryn's defense; Shep plays the field; Landon feels pinched economically.

programme.title: Hold Your Horses
programme.desc: As Craig settles into his new job, Cameran recruits Shep to be her real estate partner; Landon hits her father up for money; Kathryn begs Thomas to cosign the lease on her new house; a family day spent watching Thomas play polo turns into a showdown.

programme.title: Birds of a Feather...
programme.desc: Kathryn experiences complications related to her pregnancy, motivating Thomas to cosign her lease; Cameran considers seeing a therapist about her reluctance regarding motherhood; Craig challenges Thomas' commitment to Kathryn.

programme.title: Invite-gate
programme.desc: Craig continues to question why Kathryn is on the outs and Shep considers settling down; Kathryn comes to terms with her volatile past and tries to make her way back into the group; Landon prepares for a Shep's birthday party.

programme.title: Beast of Bourbon
programme.desc: Kathryn reaches out to an old friend to make amends; Landon heads to New York for an opportunity; Thomas grows fearful about the health of his unborn child; Craig receives a crushing blow at work, while taking a big step forward with Naomie.

programme.title: Blue Ridge Mountain Blues
programme.desc: Craig digs into the past to find the source of the animosity aimed at Kathryn; Cameran reveals more than expected at her therapy session; the gang enjoys the serenity of the Blue Ridge Mountains until secrets are revealed and friendships tested.

programme.title: Whit's End
programme.desc: The trip puts a strain on group dynamics; Craig attempts to salvage his friendships with Cameran and Whitney; Kathryn breaks the news that the baby is coming ahead of schedule, thwarting Thomas' plans to go away to Los Angeles with the guys.

programme.title: Saint and Sinners
programme.desc: As Thomas and Kathryn prepare to welcome their son into the world, JD questions whether Thomas is actually the father; Craig heads to Los Angeles for a guys' weekend; Landon reveals to Cameran the feelings she harbors for her best friend.

programme.title: From Here to Paternity
programme.desc: After the birth of their son, Thomas and Kathryn take baby steps towards a reconciliation; Landon makes a surprising declaration; Thomas has few reasons to rejoice after shocking revelations and fiery accusations are made during a celebratory dinner.

programme.title: Words of Wisdom
programme.desc: Thomas wants to prove that Kathryn and the children should not be overlooked; Patricia takes Landon under her wing and shows her how to make Shep swoon; Thomas hosts a dinner party during which a toast drives the gang apart.

programme.title: Founder's Brawl
programme.desc: Kathryn appreciates that Thomas finally had her back; JD and Whitney stage an intervention to air their concerns over Thomas' erratic behavior; the gang gets together at the second annual Founder's Ball, where simmering tensions come to a boil.

programme.title: While the Kat's Away...
programme.desc: Thomas rises to the challenge of being a single father; Shep continues to be Charleston's perennial bachelor and has a new wingman, Austen; Cameran is convinced she knows the woman who can reel Shep in; Landon is back with a new boyfriend.

programme.title: Roamin' Holiday
programme.desc: Cameran gets a sneak peek at motherhood; Kathryn's trip to Malibu, Calif., proves to be more than just sunbathing and surfing; Shep confronts Craig about the nature of his legal career; Thomas realizes he needs a stepmother for his children.

programme.title: Step and Release
programme.desc: Craig helps Naomie throw a fundraiser, but the differences in their planning styles threaten to expose the cracks in their relationship; Thomas decides to rekindle his friendship with Landon; Shep and Chelsea share a romantic evening.

programme.title: Shepwrecked
programme.desc: Kathryn struggles to cope with supervised visitation; Craig's life with Naomie starts to fall apart; Whitney confronts Landon about her true feelings for Thomas; Cameran tries to convince Shep it's not too late to win Chelsea back.

programme.title: Craig of All Trades, Master of None
programme.desc: Cameran turns to the supernatural in hopes of finding her life's purpose; Thomas asks Landon out on a date; Shep confronts Austen about his "bro-code" violation; Naomie reaches her boiling point when she learns of Craig's latest endeavor.

programme.title: To Liver and Die in Charleston
programme.desc: Shep receives shocking news about his health; Austen and Chelsea deepen their romantic bond; Thomas and Landon's connection is tested; Jennifer hosts a Sip and See to celebrate her new baby; Craig finally seals the deal on an investment property.

programme.title: Fowl Play
programme.desc: As Kathryn contemplates a reunion with the father of her children, Patricia pushes Landon and Thomas closer together; Craig and Naomie attempt to reconcile; Shep plans a hunting getaway for the group; Chelsea falls for Austen's hunting prowess.

programme.title: Sari, Not Sari...
programme.desc: Craig and Naomie visit a therapist; Austen and Chelsea continue to grow closer; Shep runs into Austen and Landon at a bar; Kathryn writes Thomas a letter; Patricia hosts an Indian-themed dinner and invites an Indian healer who reveals the future.

programme.title: Guess Who's Coming to Lunch
programme.desc: After the chaos of Patricia's dinner, some fortunes begin to come true; Cameran agrees to see if Kathryn has really changed; Austen and Craig discuss whether Shep still has his heart set on Chelsea; Landon prepares to quash a potential relationship.

programme.title: The Hangover
programme.desc: Thomas and Kathryn end their standoff to celebrate their son's birthday; Cameran begins to rethink motherhood; Craig proves he's finally all grown up when he gets the keys to his new house; Shep decides he needs to move out of downtown.

programme.title: Boys Gone Wild
programme.desc: Thomas agrees to let Kathryn do a photo shoot with Kensie; Craig and Naomie question whether they should continue to be a couple; when Chelsea tells Austen about a late-night encounter with Shep, friendships are pushed to the brink.

programme.title: A Tribe Called Key West
programme.desc: The gang heads to Key West for Cam's birthday trip; Austen questions Chelsea's commitment to their relationship; Craig finds himself on thin ice with Naomie; Kathryn reveals shocking new information about Thomas and Landon's relationship.

programme.title: Ain't No Thang Like a Chicken Wing
programme.desc: Landon and Kathryn's Key West apology sends shock waves through the South; Chelsea and Austen strive to define their relationship; Craig and Naomie decide the fate of their relationship; old tensions reemerge at JD's party.

programme.title: The Break-Up Bunch Part 1
programme.desc: Cameran prepares for the birth of her baby; Shep confesses to the downfall of his relationship following his quest to find love; Kathryn celebrates her second year of sobriety; Thomas has a new love interest.

programme.title: The Break-Up Bunch Part 2
programme.desc: Shep hosts his first adult dinner party, where Craig's anxieties over seeing Naomie mount and Austen remains hopeful that he can win Chelsea back; Kathryn finally meets Ashley, the woman determined to be the next Mrs. Ravenel.

programme.title: Groovy Baby
programme.desc: Patricia surprises Cameran by planning a glamorous retro baby shower, where Craig and Naomie fall back into old habits and an unexpected guest turns the event on its head; Thomas considers his future with Ashley.

programme.title: All Talk No Action

programme.title: Pulp Friction
programme.desc: Patricia encourages Thomas to propose; Austen's parents push him to make some strides professionally; Craig hires a coach to help him get his life on track; Naomie comes face to face with Craig's new crush.

programme.title: Kat's Got Your Tongue
programme.desc: Cameran suspects that she may be experiencing labor pains; Kathryn prepares for her first day of work; Craig helps Austen realize things are over with Chelsea; Patricia tries to make Ashley into the perfect Southern Belle and hosts a dinner party.

programme.title: What da Fuskie

programme.title: Beer and Trembling
programme.desc: Austen prepares to debut his beer to his family and friends; Craig makes progress on his pillows for Patricia; Cameran tries to adjust to her new life with baby Palmer.

programme.title: Slide Into Your DMs Like...
